    import {useEffect, useState} from 'react';
    import {Clock3, Loader2, RefreshCw} from 'lucide-react';
    import {toast} from 'sonner';
    import {Button} from '#/components/ui/button';
    import {Dialog, DialogContent, DialogDescription, DialogHeader, DialogTitle} from '#/components/ui/dialog';
    import {Textarea} from '#/components/ui/textarea';
    import {certificateRequest} from './certificate-api';
    import type {Certificate, CertificateRenewal} from './certificate-types';
    
    type Props = {certificate: Certificate | null; open: boolean; onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void; onRenewed: () => Promise<void>};
    
    const date = (timestamp?: number) => timestamp ? new Date(timestamp * 1000).toLocaleString() : 'Not available';
    
    export function CertificateHistoryDialog({certificate, open, onOpenChange, onRenewed}: Props) {
    	const [history, setHistory] = useState<CertificateRenewal[]>([]);
    	const [certificateData, setCertificateData] = useState('');
    	const [privateKey, setPrivateKey] = useState('');
    	const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
    	const [renewing, setRenewing] = useState(false);
    
    	useEffect(() => {
    		if (!open || !certificate) return;
    		setCertificateData(''); setPrivateKey(''); setLoading(true);
    		certificateRequest<CertificateRenewal[]>(`/certificates/${certificate.id}/renewals`)
    			.then(setHistory).catch(error => toast.error(error.message)).finally(() => setLoading(false));
    	}, [certificate, open]);
    
    	const renew = async () => {
    		if (!certificate) return;
    		try {
    			setRenewing(true);
    			await certificateRequest(`/certificates/${certificate.id}/renew`, {method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({certificate_data: certificateData, private_key: privateKey})});
    			toast.success('Certificate replaced successfully');
    			onOpenChange(false);
    			await onRenewed();
    		} catch (error) { toast.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Renewal failed'); }
    		finally { setRenewing(false); }
    	};
    
    	return <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}><DialogContent className="max-h-[92vh] overflow-y-auto sm:max-w-2xl"><DialogHeader><DialogTitle className="flex items-center gap-2"><RefreshCw className="size-4" />Replace certificate</DialogTitle><DialogDescription>Install a renewed PEM pair and keep an audit trail of previous attempts.</DialogDescription></DialogHeader><div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2"><Textarea className="min-h-32 font-mono text-xs" value={certificateData} onChange={event => setCertificateData(event.target.value)} placeholder="New certificate chain"/><Textarea className="min-h-32 font-mono text-xs" value={privateKey} onChange={event => setPrivateKey(event.target.value)} placeholder="New private key"/></div><div className="flex justify-end"><Button onClick={renew} disabled={renewing || !certificateData.trim() || !privateKey.trim()}>{renewing ? <Loader2 className="animate-spin"/> : <RefreshCw/>}Replace</Button></div><div className="border-t pt-4"><p className="mb-2 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold"><Clock3 className="size-3.5"/>Renewal history</p>{loading ? <Loader2 className="mx-auto my-6 size-5 animate-spin"/> : history.length === 0 ? <p className="py-5 text-center text-xs text-muted-foreground">No renewal attempts yet.</p> : <div className="space-y-2">{history.map(item => <div key={item.id} className="rounded-md border px-3 py-2 text-xs"><div className="flex justify-between"><span className={item.status === 'SUCCEEDED' ? 'font-semibold text-emerald-500' : item.status === 'FAILED' ? 'font-semibold text-destructive' : 'font-semibold text-amber-500'}>{item.status}</span><span className="text-muted-foreground">{date(item.started_at)}</span></div>{item.new_expires_at && <p className="mt-1 text-muted-foreground">Expires: {date(item.new_expires_at)}</p>}{item.error && <p className="mt-1 text-destructive">{item.error}</p>}</div>)}</div>}</div></DialogContent></Dialog>;
    }

    import {Clock3, HardDrive, KeyRound, Loader2, Pencil, RefreshCw, ShieldCheck, Trash2} from 'lucide-react';
    import {Button} from '#/components/ui/button';
    import type {Certificate, RemoteServer} from './certificate-types';
    
    type Props = {items: Certificate[]; servers: RemoteServer[]; loading: boolean; onCreate: () => void; onEdit: (item: Certificate) => void; onHistory: (item: Certificate) => void; onDelete: (item: Certificate) => void};
    
    function certificateInfo(pem: string) {
    	try {
    		const match = pem.match(/-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----([\s\S]*?)-----END CERTIFICATE-----/);
    		if (!match) return {count: 0};
    		return {count: (pem.match(/-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----/g) || []).length};
    	} catch { return {count: 0}; }
    }
    
    export function CertificateList({items, servers, loading, onCreate, onEdit, onHistory, onDelete}: Props) {
    	if (loading) return <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 py-20 text-xs text-muted-foreground"><Loader2 className="size-5 animate-spin"/>Loading certificates...</div>;
    	if (!items.length) return <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-3 rounded-lg border border-dashed py-16 text-center"><ShieldCheck className="size-9 text-muted-foreground"/><div><p className="text-sm font-semibold">No custom certificates</p><p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Install a PEM certificate chain for Traefik.</p></div><Button size="sm" onClick={onCreate}>Install certificate</Button></div>;
    	return <div className="space-y-2">{items.map(item => {const server = servers.find(value => String(value.id) === item.server_id); const info = certificateInfo(item.certificate_data); return <div key={item.id} className="flex flex-col gap-3 rounded-lg border bg-card px-4 py-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between"><div className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-3"><div className="flex size-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-md bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-500"><ShieldCheck className="size-4.5"/></div><div className="min-w-0"><div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2"><p className="truncate text-sm font-semibold">{item.name}</p><span className="rounded bg-muted px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{info.count > 1 ? `${info.count} cert chain` : 'PEM'}</span>{item.auto_renew === 1 && <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] font-medium text-emerald-500"><RefreshCw className="size-3"/>Renewal tracking</span>}</div><div className="mt-1 flex flex-wrap gap-x-3 gap-y-1 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground"><span className="flex items-center gap-1"><HardDrive className="size-3"/>{server ? `${server.name} (${server.ip_address})` : 'Openoxide local'}</span><span className="flex items-center gap-1"><KeyRound className="size-3"/>{item.has_private_key ? 'Private key stored' : 'Missing key'}</span><span className="font-mono">{item.certificate_path}</span></div></div></div><div className="flex self-end sm:self-auto"><Button variant="ghost" size="icon-sm" title="Renewal history" onClick={() => onHistory(item)}><Clock3/></Button><Button variant="ghost" size="icon-sm" title="Edit certificate" onClick={() => onEdit(item)}><Pencil/></Button><Button variant="ghost" size="icon-sm" title="Delete certificate" className="hover:text-destructive" onClick={() => onDelete(item)}><Trash2/></Button></div></div>;})}</div>;
    }

    import {createFileRoute} from '@tanstack/react-router';
    import {Plus, ShieldAlert, ShieldCheck} from 'lucide-react';
    import {useCallback, useEffect, useState} from 'react';
    import {toast} from 'sonner';
    import {Button} from '#/components/ui/button';
    import {CertificateDialog} from '#/components/settings/certificates/certificate-dialog';
    import {CertificateHistoryDialog} from '#/components/settings/certificates/certificate-history-dialog';
    import {CertificateList} from '#/components/settings/certificates/certificate-list';
    import {certificateRequest} from '#/components/settings/certificates/certificate-api';
    import type {Certificate, RemoteServer} from '#/components/settings/certificates/certificate-types';
    
    export const Route = createFileRoute('/_app/settings/certificates')({
    	component: CertificatesPage,
    });
    
    function CertificatesPage() {
    	const [items, setItems] = useState<Certificate[]>([]);
    	const [servers, setServers] = useState<RemoteServer[]>([]);
    	const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
    	const [dialogOpen, setDialogOpen] = useState(false);
    	const [historyOpen, setHistoryOpen] = useState(false);
    	const [selected, setSelected] = useState<Certificate | null>(null);
    
    	const load = useCallback(async () => {
    		try {
    			setLoading(true);
    			const [certificates, remoteServers] = await Promise.all([
    				certificateRequest<Certificate[]>('/certificates'),
    				certificateRequest<RemoteServer[]>('/remote-servers'),
    			]);
    			setItems(certificates || []);
    			setServers(remoteServers || []);
    		} catch (error) {
    			toast.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Could not load certificates');
    		} finally {
    			setLoading(false);
    		}
    	}, []);
    
    	useEffect(() => {
    		void load();
    	}, [load]);
    
    	const create = () => {
    		setSelected(null);
    		setDialogOpen(true);
    	};
    
    	const edit = (certificate: Certificate) => {
    		setSelected(certificate);
    		setDialogOpen(true);
    	};
    
    	const history = (certificate: Certificate) => {
    		setSelected(certificate);
    		setHistoryOpen(true);
    	};
    
    	const remove = async (certificate: Certificate) => {
    		if (!confirm(`Delete certificate "${certificate.name}"?`)) return;
    		try {
    			await certificateRequest(`/certificates/${certificate.id}`, {method: 'DELETE'});
    			toast.success('Certificate deleted');
    			await load();
    		} catch (error) {
    			toast.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Certificate could not be deleted');
    		}
    	};
    
    	return (
    		<div className="mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl animate-in flex-col gap-6 p-6 duration-200 fade-in">
    			<div className="flex flex-col justify-between gap-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
    				<div>
    					<h1 className="flex items-center gap-2 text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight">
    						<ShieldCheck className="size-6 text-emerald-500" />
    						SSL / TLS Certificates
    					</h1>
    					<p className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
    						Install custom PEM certificates on local or remote Traefik servers.
    					</p>
    				</div>
    				<Button onClick={create} className="gap-1.5"><Plus className="size-4" />Install certificate</Button>
    			</div>
    
    			<div className="flex gap-3 rounded-lg border border-amber-500/20 bg-amber-500/5 px-4 py-3">
    				<ShieldAlert className="mt-0.5 size-4 shrink-0 text-amber-500" />
    				<p className="text-xs leading-5 text-muted-foreground">
    					Openoxide validates that the certificate and private key match before writing them to Traefik. Invalid TLS files can interrupt HTTPS routing.
    				</p>
    			</div>
    
    			<CertificateList
    				items={items}
    				servers={servers}
    				loading={loading}
    				onCreate={create}
    				onEdit={edit}
    				onHistory={history}
    				onDelete={remove}
    			/>
    
    			<CertificateDialog
    				certificate={selected}
    				servers={servers}
    				open={dialogOpen}
    				onOpenChange={setDialogOpen}
    				onSaved={load}
    			/>
    			<CertificateHistoryDialog
    				certificate={selected}
    				open={historyOpen}
    				onOpenChange={setHistoryOpen}
    				onRenewed={load}
    			/>
    		</div>
    	);
    }

    import {KeyRound} from 'lucide-react';
    import {Input} from '#/components/ui/input';
    import {Switch} from '#/components/ui/switch';
    import {Textarea} from '#/components/ui/textarea';
    import type {
    	CertificateForm,
    	RemoteServer,
    } from './certificate-types';
    
    type Props = {
    	editing: boolean;
    	form: CertificateForm;
    	servers: RemoteServer[];
    	onChange: <K extends keyof CertificateForm>(
    		key: K,
    		value: CertificateForm[K],
    	) => void;
    };
    
    const slug = (value: string) =>
    	value
    		.toLowerCase()
    		.trim()
    		.replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')
    		.replace(/^-|-$/g, '');
    
    export function CertificateFormFields({
    	editing,
    	form,
    	servers,
    	onChange,
    }: Props) {
    	return (
    		<div className="grid gap-4">
    			<div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
    				<div className="space-y-1.5">
    					<label className="text-xs font-medium">Name</label>
    					<Input
    						value={form.name}
    						onChange={event => {
    							onChange('name', event.target.value);
    							if (!editing)
    								onChange('certificate_path', slug(event.target.value));
    						}}
    						placeholder="Production wildcard"
    					/>
    				</div>
    				<div className="space-y-1.5">
    					<label className="text-xs font-medium">Directory</label>
    					<Input
    						value={form.certificate_path}
    						onChange={event =>
    							onChange('certificate_path', slug(event.target.value))
    						}
    						placeholder="production-wildcard"
    						disabled={editing}
    					/>
    				</div>
    			</div>
    
    			<div className="space-y-1.5">
    				<label className="text-xs font-medium">Target server</label>
    				<select
    					className="h-9 w-full rounded-md border bg-background px-3 text-sm"
    					value={form.server_id}
    					onChange={event => onChange('server_id', event.target.value)}
    					disabled={editing}>
    					<option value="local">Openoxide (local)</option>
    					{servers
    						.filter(server => server.server_type !== 'BUILD')
    						.map(server => (
    							<option key={server.id} value={String(server.id)}>
    								{server.name} ({server.ip_address})
    							</option>
    						))}
    				</select>
    			</div>
    
    			<div className="space-y-1.5">
    				<label className="text-xs font-medium">Certificate chain</label>
    				<Textarea
    					className="min-h-40 resize-y font-mono text-xs"
    					value={form.certificate_data}
    					onChange={event =>
    						onChange('certificate_data', event.target.value)
    					}
    					placeholder="-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----"
    				/>
    			</div>
    
    			<div className="space-y-1.5">
    				<label className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-medium">
    					<KeyRound className="size-3.5" />
    					Private key
    				</label>
    				<Textarea
    					className="min-h-40 resize-y font-mono text-xs"
    					value={form.private_key}
    					onChange={event => onChange('private_key', event.target.value)}
    					placeholder={
    						editing
    							? 'Leave blank to keep the current private key'
    							: '-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----'
    					}
    				/>
    			</div>
    
    			<div className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-md border px-3 py-2.5">
    				<div>
    					<p className="text-xs font-medium">Track manual renewals</p>
    					<p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
    						Store replacement history for this certificate.
    					</p>
    				</div>
    				<Switch
    					checked={form.auto_renew}
    					onCheckedChange={checked => onChange('auto_renew', checked)}
    				/>
    			</div>
    		</div>
    	);
    }

    use crate::{
        api::dto::traefik::TraefikWriteFileDto,
        db::models::certificates::Certificate,
        services::traefik::TraefikService,
        utils::{
            exec::{CommandExecutor, LocalExecutor},
            os::OsCli,
        },
    };
    
    pub(super) async fn certificate_expiry(certificate: &str) -> Result<i64, String> {
        let executor = CommandExecutor::Local(LocalExecutor::new());
        OsCli::new(&executor)
            .crypto()
            .certificate(certificate)
            .expiry()
            .run()
            .await
            .map_err(|error| error.to_string())
    }
    
    pub(super) async fn validate_certificate_pair(
        certificate: &str,
        private_key: &str,
    ) -> Result<i64, String> {
        let executor = CommandExecutor::Local(LocalExecutor::new());
        OsCli::new(&executor)
            .crypto()
            .certificate(certificate)
            .validate_with_key(private_key)
            .run()
            .await
            .map(|result| result.expires_at)
            .map_err(|error| error.to_string())
    }
    
    pub(super) async fn write(certificate: &Certificate) -> Result<(), String> {
        validate_path(&certificate.certificate_path)?;
    
        let directory = format!(
            "dynamic/certificates/{}",
            certificate.certificate_path
        );
        let cert_path = format!("{directory}/chain.crt");
        let key_path = format!("{directory}/privkey.key");
        let config_path = format!("{directory}/certificate.yml");
        let config = format!(
            "tls:\n  certificates:\n    - certFile: /etc/openoxide/traefik/{cert_path}\n      keyFile: /etc/openoxide/traefik/{key_path}\n"
        );
    
        let traefik = resolve_traefik().await?;
        for (path, content) in [
            (cert_path, certificate.certificate_data.clone()),
            (key_path, certificate.private_key.clone()),
            (config_path, config),
        ] {
            traefik
                .write_file(TraefikWriteFileDto {
                    server_id: certificate.server_id,
                    path,
                    content,
                })
                .await?;
        }
        Ok(())
    }
    
    pub(super) async fn delete(certificate: &Certificate) -> Result<(), String> {
        validate_path(&certificate.certificate_path)?;
        resolve_traefik()
            .await?
            .delete_directory(
                certificate.server_id,
                &format!(
                    "dynamic/certificates/{}",
                    certificate.certificate_path
                ),
            )
            .await
    }
    
    fn validate_path(path: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
        if path.trim().is_empty()
            || path.contains("..")
            || path.contains('/')
            || path.contains('\\')
        {
            return Err("certificate path must be a simple directory name".into());
        }
        Ok(())
    }
    
    async fn resolve_traefik() -> Result<std::sync::Arc<TraefikService>, String> {
        auto_di::resolve::<TraefikService>()
            .await
            .map_err(|error| error.to_string())
    }

## User

bun run openapits wala jo genreate arkrata usi ko use karte ho na tyepsafe ke liye

## Assistant

Haan, isko confirm karne ke liye package scripts aur generated API type imports check kar raha hoon. Main dekhunga `openapits` exactly kya generate karta hai, kaunsi file consume hoti hai, aur live-generated hooks usse alag pipeline hain ya same.

## Assistant

Haan, type-safe API ke liye wahi generated OpenAPI types use ho rahe hain.

`web/openoxide_react/package.json` mein script hai:

```json
"gen:api": "openapi-typescript http://das.tail25b5a0.ts.net:4000/openapi.json -o src/types/api.d.ts"
```

Generated file:

```text
web/openoxide_react/src/types/api.d.ts
```

Use yahan hoti hai:

- `src/api/client.ts` mein `paths`
- `src/api/query.ts` ke `$api` React Query wrapper mein
- Components/stores mein `components['schemas']`
- `$api.useQuery()` aur `$api.useMutation()` ke endpoint/body/response types mein

Realtime ke liye alag generated file hai:

```text
web/openoxide_react/src/openoxide-live.generated.d.ts
```

Uska script:

```json
"gen:live": "node ../../crates/auto/vite/src/generate.js . ../../Cargo.toml src/openoxide-live.generated.d.ts openoxide-live-manifest"
```

So architecture split hai:

- REST/API type safety: `bun run gen:api`
- Live socket hook type safety: `bun run gen:live`
- Zustand sirf live hook se received data ko app-wide state mein distribute karta hai

DNS, Vault, AI aur Certificate backend endpoint definitions dono generated pipelines mein available hain.

Agar strict same architecture chahiye, to AI aur Certificate ke create/update/delete/list calls bhi `$api` par migrate karne padenge.

    import {client} from '#/api/client';
    
    type AiRequest =
      | {path: '/api/ai/settings'; method: 'GET'}
      | {path: '/api/ai/settings/{id}'; method: 'DELETE'; id: number}
      | {path: '/api/ai/settings'; method: 'POST'; body: {name: string; api_url: string; api_key: string; model: string; is_enabled: boolean}}
      | {path: '/api/ai/settings/{id}'; method: 'PUT'; id: number; body: {name?: string; api_url?: string; api_key?: string; model?: string; is_enabled?: boolean}};
    
    function ensure<T>(result: {data?: T; error?: unknown}) {
      if (result.error) throw new Error(String(result.error));
      return result.data as T;
    }
    
    export async function listAiSettings() {
      return ensure(await client.GET('/api/ai/settings'));
    }
    
    export async function createAiSetting(body: AiRequest & {method: 'POST'}) {
      return ensure(await client.POST('/api/ai/settings', {body: body.body}));
    }
    
    export async function updateAiSetting(id: number, body: AiRequest & {method: 'PUT'}) {
      return ensure(await client.PUT('/api/ai/settings/{id}', {params: {path: {id}}, body: body.body}));
    }
    
    export async function deleteAiSetting(id: number) {
      return ensure(await client.DELETE('/api/ai/settings/{id}', {params: {path: {id}}}));
    }
    
    export async function discoverAiModels(body: {api_url: string; api_key: string}) {
      return ensure(await client.POST('/api/ai/models/discover', {body}));
    }
    
    export async function discoverSettingModels(id: number) {
      return ensure(await client.GET('/api/ai/settings/{id}/models', {params: {path: {id}}}));
    }
    
    export async function testAiConnection(body: {api_url: string; api_key: string; model: string}) {
      return ensure(await client.POST('/api/ai/connection/test', {body}));
    }
    
    export async function testAiSetting(id: number) {
      return ensure(await client.POST('/api/ai/settings/{id}/test', {params: {path: {id}}}));
    }

    use std::{collections::VecDeque, sync::atomic::{AtomicI64, Ordering}};
    
    use chrono::{DateTime, Duration, Utc};
    use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
    use tokio::sync::RwLock;
    
    use crate::error::MonitorError;
    
    const SESSION_WINDOW_MINUTES: i64 = 5;
    
    #[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
    pub struct ServerMetric {
        pub id: Option<i64>,
        pub timestamp: String,
        pub cpu: f64,
        pub cpu_model: String,
        pub cpu_cores: i32,
        pub cpu_physical_cores: i32,
        pub cpu_speed: f64,
        pub os: String,
        pub distro: String,
        pub kernel: String,
        pub arch: String,
        pub mem_used: f64,
        pub mem_used_gb: f64,
        pub mem_total: f64,
        pub uptime: u64,
        pub disk_used: f64,
        pub total_disk: f64,
        pub network_in: f64,
        pub network_out: f64,
    }
    
    #[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
    pub struct ContainerMetricRow {
        pub id: Option<i64>,
        pub timestamp: String,
        pub container_id: String,
        pub name: String,
        pub cpu_perc: f64,
        pub mem_perc: f64,
        pub mem_used_mb: f64,
        pub mem_total_mb: f64,
        pub net_in_mb: f64,
        pub net_out_mb: f64,
        pub block_read_mb: f64,
        pub block_write_mb: f64,
        #[serde(default)]
        pub application_id: Option<i64>,
        #[serde(default)]
        pub compose_id: Option<i64>,
    }
    
    pub struct Store {
        server_metrics: RwLock<VecDeque<ServerMetric>>,
        container_metrics: RwLock<VecDeque<ContainerMetricRow>>,
        sequence: AtomicI64,
    }
    
    impl Store {
        pub async fn init(_database_url: &str) -> Result<Self, MonitorError> {
            tracing::info!(
                session_minutes = SESSION_WINDOW_MINUTES,
                "in-memory metric session initialized"
            );
            Ok(Self::new())
        }
    
        pub fn new() -> Self {
            Self {
                server_metrics: RwLock::new(VecDeque::new()),
                container_metrics: RwLock::new(VecDeque::new()),
                sequence: AtomicI64::new(1),
            }
        }
    
        pub async fn save_server_metric(&self, metric: &ServerMetric) -> Result<(), MonitorError> {
            let mut metric = metric.clone();
            metric.id = Some(self.next_id());
            let mut rows = self.server_metrics.write().await;
            rows.push_back(metric);
            prune(&mut rows, |row| &row.timestamp);
            Ok(())
        }
    
        pub async fn get_last_n_server_metrics(
            &self,
            limit: i64,
        ) -> Result<Vec<ServerMetric>, MonitorError> {
            let mut rows = self.server_metrics.write().await;
            prune(&mut rows, |row| &row.timestamp);
            Ok(rows.iter().rev().take(limit.max(0) as usize).cloned().collect())
        }
    
        #[allow(dead_code)]
        pub async fn save_container_metric(
            &self,
            metric: &ContainerMetricRow,
        ) -> Result<(), MonitorError> {
            self.save_container_metrics_batch(std::slice::from_ref(metric)).await
        }
    
        pub async fn save_container_metrics_batch(
            &self,
            metrics: &[ContainerMetricRow],
        ) -> Result<(), MonitorError> {
            let mut rows = self.container_metrics.write().await;
            for metric in metrics {
                let mut metric = metric.clone();
                metric.id = Some(self.next_id());
                rows.push_back(metric);
            }
            prune(&mut rows, |row| &row.timestamp);
            Ok(())
        }
    
        pub async fn get_last_n_container_metrics(
            &self,
            app_name: &str,
            limit: i64,
        ) -> Result<Vec<ContainerMetricRow>, MonitorError> {
            let mut rows = self.container_metrics.write().await;
            prune(&mut rows, |row| &row.timestamp);
            Ok(rows
                .iter()
                .rev()
                .filter(|row| row.name.contains(app_name))
                .take(limit.max(0) as usize)
                .cloned()
                .collect())
        }
    
        pub async fn cleanup_old_metrics(&self, _retention_days: i64) -> Result<u64, MonitorError> {
            let mut server = self.server_metrics.write().await;
            let mut containers = self.container_metrics.write().await;
            let before = server.len() + containers.len();
            prune(&mut server, |row| &row.timestamp);
            prune(&mut containers, |row| &row.timestamp);
            Ok((before - server.len() - containers.len()) as u64)
        }
    
        fn next_id(&self) -> i64 {
            self.sequence.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed)
        }
    }
    
    fn prune<T>(rows: &mut VecDeque<T>, timestamp: impl Fn(&T) -> &str) {
        let cutoff = Utc::now() - Duration::minutes(SESSION_WINDOW_MINUTES);
        while rows.front().is_some_and(|row| is_older(timestamp(row), cutoff)) {
            rows.pop_front();
        }
    }
    
    fn is_older(raw: &str, cutoff: DateTime<Utc>) -> bool {
        DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(raw)
            .map(|value| value.with_timezone(&Utc) < cutoff)
            .unwrap_or(true)
    }
    
    #[cfg(test)]
    mod tests {
        use super::*;
    
        #[tokio::test]
        async fn old_rows_are_removed_from_the_session() {
            let store = Store::new();
            let old = ServerMetric {
                id: None,
                timestamp: (Utc::now() - Duration::minutes(6)).to_rfc3339(),
                cpu: 0.0,
                cpu_model: String::new(),
                cpu_cores: 0,
                cpu_physical_cores: 0,
                cpu_speed: 0.0,
                os: String::new(),
                distro: String::new(),
                kernel: String::new(),
                arch: String::new(),
                mem_used: 0.0,
                mem_used_gb: 0.0,
                mem_total: 0.0,
                uptime: 0,
                disk_used: 0.0,
                total_disk: 0.0,
                network_in: 0.0,
                network_out: 0.0,
            };
            store.save_server_metric(&old).await.unwrap();
            assert!(store.get_last_n_server_metrics(10).await.unwrap().is_empty());
        }
    }

    use sqlx::{Row, SqlitePool};
    
    use super::monitoring_service::{MonitoringService, proto::ContainerStatePoint};
    
    const RUNTIME_STATUSES: &[&str] = &[
        "RUNNING",
        "HEALTHY",
        "OFFLINE",
        "RESTARTING",
        "DEGRADED",
        "CRASHED",
        "ERROR",
    ];
    
    pub struct MonitoringReconciler {
        pool: Arc<SqlitePool>,
        monitoring: Arc<MonitoringService>,
    }
    
    #[singleton]
    impl MonitoringReconciler {
        fn new(pool: Arc<SqlitePool>, monitoring: Arc<MonitoringService>) -> Self {
            Self { pool, monitoring }
        }
    
        pub async fn reconcile(&self) -> Result<(), String> {
            let servers = sqlx::query("SELECT id, server_status FROM servers")
                .fetch_all(self.pool.as_ref())
                .await
                .map_err(|error| error.to_string())?;
    
            for server in servers {
                let server_id: i64 = server.get("id");
                match self.monitoring.container_states(server_id).await {
                    Ok(states) => {
                        self.update_server(server_id, "ONLINE").await?;
                        self.reconcile_server_resources(server_id, &states).await?;
                    }
                    Err(error) => {
                        tracing::debug!(server_id, %error, "monitoring agent is offline");
                        self.update_server(server_id, "OFFLINE").await?;
                        self.mark_server_resources_offline(server_id).await?;
                    }
                }
            }
            Ok(())
        }
    
        async fn update_server(&self, id: i64, status: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
            sqlx::query("UPDATE servers SET server_status=? WHERE id=? AND server_status!=?")
                .bind(status)
                .bind(id)
                .bind(status)
                .execute(self.pool.as_ref())
                .await
                .map_err(|error| error.to_string())?;
            Ok(())
        }
    
        async fn mark_server_resources_offline(&self, server_id: i64) -> Result<(), String> {
            self.update_table_by_server("applications", "app_status", server_id, "OFFLINE")
                .await?;
            self.update_table_by_server("compose_projects", "compose_status", server_id, "OFFLINE")
                .await?;
            for table in database_tables() {
                self.update_table_by_server(table, "app_status", server_id, "OFFLINE")
                    .await?;
            }
            Ok(())
        }
    
        async fn reconcile_server_resources(
            &self,
            server_id: i64,
            states: &[ContainerStatePoint],
        ) -> Result<(), String> {
            self.reconcile_named_table(
                "applications",
                "app_status",
                server_id,
                states,
                ResourceKind::Application,
            )
            .await?;
            self.reconcile_named_table(
                "compose_projects",
                "compose_status",
                server_id,
                states,
                ResourceKind::Compose,
            )
            .await?;
            for table in database_tables() {
                self.reconcile_named_table(
                    table,
                    "app_status",
                    server_id,
                    states,
                    ResourceKind::Database,
                )
                .await?;
            }
            Ok(())
        }
    
        async fn reconcile_named_table(
            &self,
            table: &str,
            status_column: &str,
            server_id: i64,
            states: &[ContainerStatePoint],
            kind: ResourceKind,
        ) -> Result<(), String> {
            let query = format!(
                "SELECT id, app_name, {status_column} AS current_status FROM {table} WHERE server_id=?"
            );
            let rows = sqlx::query(sqlx::AssertSqlSafe(query))
                .bind(server_id)
                .fetch_all(self.pool.as_ref())
                .await
                .map_err(|error| error.to_string())?;
    
            for row in rows {
                let id: i64 = row.get("id");
                let app_name: String = row.get("app_name");
                let current: String = row.get("current_status");
                if !RUNTIME_STATUSES.contains(&current.as_str()) {
                    continue;
                }
                let matching: Vec<&ContainerStatePoint> = states
                    .iter()
                    .filter(|state| matches_resource(state, kind, id, &app_name))
                    .collect();
                let Some(status) = aggregate_status(&matching, kind) else {
                    continue;
                };
                let update = format!(
                    "UPDATE {table} SET {status_column}=? WHERE id=? AND {status_column}!=?"
                );
                sqlx::query(sqlx::AssertSqlSafe(update))
                    .bind(status)
                    .bind(id)
                    .bind(status)
                    .execute(self.pool.as_ref())
                    .await
                    .map_err(|error| error.to_string())?;
            }
            Ok(())
        }
    
        async fn update_table_by_server(
            &self,
            table: &str,
            status_column: &str,
            server_id: i64,
            status: &str,
        ) -> Result<(), String> {
            let query = format!(
                "UPDATE {table} SET {status_column}=? WHERE server_id=? AND {status_column} IN ('RUNNING','HEALTHY','RESTARTING','DEGRADED','CRASHED','ERROR')"
            );
            sqlx::query(sqlx::AssertSqlSafe(query))
                .bind(status)
                .bind(server_id)
                .execute(self.pool.as_ref())
                .await
                .map_err(|error| error.to_string())?;
            Ok(())
        }
    }
    
    #[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
    enum ResourceKind {
        Application,
        Compose,
        Database,
    }
    
    fn matches_resource(
        state: &ContainerStatePoint,
        kind: ResourceKind,
        id: i64,
        app_name: &str,
    ) -> bool {
        match kind {
            ResourceKind::Application => {
                state.application_id == id || state.name.contains(app_name)
            }
            ResourceKind::Compose => {
                state.compose_id == id
                    || state.compose_project == app_name
                    || state.name.contains(app_name)
            }
            ResourceKind::Database => state.name.contains(app_name),
        }
    }
    
    fn aggregate_status(
        states: &[&ContainerStatePoint],
        kind: ResourceKind,
    ) -> Option<&'static str> {
        if states.is_empty() {
            return None;
        }
        let counts = states.iter().fold(HashMap::new(), |mut counts, state| {
            *counts.entry(state.state.as_str()).or_insert(0usize) += 1;
            counts
        });
        if counts.contains_key("restarting") {
            return Some("RESTARTING");
        }
        let running = counts.get("running").copied().unwrap_or_default();
        if running == states.len() {
            return Some("RUNNING");
        }
        if kind == ResourceKind::Compose && running > 0 {
            return Some("DEGRADED");
        }
        Some("CRASHED")
    }
    
    fn database_tables() -> &'static [&'static str] {
        &[
            "postgres_dbs",
            "mysql_dbs",
            "mariadb_dbs",
            "mongo_dbs",
            "redis_dbs",
            "libsql_dbs",
        ]
    }

    use std::sync::Arc;
    
    use crate::services::monitoring::reconciler::MonitoringReconciler;
    
    pub fn start(service: Arc<MonitoringReconciler>) {
        tokio::spawn(async move {
            let mut ticker = tokio::time::interval(std::time::Duration::from_secs(10));
            ticker.set_missed_tick_behavior(tokio::time::MissedTickBehavior::Skip);
            loop {
                ticker.tick().await;
                if let Err(error) = service.reconcile().await {
                    tracing::warn!(%error, "monitoring status reconciliation failed");
                }
            }
        });
    }

    use std::time::Duration;
    
    use serde::Serialize;
    use tokio_util::sync::CancellationToken;
    use tracing::{debug, info, warn};
    
    use crate::{context::MonitorContext, docker::types::ContainerSummary};
    
    const HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL: Duration = Duration::from_secs(15);
    
    #[derive(Serialize)]
    struct LifecyclePayload {
        containers: Vec<ContainerState>,
    }
    
    #[derive(Clone, Serialize)]
    struct ContainerState {
        container_id: String,
        name: String,
        state: String,
        status: String,
        application_id: Option<i64>,
        compose_id: Option<i64>,
        compose_project: Option<String>,
        compose_service: Option<String>,
    }
    
    pub async fn publish_container_lifecycle(ctx: MonitorContext, shutdown: CancellationToken) {
        let client = reqwest::Client::new();
        let mut ticker = tokio::time::interval(Duration::from_secs(ctx.config.refresh_rate.min(5)));
        ticker.set_missed_tick_behavior(tokio::time::MissedTickBehavior::Skip);
        let mut previous = String::new();
        let mut last_push = std::time::Instant::now() - HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL;
    
        info!("container lifecycle publisher started");
        loop {
            tokio::select! {
                _ = shutdown.cancelled() => return,
                _ = ticker.tick() => {
                    let summaries = match ctx.docker.get_json::<Vec<ContainerSummary>>("/containers/json?all=true").await {
                        Ok(summaries) => summaries,
                        Err(error) => {
                            warn!(%error, "could not read container lifecycle state");
                            continue;
                        }
                    };
                    let mut containers: Vec<_> = summaries.into_iter().map(container_state).collect();
                    containers.sort_by(|a, b| a.container_id.cmp(&b.container_id));
                    let fingerprint = serde_json::to_string(&containers).unwrap_or_default();
                    if fingerprint == previous && last_push.elapsed() < HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL {
                        continue;
                    }
    
                    let url = format!(
                        "{}/api/monitoring/agents/{}/lifecycle",
                        ctx.config.panel_url.trim_end_matches('/'),
                        ctx.config.server_id
                    );
                    match client
                        .post(url)
                        .header("x-metrics-token", &ctx.config.metrics_token)
                        .json(&LifecyclePayload { containers })
                        .send()
                        .await
                    {
                        Ok(response) if response.status().is_success() => {
                            previous = fingerprint;
                            last_push = std::time::Instant::now();
                        }
                        Ok(response) => warn!(status = %response.status(), "panel rejected lifecycle update"),
                        Err(error) => debug!(%error, "panel lifecycle push failed"),
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    fn container_state(summary: ContainerSummary) -> ContainerState {
        ContainerState {
            container_id: summary.id.as_str().to_owned(),
            name: summary.display_name().as_str().to_owned(),
            state: summary.state,
            status: summary.status,
            application_id: label_id(&summary.labels, "com.openoxide.application-id"),
            compose_id: label_id(&summary.labels, "com.openoxide.compose-id"),
            compose_project: summary.labels.get("com.docker.compose.project").cloned(),
            compose_service: summary.labels.get("com.docker.compose.service").cloned(),
        }
    }
    
    fn label_id(labels: &std::collections::HashMap<String, String>, key: &str) -> Option<i64> {
        labels.get(key).and_then(|value| value.parse().ok())
    }

Persistent gRPC lifecycle stream bana hai:

- Panel agent ke saath ek long-lived bidirectional gRPC channel open karta hai.
- Agent apne Docker state snapshots isi connection par push karta hai.
- Panel channel se milne wale agent ko already known server mapping ke through identify karta hai.
- Container state change par existing main tables immediately update hoti hain.
- Agent heartbeat snapshot 15 seconds me bhejta hai.
- 30 seconds tak stream message na aaye to server `INACTIVE` aur resources `ERROR`.
- Stream disconnect hone par automatic reconnect hota hai.
- Koi 1-minute backend fetch/poll lifecycle status ke liye nahi hai.

Status flow:

- All matched containers running: main resource status `RUNNING`
- Restarting/stopped/crashed/partial compose failure: main resource status `ERROR`
- Agent stream disconnected: server `INACTIVE`, running resources `ERROR`

Validation pass:

- Backend `cargo check --offline`
- Agent `cargo test --offline`: 70 tests passed

Metrics samples agent ki in-memory 5-minute store me hi rehte hain; lifecycle status persistent gRPC push se realtime hai.

    Add: /run/media/das/SSD/Devloper/rustploy/.github/workflows/docker-publish.yml
    name: Publish Docker images
    
    on:
      push:
        branches: [master]
        tags: ['v*.*.*']
      workflow_dispatch:
    
    env:
      REGISTRY: docker.io
      IMAGE_NAMESPACE: dubeyanand
    
    jobs:
      publish:
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        permissions:
          contents: read
    
        steps:
          - name: Checkout
            uses: actions/checkout@v4
    
          - name: Set up Buildx
            uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3
    
          - name: Log in to Docker Hub
            uses: docker/login-action@v3
            with:
              registry: ${{ env.REGISTRY }}
              username: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}
              password: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_TOKEN }}
    
          - name: Docker metadata
            id: meta
            uses: docker/metadata-action@v5
            with:
              images: |
                ${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAMESPACE }}/openoxide
                ${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAMESPACE }}/openoxide-monitor
              tags: |
                type=raw,value=latest,enable={{is_default_branch}}
                type=sha,prefix=sha-
                type=ref,event=tag
    
          - name: Build and push panel
            uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
            with:
              context: .
              file: Dockerfile
              platforms: linux/amd64,linux/arm64
              push: true
              tags: ${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAMESPACE }}/openoxide:${{ steps.meta.outputs.version }}
              labels: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.labels }}
              cache-from: type=gha,scope=openoxide
              cache-to: type=gha,mode=max,scope=openoxide
    
          - name: Build and push monitoring agent
            uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
            with:
              context: .
              file: Dockerfile.monitor
              platforms: linux/amd64,linux/arm64
              push: true
              tags: ${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAMESPACE }}/openoxide-monitor:${{ steps.meta.outputs.version }}
              labels: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.labels }}
              cache-from: type=gha,scope=openoxide-monitor
              cache-to: type=gha,mode=max,scope=openoxide-monitor

    +/// Kick the one-shot lifecycle reconciliation after an explicit connection
    +/// check. The HTTP response is not held open while the agent is contacted.
    +fn trigger_monitoring_refresh(server_id: i64) {
    +    tokio::spawn(async move {
    +        let monitoring = match resolve::<
    +            crate::services::monitoring::monitoring_service::MonitoringService,
    +        >()
    +        .await
    +        {
    +            Ok(service) => service,
    +            Err(error) => {
    +                tracing::debug!(server_id, %error, "monitoring refresh service unavailable");
    +                return;
    +            }
    +        };
    +        let reconciler = match resolve::<crate::services::monitoring::reconciler::MonitoringReconciler>()
    +            .await
    +        {
    +            Ok(reconciler) => reconciler,
    +            Err(error) => {
    +                tracing::debug!(server_id, %error, "monitoring reconciler unavailable");
    +                return;
    +            }
    +        };
    +        match monitoring.container_states(server_id).await {
    +            Ok(states) => {
    +                if let Err(error) = reconciler.apply_snapshot(server_id, &states).await {
    +                    tracing::warn!(server_id, %error, "explicit monitoring refresh reconciliation failed");
    +                }
    +            }
    +            Err(error) => tracing::debug!(server_id, %error, "agent unavailable during explicit monitoring refresh"),
    +        }
    +    });
    +}

## User

har 15secon me kya hota jara batana

## Assistant

Har 15 seconds mein do alag cheezein hoti hain:

1. Agent → Panel gRPC stream heartbeat

Agent Docker event stream se connected rehta hai. Agar 15 seconds tak koi container event nahi aaya, agent current container snapshot panel ko bhejta hai. Isse connection alive verify hota hai aur panel ko latest state milti hai.

2. Panel → Agent stream timeout

Panel incoming gRPC stream message ko maximum 30 seconds wait karta hai. 30 seconds tak heartbeat/snapshot na aaye to stream disconnected maana jaata hai aur reconnect attempt hota hai.

Normal case:

```text
Docker event aaye       → immediate snapshot
No event for 15 sec     → heartbeat snapshot
No response for 30 sec  → panel reconnect
Agent unavailable       → SSH reachability check
SSH pass                → server ACTIVE
SSH fail                → server INACTIVE
```

Metrics ka 15-second heartbeat se direct relation nahi hai; CPU/memory metrics apne configured refresh interval par collect hote hain.

## Assistant

Root cause mil gaya: local ke liye fake `server_id=5` bheja ja raha tha, lekin DB me local server row hai hi nahi. Isliye remote select karne par data aata tha, local initial state blank/stale rehti thi.

Fix:
- Local option ab `server_id=0` hai.
- Local ke liye Docker containers/stats requests me `server_id` omit hota hai, direct panel ke local Docker daemon ko use karta hai.
- Remote servers ke liye actual server ID bheji jaati hai.
- Initial load me local data automatically fetch hoga.
- `Disk Space` aur `Docker Disk Usage` sections source se remove hain.

jab user container metrics ko string karne bolta hai tab kya karte hao

## Assistant

Jab user container metrics ko **stream** karne bolta hai, backend:

1. Selected target decide karta hai:
   - Local ke liye local Docker daemon.
   - Remote ke liye selected `server_id` ka SSH/Docker executor.

2. Docker stats process start karta hai, usually continuous `docker stats` JSON stream.

3. Har stats line ko parse karke SSE event me convert karta hai:
   ```text
   data: {"type":"stats","stats":...}
   ```

4. Frontend SSE connection open rakhta hai aur har event par:
   - CPU
   - Memory
   - Block I/O
   - Network I/O
   - Container count

   update karta hai.

5. Server change hone par purana stream abort hota hai aur naye server/local target ke liye naya stream open hota hai.

Local target ke liye `server_id` nahi bhejna chahiye; request direct local Docker socket par jaani chahiye. Remote target ke liye actual server ID bhejna chahiye.

   Local Redis ka actual Docker container exist nahi karta tha, lekin DB me uska status `RUNNING` saved tha. Reconciler us row ko touch nahi kar raha tha, isliye old status dikhta raha.

5. Docker Swarm confusion
   `docker stack ls` empty tha, lekin services Docker Compose containers se manage ho rahe the. Swarm empty hona issue nahi tha.

6. Realtime invalidation chal rahi thi, mapping galat thi
   Socket events backend tak aa rahe the, lekin wrong server ID/local mapping ke कारण UI aur DB status correct resource se match nahi ho rahe the.

Ab local identity, agent registration, frontend server ID aur reconciliation mapping fix ki gayi hai.

## Assistant

Backend side se bol rahe ho to main reason ye hai ki schedule/backup create-delete synchronous database mutation hai, lekin uska actual effect background scheduler me hot-reload nahi hota.

Abhi flow roughly aisa hai:

- Record database me insert/delete hota hai.
- Cache invalidate hota hai.
- Scheduler/backup runner apni already-loaded configuration ya next polling cycle par depend karta hai.
- Isliye naya cron ya backup turant active nahi hota, aur delete ke baad purana job current in-memory scheduler me thodi der reh sakta hai.

Proper backend behavior ke liye mutation ke turant baad scheduler ko explicit command deni chahiye:

- Create/update: job registry me add/reload, next run calculate.
- Delete/disable: existing task cancel/remove.
- Backup rule change: backup scheduler reload.
- Transaction commit ke baad hi reload trigger ho, taaki scheduler half-written record na padhe.

Cache invalidation sirf read cache clear karta hai; woh running scheduler task ko automatically add/remove nahi karta. यही वजह है कि “turant add/remove” backend side par abhi guaranteed nahi hai.

## Assistant

Issue ye tha ki delete ke baad scheduler ka already-queued callback execute ho raha tha. Scheduler refresh se registered job remove hoti thi, lekin queued callback cancel nahi hota tha.

Ab fix kiya:

- Schedule/backup create, update, delete ke baad scheduler instantly refresh hota hai.
- Queued schedule callback execution se pehle DB me dobara check karta hai.
- Deleted ya disabled schedule execute nahi hoga.
- Database aur volume backup bhi external command start karne se just pehle revalidate hote hain.
- Invalid/deleted backup par command start nahi hogi.
- 30-second background refresh fallback ke roop me ab bhi rahega.

Verification pass:

- `cargo check -p openoxide --lib`
- `cargo fmt --all`
- `git diff --check`

Note: jo command deletion se pehle already start ho chuka ho, usko ye patch forcibly terminate nahi karta. Lekin delete ke baad queued/stale execution ab skip ho jayega.

## Assistant

Root cause mil gaya: delete ke baad cron callback already queue me hota tha. Scheduler refresh job remove karta tha, lekin queued callback phir bhi backup runner call kar deta tha.

Fix kiya:

- Database backup callback ke bilkul first step par DB recheck.
- Volume backup callback ke bilkul first step par DB recheck.
- Record missing/deleted ya `enabled = 0` ho to callback immediately return karega.
- `in_flight` lock aur backup slot bhi lene se pehle check hota hai.
- Existing service-level recheck bhi rahega, yani command start hone se pehle second protection.
- Regression test add kiya:
  - deleted backup skip
  - disabled backup skip
  - enabled backup allow

Verification pass:

```text

cargo check -p openoxide --lib
cargo fmt --all
git diff --check
```

Ab 1-minute backup delete karne ke baad next queued tick backup execute nahi karega. Jo backup command deletion se pehle already start ho chuka ho, woh current process complete/cancel behavior ke hisaab se finish ho sakta hai.

    import {useEffect, useState} from 'react';
    import {createPortal} from 'react-dom';
    import {Globe, RefreshCw, X} from 'lucide-react';
    import {Button} from '#/components/ui/button';
    import {Input} from '#/components/ui/input';
    import {Label} from '#/components/ui/label';
    import {Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue} from '#/components/ui/select';
    import {Switch} from '#/components/ui/switch';
    import {toast} from 'sonner';
    
    export type DomainFormData = {
    	host: string;
    	path: string;
    	internal_path: string;
    	strip_path: boolean;
    	port: number;
    	service_name?: string;
    	https: boolean;
    	certificate_type: 'LETSENCRYPT' | 'NONE' | 'CUSTOM';
    	custom_cert_resolver?: string;
    	custom_entrypoint?: string;
    	middlewares: string;
    };
    
    interface DomainDialogProps {
    	isOpen: boolean;
    	onClose: () => void;
    	editingDomain?: any | null;
    	services?: string[];
    	onSave: (data: DomainFormData) => Promise<void>;
    }
    
    export function DomainDialog({isOpen, onClose, editingDomain, services = [], onSave}: DomainDialogProps) {
    	const [host, setHost] = useState('');
    	const [path, setPath] = useState('/');
    	const [internalPath, setInternalPath] = useState('/');
    	const [port, setPort] = useState('3000');
    	const [serviceName, setServiceName] = useState('');
    	const [https, setHttps] = useState(true);
    	const [certificateType, setCertificateType] = useState<DomainFormData['certificate_type']>('LETSENCRYPT');
    	const [customResolver, setCustomResolver] = useState('');
    	const [customEntrypoint, setCustomEntrypoint] = useState('');
    	const [stripPath, setStripPath] = useState(false);
    	const [middlewares, setMiddlewares] = useState('');
    	const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
    
    	useEffect(() => {
    		if (!isOpen) return;
    		setHost(editingDomain?.host || '');
    		setPath(editingDomain?.path || '/');
    		setInternalPath(editingDomain?.internal_path || '/');
    		setPort(String(editingDomain?.port ?? 3000));
    		setServiceName(editingDomain?.service_name || services[0] || '');
    		setHttps(editingDomain?.https !== false);
    		const cert = String(editingDomain?.certificate_type || 'LETSENCRYPT').toUpperCase();
    		setCertificateType(cert === 'CUSTOM' || cert === 'NONE' ? cert : 'LETSENCRYPT');
    		setCustomResolver(editingDomain?.custom_cert_resolver || '');
    		setCustomEntrypoint(editingDomain?.custom_entrypoint || '');
    		setStripPath(Boolean(editingDomain?.strip_path));
    		try {
    			const parsed = JSON.parse(editingDomain?.middlewares || '[]');
    			setMiddlewares(Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed.join(', ') : '');
    		} catch { setMiddlewares(editingDomain?.middlewares || ''); }
    	}, [isOpen, editingDomain, services]);
    
    	if (!isOpen || typeof document === 'undefined') return null;
    
    	const submit = async (event: React.FormEvent) => {
    		event.preventDefault();
    		const normalizedPath = path.trim() || '/';
    		const normalizedInternal = internalPath.trim() || '/';
    		const numericPort = Number(port);
    		if (!host.trim()) return toast.error('Host is required');
    		if (!normalizedPath.startsWith('/') || !normalizedInternal.startsWith('/')) return toast.error('Paths must start with /');
    		if (!Number.isInteger(numericPort) || numericPort < 1 || numericPort > 65535) return toast.error('Port must be between 1 and 65535');
    		if (stripPath && normalizedPath === '/') return toast.error('Strip Path requires a non-root path');
    		if (certificateType === 'CUSTOM' && !customResolver.trim()) return toast.error('Custom certificate resolver is required');
    		if (customEntrypoint.trim() && !customEntrypoint.trim().startsWith('/')) return toast.error('Entrypoint must start with /');
    		setSaving(true);
    		try {
    			await onSave({
    				host: host.trim(), path: normalizedPath, internal_path: normalizedInternal,
    				strip_path: stripPath, port: numericPort, service_name: serviceName || undefined,
    				https, certificate_type: https ? certificateType : 'NONE',
    				custom_cert_resolver: certificateType === 'CUSTOM' ? customResolver.trim() : undefined,
    				custom_entrypoint: customEntrypoint.trim() || undefined,
    				middlewares: JSON.stringify(middlewares.split(',').map(value => value.trim()).filter(Boolean)),
    			});
    			onClose();
    		} catch (error: any) { toast.error(error?.message || 'Unable to save domain'); }
    		finally { setSaving(false); }
    	};
    
    	return createPortal(
    		<div className="fixed inset-0 z-[999999] flex items-center justify-center overflow-y-auto bg-black/60 p-4 backdrop-blur-sm">
    			<div className="my-8 w-full max-w-2xl rounded-xl border border-border bg-card shadow-2xl">
    				<div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-border bg-muted/30 p-4"><div className="flex items-center gap-2"><Globe className="size-4 text-primary" /><h3 className="text-sm font-bold">{editingDomain ? 'Edit Domain Route' : 'Add Domain Route'}</h3></div><Button variant="ghost" size="icon" onClick={onClose} className="size-7"><X className="size-4" /></Button></div>
    				<form onSubmit={submit} className="grid gap-4 p-5 sm:grid-cols-2">
    					<div className="sm:col-span-2"><Label>Host *</Label><Input className="mt-1.5 font-mono text-xs" value={host} onChange={e => setHost(e.target.value)} placeholder="app.example.com" /></div>
    					{services.length > 0 && <div><Label>Compose service *</Label><Select value={serviceName} onValueChange={setServiceName}><SelectTrigger className="mt-1.5 text-xs"><SelectValue placeholder="Select service" /></SelectTrigger><SelectContent>{services.map(service => <SelectItem key={service} value={service}>{service}</SelectItem>)}</SelectContent></Select></div>}
    					<div><Label>Container port *</Label><Input className="mt-1.5 font-mono text-xs" type="number" min="1" max="65535" value={port} onChange={e => setPort(e.target.value)} /></div>
    					<div><Label>Public path</Label><Input className="mt-1.5 font-mono text-xs" value={path} onChange={e => setPath(e.target.value)} placeholder="/api" /></div>
    					<div><Label>Internal path</Label><Input className="mt-1.5 font-mono text-xs" value={internalPath} onChange={e => setInternalPath(e.target.value)} placeholder="/" /></div>
    					<div className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-lg border p-3"><div><Label>HTTPS / SSL</Label><p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">Secure traffic through Traefik</p></div><Switch checked={https} onCheckedChange={setHttps} /></div>
    					{https && <div><Label>Certificate type</Label><Select value={certificateType} onValueChange={value => setCertificateType(value as DomainFormData['certificate_type'])}><SelectTrigger className="mt-1.5 text-xs"><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger><SelectContent><SelectItem value="LETSENCRYPT">Let's Encrypt (automatic)</SelectItem><SelectItem value="NONE">Built-in TLS</SelectItem><SelectItem value="CUSTOM">Custom resolver</SelectItem></SelectContent></Select></div>}
    					{https && certificateType === 'CUSTOM' && <div><Label>Custom certificate resolver *</Label><Input className="mt-1.5 font-mono text-xs" value={customResolver} onChange={e => setCustomResolver(e.target.value)} placeholder="myresolver" /></div>}
    					<div><Label>Custom entrypoint</Label><Input className="mt-1.5 font-mono text-xs" value={customEntrypoint} onChange={e => setCustomEntrypoint(e.target.value)} placeholder="websecure" /></div>
    					<div><Label>Middlewares</Label><Input className="mt-1.5 text-xs" value={middlewares} onChange={e => setMiddlewares(e.target.value)} placeholder="auth@file, rate-limit@file" /></div>
    					<div className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-lg border p-3 sm:col-span-2"><div><Label>Strip public path</Label><p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">Remove the public prefix before forwarding</p></div><Switch checked={stripPath} onCheckedChange={setStripPath} /></div>
    					<div className="flex justify-end border-t pt-4 sm:col-span-2"><Button type="submit" disabled={saving}>{saving && <RefreshCw className="mr-2 size-3.5 animate-spin" />}{editingDomain ? 'Update Domain' : 'Add Domain'}</Button></div>
    				</form>
    			</div>
    		</div>, document.body);
    }

    import {useState} from 'react';

    import {toast} from 'sonner';
    import {$api} from '#/api/query';
    import {formatApiError} from '#/api/utils';
    import {DomainDialog, type DomainFormData} from '#/components/projects/common/domain-dialog';
    import {Badge} from '#/components/ui/badge';
    import {Button} from '#/components/ui/button';
    import {Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow} from '#/components/ui/table';
    
    interface DomainsTabProps { app: any; domains?: any[]; onRefresh?: () => void; }
    
    export function DomainsTab({app, domains: passedDomains, onRefresh}: DomainsTabProps) {
    	const [dialogOpen, setDialogOpen] = useState(false);
    	const [editingDomain, setEditingDomain] = useState<any | null>(null);
    	const [deletingId, setDeletingId] = useState<number | null>(null);
    	const domains = Array.isArray(passedDomains) ? passedDomains : [];
    	const createDomain = $api.useMutation('post', '/domains');
    	const updateDomain = $api.useMutation('patch', '/domains/{id}');
    	const deleteDomain = $api.useMutation('delete', '/domains/{id}');
    
    	const openCreate = () => { setEditingDomain(null); setDialogOpen(true); };
    	const saveDomain = async (data: DomainFormData) => {
    		try {
    			if (editingDomain?.id) await updateDomain.mutateAsync({params: {path: {id: editingDomain.id}}, body: data as any});
    			else await createDomain.mutateAsync({body: {...data, application_id: app.id} as any});
    			toast.success(editingDomain ? 'Domain updated successfully' : 'Domain added successfully');
    			onRefresh?.();
    		} catch (error) { throw new Error(formatApiError(error)); }
    	};
    
    	const removeDomain = async (id: number) => {
    		setDeletingId(id);
    		try { await deleteDomain.mutateAsync({params: {path: {id}}}); toast.success('Domain deleted successfully'); onRefresh?.(); }
    		catch (error) { toast.error(formatApiError(error)); }
    		finally { setDeletingId(null); }
    	};
    
    	return <div className="flex w-full flex-col gap-6">
    		<div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4 border-b pb-4">
    			<div><h3 className="text-lg font-bold">Domains</h3><p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Configure routes, paths and TLS certificates for this application</p></div>
    			<div className="flex gap-2"><Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={onRefresh}><RefreshCw className="mr-1.5 size-3.5" />Refresh</Button><Button size="sm" onClick={openCreate}><Plus className="mr-1.5 size-3.5" />Add Domain</Button></div>
    		</div>
    		{domains.length === 0 ? <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-3 rounded-lg border border-dashed py-16 text-center"><Globe className="size-9 text-muted-foreground/40" /><div><p className="text-sm font-semibold">No custom domains</p><p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Add a route to expose this application</p></div><Button size="sm" onClick={openCreate}><Plus className="mr-1.5 size-3.5" />Add Domain</Button></div> :

Ab domain add, edit aur delete ke baad page refresh ki zarurat nahi honi chahiye. Deploy/rebuild ko same time click karne wala separate action-lock issue hai; domain realtime fix ke baad usko next isolate karna hoga.

## Assistant

Haan, ab exact requirement ye hai:

```rust
docker.container(name).start().run().await?;
```

Isme default behavior CLI hoga.

```rust
docker.container(name).start().api().run().await?;
```

Isme explicitly Docker Engine API endpoint use hoga. API method endpoint, HTTP verb, path params, query params aur JSON body internally operation se generate honge. Caller ko manually `/v1.52/...` likhne ki zarurat nahi hogi.

Remote server optimization:

1. Pehli API request par SSH connection ke through remote Docker socket ka temporary tunnel/proxy open hoga.
2. Tunnel maximum 3 minutes idle lifetime ke saath reuse hoga.
3. Agar us window me doosri Docker API requests aati hain, wahi existing socket/tunnel use hoga.
4. Har request activity timeout ko refresh karegi.
5. Jab active users/requests, streams, watchers aur pending operations sab zero ho jayenge, 3-minute idle timer start hoga.
6. 3 minutes tak koi use nahi hua to socket/tunnel close hoga.
7. New request par tunnel lazily dobara open hoga.
8. CLI operations SSH command ke through hi chalenge; unke liye socket tunnel force nahi hoga.

Important distinction:

- Default: CLI
- Explicit `.api()`: Engine API
- Remote API: reusable temporary SSH socket tunnel
- Remote CLI: existing SSH executor
- Active stream/watch operation tunnel ko alive rakhega
- Shutdown graceful hoga, active request ko interrupt nahi karega

Isse existing syntax break nahi hogi, API sirf jahan explicitly choose ki jayegi wahan use hoga, aur remote par har API call ke liye naya SSH/socket setup nahi karna padega.

    use bytes::Bytes;
    use http_body_util::{BodyExt, Empty};
    use hyper::{Request, StatusCode};
    use hyper_util::rt::TokioIo;
    use serde::de::DeserializeOwned;
    use tokio::net::UnixStream;
    
    use super::DockerError;
    
    pub const API_VERSION: &str = "v1.52";
    
    /// Minimal Docker Engine API v1.52 transport over the local Unix socket.
    /// Remote transports are supplied by the executor layer; this type deliberately
    /// contains no SSH or CLI fallback policy.
    #[derive(Clone, Debug)]
    pub struct DockerApi {
    	socket_path: String,
    }
    
    impl DockerApi {
    	pub fn new(socket_path: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
    		Self { socket_path: socket_path.into() }
    	}
    
    	pub async fn request(&self, method: &str, path: &str, body: Option<Bytes>) -> Result<Bytes, DockerError> {
    		let stream = UnixStream::connect(&self.socket_path).await.map_err(|error| DockerError::Ssh(format!("docker socket {}: {error}", self.socket_path)))?;
    		let (mut sender, connection) = hyper::client::conn::http1::handshake(TokioIo::new(stream)).await.map_err(|error| DockerError::Ssh(error.to_string()))?;
    		tokio::spawn(async move { let _ = connection.await; });
    		let uri = format!("/{API_VERSION}{path}");
    		let request = Request::builder().method(method).uri(&uri).header("Host", "docker").header("Content-Type", "application/json").body(match body { Some(bytes) => http_body_util::Full::new(bytes).boxed(), None => Empty::<Bytes>::new().boxed() }).map_err(|error| DockerError::Ssh(error.to_string()))?;
    		let response = sender.send_request(request).await.map_err(|error| DockerError::Ssh(error.to_string()))?;
    		let status = response.status();
    		let payload = response.into_body().collect().await.map_err(|error| DockerError::Ssh(error.to_string()))?.to_bytes();
    		if !status.is_success() && status != StatusCode::NO_CONTENT {
    			return Err(DockerError::Ssh(format!("Docker API {method} {uri} returned {status}: {}", String::from_utf8_lossy(&payload).trim())));
    		}
    		Ok(payload)
    	}
    
    	pub async fn get_json<T: DeserializeOwned>(&self, path: &str) -> Result<T, DockerError> {
    		let payload = self.request("GET", path, None).await?;
    		serde_json::from_slice(&payload).map_err(Into::into)
    	}
    }

    /// Minimal Docker Engine API v1.52 transport over the local Unix socket.
    /// Remote transports are supplied by the executor layer; this type deliberately
    /// contains no SSH or CLI fallback policy.
    #[derive(Clone, Debug)]
    pub struct DockerApi {
        socket_path: String,
    }
    
    impl DockerApi {
        pub fn new(socket_path: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
            Self {
                socket_path: socket_path.into(),
            }
        }
    
        pub async fn request(
            &self,
            method: &str,
            path: &str,
            body: Option<Bytes>,
        ) -> Result<Bytes, DockerError> {
            let stream = UnixStream::connect(&self.socket_path)
                .await
                .map_err(|error| {
                    DockerError::Ssh(format!("docker socket {}: {error}", self.socket_path))
                })?;
            let (mut sender, connection) = hyper::client::conn::http1::handshake(TokioIo::new(stream))
                .await
                .map_err(|error| DockerError::Ssh(error.to_string()))?;
            tokio::spawn(async move {
                let _ = connection.await;
            });
            let uri = format!("/{API_VERSION}{path}");
            let request = Request::builder()
                .method(method)
                .uri(&uri)
                .header("Host", "docker")
                .header("Content-Type", "application/json")
                .body(http_body_util::Full::new(body.unwrap_or_default()).boxed())
                .map_err(|error| DockerError::Ssh(error.to_string()))?;
            let response = sender
                .send_request(request)
                .await
                .map_err(|error| DockerError::Ssh(error.to_string()))?;
            let status = response.status();
            let payload = response
                .into_body()
                .collect()
                .await
                .map_err(|error| DockerError::Ssh(error.to_string()))?
                .to_bytes();
            if !status.is_success() && status != StatusCode::NO_CONTENT {
                return Err(DockerError::Ssh(format!(
                    "Docker API {method} {uri} returned {status}: {}",
                    String::from_utf8_lossy(&payload).trim()
                )));
            }
            Ok(payload)
        }
    
        pub async fn get_json<T: DeserializeOwned>(&self, path: &str) -> Result<T, DockerError> {
            let payload = self.request("GET", path, None).await?;
            serde_json::from_slice(&payload).map_err(Into::into)
        }
    }

        let command = args.first()?.as_str();
        let resource = args.get(1).map(String::as_str);
        match (command, resource) {
            ("container", Some("ls" | "ps")) => get("/containers/json?all=true"),
            ("image", Some("ls")) | ("images", None) => get("/images/json?all=true"),
            ("volume", Some("ls")) => get("/volumes"),
            ("network", Some("ls")) => get("/networks"),
            ("secret", Some("ls")) => get("/secrets"),
            ("config", Some("ls")) => get("/configs"),
            ("service", Some("ls")) => get("/services"),
            ("node", Some("ls" | "ps")) => get("/nodes"),
            ("system", Some("info")) | ("info", None) => get("/info"),
            ("version", None) => get("/version"),
            ("swarm", Some("inspect")) => get("/swarm"),
            ("system", Some("df")) => get("/system/df"),
            ("system", Some("events")) => get("/events"),
            ("container", Some(action @ ("start" | "stop" | "restart" | "kill" | "pause" | "unpause"))) => id_op(args, "POST", &format!("/{action}"), ResponseShape::Raw),
            ("container", Some("remove" | "rm")) => id_op(args, "DELETE", "", ResponseShape::Raw),
            ("container", Some("inspect")) => id_op(args, "GET", "/json", ResponseShape::Array),
            ("image", Some("inspect")) => id_op(args, "GET", "/json", ResponseShape::Array).map(|(m, p, s)| (m, p.replace("/containers/", "/images/"), s)),
            ("image", Some("remove" | "rm")) => id_op(args, "DELETE", "?force=true", ResponseShape::Raw).map(|(m, p, s)| (m, p.replace("/containers/", "/images/"), s)),
            ("volume", Some("inspect" | "remove" | "rm")) => id_op(args, if resource == Some("inspect") { "GET" } else { "DELETE" }, "", ResponseShape::Raw).map(|(m, p, s)| (m, p.replace("/containers/", "/volumes/"), s)),
            ("network", Some("inspect" | "remove" | "rm")) => id_op(args, if resource == Some("inspect") { "GET" } else { "DELETE" }, "", ResponseShape::Raw).map(|(m, p, s)| (m, p.replace("/containers/", "/networks/"), s)),
            ("secret", Some("inspect" | "remove" | "rm")) => id_op(args, if resource == Some("inspect") { "GET" } else { "DELETE" }, "", ResponseShape::Raw).map(|(m, p, s)| (m, p.replace("/containers/", "/secrets/"), s)),
            ("config", Some("inspect" | "remove" | "rm")) => id_op(args, if resource == Some("inspect") { "GET" } else { "DELETE" }, "", ResponseShape::Raw).map(|(m, p, s)| (m, p.replace("/containers/", "/configs/"), s)),
            ("service", Some("inspect" | "remove" | "rm")) => id_op(args, if resource == Some("inspect") { "GET" } else { "DELETE" }, "", ResponseShape::Array).map(|(m, p, s)| (m, p.replace("/containers/", "/services/"), s)),
            ("node", Some("inspect" | "remove" | "rm")) => id_op(args, if resource == Some("inspect") { "GET" } else { "DELETE" }, "", ResponseShape::Raw).map(|(m, p, s)| (m, p.replace("/containers/", "/nodes/"), s)),
            _ => None,
        }
    }
    
    fn get(path: &str) -> Option<(&'static str, String, ResponseShape)> { Some(("GET", path.into(), ResponseShape::Raw)) }
    
    fn id_op(args: &[String], method: &'static str, suffix: &str, shape: ResponseShape) -> Option<(&'static str, String, ResponseShape)> {
        Some((method, format!("/containers/{}{}", args.get(2)?, suffix), shape))
    }

    use bytes::Bytes;
    use http_body_util::BodyExt;
    use hyper::{Request, StatusCode};
    use hyper_util::rt::TokioIo;
    use serde::de::DeserializeOwned;
    use tokio::net::UnixStream;
    use super::super::DockerError;
    use super::super::api::API_VERSION;
    
    #[derive(Clone, Debug)]
    pub struct DockerApi { socket_path: String }
    
    impl DockerApi {
        pub fn new(socket_path: impl Into<String>) -> Self { Self { socket_path: socket_path.into() } }
    
        pub async fn request(&self, method: &str, path: &str, body: Option<Bytes>) -> Result<Bytes, DockerError> {
            let stream = UnixStream::connect(&self.socket_path).await.map_err(|e| DockerError::Ssh(format!("docker socket {}: {e}", self.socket_path)))?;
            let (mut sender, connection) = hyper::client::conn::http1::handshake(TokioIo::new(stream)).await.map_err(|e| DockerError::Ssh(e.to_string()))?;
            tokio::spawn(async move { let _ = connection.await; });
            let uri = format!("/{API_VERSION}{path}");
            let request = Request::builder().method(method).uri(&uri).header("Host", "docker").header("Content-Type", "application/json").body(http_body_util::Full::new(body.unwrap_or_default()).boxed()).map_err(|e| DockerError::Ssh(e.to_string()))?;
            let response = sender.send_request(request).await.map_err(|e| DockerError::Ssh(e.to_string()))?;
            let status = response.status();
            let payload = response.into_body().collect().await.map_err(|e| DockerError::Ssh(e.to_string()))?.to_bytes();
            if !status.is_success() && status != StatusCode::NO_CONTENT { return Err(DockerError::Ssh(format!("Docker API {method} {uri} returned {status}: {}", String::from_utf8_lossy(&payload).trim()))); }
            Ok(payload)
        }
    
        pub async fn get_json<T: DeserializeOwned>(&self, path: &str) -> Result<T, DockerError> { serde_json::from_slice(&self.request("GET", path, None).await?).map_err(Into::into) }
    }

    +    let mut host = serde_json::json!({"Binds": [], "PortBindings": {}, "NetworkMode": "default"});
    +    let mut i = 2;
    +    let mut image = None;

    +        let arg = args[i].as_str();
    +        let value = args.get(i + 1).map(String::as_str);
    +        match arg {
    +            "--name" => { config["name"] = serde_json::json!(value?); i += 2; }
    +            "--hostname" => { config["Hostname"] = serde_json::json!(value?); i += 2; }
    +            "--workdir" => { config["WorkingDir"] = serde_json::json!(value?); i += 2; }
    +            "--user" => { config["User"] = serde_json::json!(value?); i += 2; }
    +            "--entrypoint" => { config["Entrypoint"] = serde_json::json!(value?.split_whitespace().collect::<Vec<_>>()); i += 2; }
    +            "--env" => { config["Env"].as_array_mut()?.push(serde_json::json!(value?)); i += 2; }
    +            "--label" => { let pair = value?; let (k,v) = pair.split_once('=')?; config["Labels"][k] = serde_json::json!(v); i += 2; }
    +            "--publish" => { let port = value?; let (host_port, container_port) = port.split_once(':').unwrap_or((port, port)); host["PortBindings"][format!("{container_port}/tcp")] = serde_json::json!([{"HostPort": host_port}]); config["ExposedPorts"][format!("{container_port}/tcp")] = serde_json::json!({}); i += 2; }
    +            "--volume" | "-v" => { host["Binds"].as_array_mut()?.push(serde_json::json!(value?)); i += 2; }
    +            "--network" => { host["NetworkMode"] = serde_json::json!(value?); i += 2; }
    +            "--memory" => { host["Memory"] = serde_json::json!(value?.parse::<i64>().unwrap_or(0)); i += 2; }
    +            "--cpus" => { host["NanoCpus"] = serde_json::json!((value?.parse::<f64>().unwrap_or(0.0) * 1_000_000_000.0) as i64); i += 2; }
    +            "--privileged" => { host["Privileged"] = serde_json::json!(true); i += 1; }
    +            "--tty" | "-t" => { config["Tty"] = serde_json::json!(true); i += 1; }
    +            "--interactive" | "-i" => { config["OpenStdin"] = serde_json::json!(true); i += 1; }

    +fn parse_bytes(input: &str) -> i64 {
    +    let s = input.trim().to_ascii_lowercase();
    +    let (number, multiplier) = if let Some(v) = s.strip_suffix("gib") { (v, 1024_i64.pow(3)) }
    +        else if let Some(v) = s.strip_suffix("gb") { (v, 1_000_000_000) }
    +        else if let Some(v) = s.strip_suffix("mib") { (v, 1024_i64.pow(2)) }
    +        else if let Some(v) = s.strip_suffix("mb") { (v, 1_000_000) }
    +        else if let Some(v) = s.strip_suffix("kib") { (v, 1024) }
    +        else if let Some(v) = s.strip_suffix('g') { (v, 1024_i64.pow(3)) }
    +        else if let Some(v) = s.strip_suffix('m') { (v, 1024_i64.pow(2)) }
    +        else if let Some(v) = s.strip_suffix('k') { (v, 1024) }
    +        else { (s.as_str(), 1) };
    +    number.trim().parse::<f64>().map(|v| (v * multiplier as f64) as i64).unwrap_or(0)
    +}
    +
    +fn parse_device(value: &str) -> (&str, &str, &str) {
    +    let mut parts = value.split(':'); let src = parts.next().unwrap_or(value); let dst = parts.next().unwrap_or(src); let mode = parts.next().unwrap_or("rwm"); (src, dst, mode)
    +}
    +
    +fn restart_policy(value: &str) -> serde_json::Value {
    +    let (name, max) = value.split_once(':').map(|(n, m)| (n, m.parse::<u64>().unwrap_or(0))).unwrap_or((value, 0));
    +    serde_json::json!({"Name": name, "MaximumRetryCount": max})
    +}
    +
    +fn encode_query(value: &str) -> String {
    +    value.bytes().map(|b| match b { b'A'..=b'Z' | b'a'..=b'z' | b'0'..=b'9' | b'-' | b'_' | b'.' | b'~' => (b as char).to_string(), _ => format!("%{b:02X}") }).collect()
    +}
