    +            "--label" => { let (k,v) = args.get(i+1)?.split_once('=')?; body["Labels"][k] = serde_json::json!(v); i += 2; }
    +            "--opt" => { let (k,v) = args.get(i+1)?.split_once('=')?; body["DriverOpts"][k] = serde_json::json!(v); i += 2; }

    +            "--gateway" => { let config = body["IPAM"]["Config"].as_array_mut()?; if config.is_empty() { config.push(serde_json::json!({})); } config[0]["Gateway"] = serde_json::json!(args.get(i+1)?); i += 2; }

    +    pub async fn request_stream(
    +        &self,
    +        method: &str,
    +        path: &str,
    +        body: Option<Bytes>,
    +        sender: mpsc::Sender<crate::docker::DockerStreamEvent>,
    +    ) -> Result<u16, DockerError> {
    +        let stream = UnixStream::connect(&self.socket_path)
    +            .await
    +            .map_err(|e| DockerError::Ssh(format!("docker socket {}: {e}", self.socket_path)))?;
    +        let (mut client, connection) = hyper::client::conn::http1::handshake(TokioIo::new(stream))
    +            .await
    +            .map_err(|e| DockerError::Ssh(e.to_string()))?;
    +        tokio::spawn(async move { let _ = connection.await; });
    +        let uri = format!("/{API_VERSION}{path}");
    +        let request = Request::builder().method(method).uri(&uri).header("Host", "docker")
    +            .header("Content-Type", "application/json")
    +            .body(http_body_util::Full::new(body.unwrap_or_default()).boxed())
    +            .map_err(|e| DockerError::Ssh(e.to_string()))?;
    +        let response = client.send_request(request).await.map_err(|e| DockerError::Ssh(e.to_string()))?;
    +        let status = response.status();
    +        if !status.is_success() { return Err(DockerError::Ssh(format!("Docker API {method} {uri} returned {status}"))); }
    +        let mut body = response.into_body();
    +        while let Some(frame) = body.frame().await {
    +            let frame = frame.map_err(|e| DockerError::Ssh(e.to_string()))?;
    +            if let Ok(data) = frame.into_data() {
    +                if sender.send(crate::docker::DockerStreamEvent::Stdout(data.to_vec())).await.is_err() { break; }
    +            }
    +        }
    +        Ok(status.as_u16())
    +    }

    use crate::docker::DockerError;
    use crate::exec::RemoteExecutor;
    use crate::ssh::{SshAgentSession, SshBuilder};
    use std::sync::Arc;
    use std::time::Duration;
    use tempfile::TempPath;
    use tokio::process::Child;
    use tokio::sync::Mutex;
    
    const IDLE_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(180);
    
    #[derive(Debug)]
    struct RunningTunnel {
        child: Child,
        socket: String,
        agent: Option<SshAgentSession>,
        askpass: Option<TempPath>,
        users: usize,
        generation: u64,
    }
    
    #[derive(Clone, Debug, Default)]
    pub struct RemoteApiTunnel {
        state: Arc<Mutex<Option<RunningTunnel>>>,
    }
    
    pub struct TunnelLease {
        state: Arc<Mutex<Option<RunningTunnel>>>,
        socket: String,
        generation: u64,
    }
    
    impl TunnelLease {
        pub fn socket(&self) -> &str {
            &self.socket
        }
    }
    
    impl Drop for TunnelLease {
        fn drop(&mut self) {
            let state = self.state.clone();
            let generation = self.generation;
            tokio::spawn(async move {
                {
                    let mut guard = state.lock().await;
                    let Some(tunnel) = guard.as_mut() else { return };
                    tunnel.users = tunnel.users.saturating_sub(1);
                    if tunnel.users != 0 || tunnel.generation != generation { return; }
                }
                tokio::time::sleep(IDLE_TIMEOUT).await;
                let mut guard = state.lock().await;
                let should_close = guard.as_ref().is_some_and(|t| t.users == 0 && t.generation == generation);
                if should_close {
                    if let Some(mut tunnel) = guard.take() {
                        let _ = tunnel.child.kill().await;
                        let _ = tokio::fs::remove_file(&tunnel.socket).await;
                    }
                }
            });
        }
    }
    
    impl RemoteApiTunnel {
        pub async fn acquire(&self, remote: &RemoteExecutor) -> Result<TunnelLease, DockerError> {
            let mut guard = self.state.lock().await;
            let needs_start = match guard.as_mut() {
                Some(tunnel) => tunnel.child.try_wait().ok().flatten().is_some(),
                None => true,
            };
            if needs_start {
                *guard = Some(start_tunnel(remote).await?);
            }
            let tunnel = guard.as_mut().expect("tunnel initialized");
            tunnel.users += 1;
            tunnel.generation = tunnel.generation.wrapping_add(1);
            Ok(TunnelLease { state: self.state.clone(), socket: tunnel.socket.clone(), generation: tunnel.generation })
        }
    }
    
    async fn start_tunnel(remote: &RemoteExecutor) -> Result<RunningTunnel, DockerError> {
        let socket = format!("/tmp/openoxide-docker-api-{}.sock", uuid::Uuid::new_v4());
        let builder = SshBuilder::new(
            remote.host().to_owned(), remote.username().to_owned(),
            remote.auth().clone(), remote.host_key().clone(),
        ).port(remote.port())
            .connect_timeout(remote.connect_timeout().as_secs() as u32)
            .local_forward(format!("{socket}:/var/run/docker.sock"))
            .option("ExitOnForwardFailure", "yes")
            .option("ServerAliveInterval", "30")
            .option("ServerAliveCountMax", "3");
        let command = builder.build_command("sleep", &["2147483647".into()]).await
            .map_err(|e| DockerError::Ssh(e.to_string()))?;
        let mut process = command.command;
        process.stdin(std::process::Stdio::null()).stdout(std::process::Stdio::null()).stderr(std::process::Stdio::null());
        let child = process.spawn().map_err(|e| DockerError::Ssh(e.to_string()))?;
        for _ in 0..100 {
            if tokio::fs::metadata(&socket).await.is_ok() { break; }
            tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(25)).await;
        }
        if tokio::fs::metadata(&socket).await.is_err() {
            return Err(DockerError::Ssh(format!("SSH Docker socket tunnel to {} did not become ready", remote.host())));
        }
        Ok(RunningTunnel { child, socket, agent: command.agent_session, askpass: command.temp_askpass_file, users: 0, generation: 0 })
    }

    use super::DockerApi;
    use crate::docker::{DockerError, DockerOutput, DockerResult};
    
    pub async fn execute(api: &DockerApi, args: &[String]) -> DockerResult<DockerOutput> {
        let container = positional(args, 2)?;
        let mut command = Vec::new();
        let mut env = Vec::new();
        let mut user = None;
        let mut workdir = None;
        let mut tty = false;
        let mut detach = false;
        let mut seen_container = false;
        let mut i = 2;
        while i < args.len() {
            match args[i].as_str() {
                "-u" | "--user" => { user = args.get(i + 1).cloned(); i += 2; }
                "-w" | "--workdir" => { workdir = args.get(i + 1).cloned(); i += 2; }
                "--env" | "-e" => { env.push(required(args.get(i + 1), "exec env")?.clone()); i += 2; }
                "-t" | "--tty" => { tty = true; i += 1; }
                "-i" | "--interactive" => i += 1,
                "-d" | "--detach" => { detach = true; i += 1; }
                value if !value.starts_with('-') && !seen_container => { seen_container = true; i += 1; }
                value if !value.starts_with('-') => { command.extend(args[i..].iter().cloned()); break; }
                _ => i += 1,
            }
        }
        if command.is_empty() { return Err(api_error("container exec requires a command")); }
        let mut create = serde_json::json!({"AttachStdin": true, "AttachStdout": true, "AttachStderr": true, "Tty": tty, "Cmd": command, "Env": env});
        if let Some(value) = user { create["User"] = serde_json::json!(value); }
        if let Some(value) = workdir { create["WorkingDir"] = serde_json::json!(value); }
        let payload = api.request("POST", &format!("/containers/{container}/exec"), Some(serde_json::to_vec(&create).unwrap().into())).await?;
        let id = serde_json::from_slice::<serde_json::Value>(&payload).ok()
            .and_then(|value| value.get("Id").and_then(serde_json::Value::as_str).map(str::to_owned))
            .ok_or_else(|| api_error("Docker exec create returned no Id"))?;
        let start = serde_json::json!({"Detach": detach, "Tty": tty});
        let payload = api.request("POST", &format!("/exec/{id}/start"), Some(serde_json::to_vec(&start).unwrap().into())).await?;
        Ok(DockerOutput { status: crate::exec::ExecExitStatus::Api(200), stdout: String::from_utf8_lossy(&payload).into_owned(), stderr: String::new() })
    }
    
    fn positional(args: &[String], start: usize) -> DockerResult<String> {
        let mut i = start;
        while i < args.len() {
            match args[i].as_str() {
                "-u" | "--user" | "-w" | "--workdir" | "--env" | "-e" => i += 2,
                value if value.starts_with('-') => i += 1,
                _ => return Ok(args[i].clone()),
            }
        }
        Err(api_error("container exec requires a container id"))
    }
    
    fn required<'a>(value: Option<&'a String>, name: &str) -> DockerResult<&'a String> {
        value.ok_or_else(|| api_error(format!("missing {name}")))
    }
    
    fn api_error(message: impl Into<String>) -> DockerError {
        DockerError::Ssh(message.into())
    }

    use super::DockerApi;
    use crate::docker::{DockerError, DockerOutput, DockerResult};
    
    pub fn handles(args: &[String]) -> bool {
        matches!(
            (args.first().map(String::as_str), args.get(1).map(String::as_str)),
            (Some("service"), Some("update" | "scale" | "rollback"))
                | (Some("node"), Some("update" | "promote" | "demote"))
        )
    }
    
    pub async fn execute(api: &DockerApi, args: &[String]) -> DockerResult<DockerOutput> {
        match (args.first().map(String::as_str), args.get(1).map(String::as_str)) {
            (Some("service"), Some("update")) => service_update(api, args).await,
            (Some("service"), Some("scale")) => service_scale(api, args).await,
            (Some("service"), Some("rollback")) => service_rollback(api, args).await,
            (Some("node"), Some("update" | "promote" | "demote")) => node_update(api, args).await,
            _ => Err(error("unsupported Docker mutation")),
        }
    }
    
    async fn service_update(api: &DockerApi, args: &[String]) -> DockerResult<DockerOutput> {
        let id = positional(args, 2, &["--image", "--replicas", "--env-add", "--env-rm", "--label-add", "--label-rm", "--limit-memory", "--update-parallelism", "--update-delay"])?;
        let (version, mut spec) = inspect_spec(api, "services", &id).await?;
        for pair in args.windows(2) {
            match pair[0].as_str() {
                "--image" => spec["TaskTemplate"]["ContainerSpec"]["Image"] = serde_json::json!(pair[1]),
                "--replicas" => spec["Mode"]["Replicated"]["Replicas"] = number(&pair[1])?,
                "--env-add" => add_array(&mut spec["TaskTemplate"]["ContainerSpec"]["Env"], pair[1].clone()),
                "--env-rm" => remove_prefixed(&mut spec["TaskTemplate"]["ContainerSpec"]["Env"], &pair[1]),
                "--label-add" => set_pair(&mut spec["Labels"], &pair[1])?,
                "--label-rm" => { if let Some(map) = spec["Labels"].as_object_mut() { map.remove(&pair[1]); } }
                "--limit-memory" => spec["TaskTemplate"]["Resources"]["Limits"]["MemoryBytes"] = serde_json::json!(parse_bytes(&pair[1])),
                "--update-parallelism" => spec["UpdateConfig"]["Parallelism"] = number(&pair[1])?,
                "--update-delay" => spec["UpdateConfig"]["Delay"] = serde_json::json!(parse_duration_ns(&pair[1])),
                _ => {}
            }
        }
        if args.iter().any(|arg| arg == "--force") {
            let current = spec["TaskTemplate"]["ForceUpdate"].as_u64().unwrap_or(0);
            spec["TaskTemplate"]["ForceUpdate"] = serde_json::json!(current + 1);
        }
        update(api, "services", &id, version, spec, None).await
    }
    
    async fn service_scale(api: &DockerApi, args: &[String]) -> DockerResult<DockerOutput> {
        let mut last = None;
        for item in args.iter().skip(2).filter(|item| !item.starts_with('-')) {
            let (id, replicas) = item.split_once('=').ok_or_else(|| error("service scale expects SERVICE=REPLICAS"))?;
            let (version, mut spec) = inspect_spec(api, "services", id).await?;
            spec["Mode"]["Replicated"]["Replicas"] = number(replicas)?;
            last = Some(update(api, "services", id, version, spec, None).await?);
        }
        last.ok_or_else(|| error("service scale requires at least one service"))
    }
    
    async fn service_rollback(api: &DockerApi, args: &[String]) -> DockerResult<DockerOutput> {
        let id = args.get(2).ok_or_else(|| error("service rollback requires service"))?;
        let (version, spec) = inspect_spec(api, "services", id).await?;
        update(api, "services", id, version, spec, Some("rollback=previous")).await
    }
    
    async fn node_update(api: &DockerApi, args: &[String]) -> DockerResult<DockerOutput> {
        let action = args.get(1).ok_or_else(|| error("node action required"))?;
        let id = positional(args, 2, &["--availability", "--role", "--label-add", "--label-rm"])?;
        let (version, mut spec) = inspect_spec(api, "nodes", &id).await?;
        if action == "promote" { spec["Role"] = serde_json::json!("manager"); }
        if action == "demote" { spec["Role"] = serde_json::json!("worker"); }
        for pair in args.windows(2) {
            match pair[0].as_str() {
                "--availability" => spec["Availability"] = serde_json::json!(pair[1]),
                "--role" => spec["Role"] = serde_json::json!(pair[1]),
                "--label-add" => set_pair(&mut spec["Labels"], &pair[1])?,
                "--label-rm" => { if let Some(map) = spec["Labels"].as_object_mut() { map.remove(&pair[1]); } }
                _ => {}
            }
        }
        update(api, "nodes", &id, version, spec, None).await
    }
    
    async fn inspect_spec(api: &DockerApi, kind: &str, id: &str) -> DockerResult<(u64, serde_json::Value)> {
        let object: serde_json::Value = api.get_json(&format!("/{kind}/{id}")).await?;
        let version = object["Version"]["Index"].as_u64().ok_or_else(|| error("Docker object has no Version.Index"))?;
        let spec = object.get("Spec").cloned().ok_or_else(|| error("Docker object has no Spec"))?;
        Ok((version, spec))
    }
    
    async fn update(api: &DockerApi, kind: &str, id: &str, version: u64, spec: serde_json::Value, extra: Option<&str>) -> DockerResult<DockerOutput> {
        let suffix = extra.map(|value| format!("&{value}")).unwrap_or_default();
        let payload = api.request("POST", &format!("/{kind}/{id}/update?version={version}{suffix}"), Some(serde_json::to_vec(&spec).unwrap().into())).await?;
        Ok(output(payload))
    }
    
    fn output(payload: bytes::Bytes) -> DockerOutput {
        DockerOutput { status: crate::exec::ExecExitStatus::Api(200), stdout: String::from_utf8_lossy(&payload).into_owned(), stderr: String::new() }
    }
    
    fn positional(args: &[String], mut i: usize, valued: &[&str]) -> DockerResult<String> {
        while i < args.len() { if valued.contains(&args[i].as_str()) { i += 2; } else if args[i].starts_with('-') { i += 1; } else { return Ok(args[i].clone()); } }
        Err(error("resource identifier required"))
    }
    
    fn add_array(target: &mut serde_json::Value, value: String) { if !target.is_array() { *target = serde_json::json!([]); } target.as_array_mut().unwrap().push(serde_json::json!(value)); }
    fn remove_prefixed(target: &mut serde_json::Value, key: &str) { if let Some(values) = target.as_array_mut() { values.retain(|value| !value.as_str().is_some_and(|value| value == key || value.starts_with(&format!("{key}=")))); } }
    fn set_pair(target: &mut serde_json::Value, pair: &str) -> DockerResult<()> { let (key, value) = pair.split_once('=').ok_or_else(|| error("expected KEY=VALUE"))?; if !target.is_object() { *target = serde_json::json!({}); } target[key] = serde_json::json!(value); Ok(()) }
    fn number(value: &str) -> DockerResult<serde_json::Value> { Ok(serde_json::json!(value.parse::<u64>().map_err(|_| error("invalid number"))?)) }
    fn parse_bytes(value: &str) -> i64 { let value = value.to_ascii_lowercase(); let (n,m) = value.strip_suffix('g').map(|v|(v,1_i64<<30)).or_else(||value.strip_suffix('m').map(|v|(v,1_i64<<20))).or_else(||value.strip_suffix('k').map(|v|(v,1_i64<<10))).unwrap_or((&value,1)); n.parse::<f64>().map(|n|(n*m as f64) as i64).unwrap_or(0) }
    fn parse_duration_ns(value: &str) -> u64 { value.strip_suffix("ms").and_then(|v|v.parse().ok()).map(|v:u64|v*1_000_000).or_else(||value.strip_suffix('s').and_then(|v|v.parse().ok()).map(|v:u64|v*1_000_000_000)).unwrap_or(0) }
    fn error(message: impl Into<String>) -> DockerError { DockerError::Ssh(message.into()) }

    +
    +fn looks_multiplexed(data: &[u8]) -> bool {
    +    data.len() >= 8 && matches!(data[0], 0..=2) && data[1..4] == [0, 0, 0]
    +}
    +
    +fn multiplex_frame(data: &[u8]) -> Option<(u8, &[u8], usize)> {
    +    if !looks_multiplexed(data) { return None; }
    +    let size = u32::from_be_bytes(data[4..8].try_into().ok()?) as usize;
    +    let end = 8usize.checked_add(size)?;
    +    (data.len() >= end).then(|| (data[0], &data[8..end], end))
    +}

    use super::{DockerApi, encode_query_public};
    use crate::docker::{DockerError, DockerExitStatus, DockerResult, DockerStreamEvent};
    use tokio::sync::mpsc;
    
    pub async fn execute_stream(api: &DockerApi, args: &[String], sender: mpsc::Sender<DockerStreamEvent>) -> DockerResult<DockerExitStatus> {
        let context = args.last().ok_or_else(|| error("image build requires context"))?;
        let (path, archive) = request_parts(args, context).await?;
        let status = api.request_stream_with_type("POST", &path, Some(archive.into()), "application/x-tar", sender).await?;
        Ok(crate::exec::ExecExitStatus::Api(status))
    }
    
    async fn request_parts(args: &[String], context: &str) -> DockerResult<(String, Vec<u8>)> {
        let mut query = Vec::new();
        let mut build_args = serde_json::Map::new();
        let mut labels = serde_json::Map::new();
        for pair in args.windows(2) {
            match pair[0].as_str() {
                "--tag" | "-t" => query.push(format!("t={}", encode_query_public(&pair[1]))),
                "--file" | "-f" => query.push(format!("dockerfile={}", encode_query_public(&pair[1]))),
                "--target" => query.push(format!("target={}", encode_query_public(&pair[1]))),
                "--platform" => query.push(format!("platform={}", encode_query_public(&pair[1]))),
                "--cache-from" => query.push(format!("cachefrom={}", encode_query_public(&serde_json::json!([pair[1]]).to_string()))),
                "--build-arg" => { let (key, value) = pair[1].split_once('=').unwrap_or((&pair[1], "")); build_args.insert(key.into(), serde_json::json!(value)); }
                "--label" => { let (key, value) = pair[1].split_once('=').unwrap_or((&pair[1], "")); labels.insert(key.into(), serde_json::json!(value)); }
                _ => {}
            }
        }
        if !build_args.is_empty() { query.push(format!("buildargs={}", encode_query_public(&serde_json::Value::Object(build_args).to_string()))); }
        if !labels.is_empty() { query.push(format!("labels={}", encode_query_public(&serde_json::Value::Object(labels).to_string()))); }
        query.push(format!("nocache={}", args.iter().any(|arg| arg == "--no-cache")));
        query.push(format!("pull={}", args.iter().any(|arg| arg == "--pull")));
        query.push("forcerm=true".into());
        let archive = tokio::process::Command::new("tar").args(["-C", context, "-cf", "-", "."]).output().await?;
        if !archive.status.success() { return Err(error(format!("failed to archive build context: {}", String::from_utf8_lossy(&archive.stderr)))); }
        Ok((format!("/build?{}", query.join("&")), archive.stdout))
    }
    
    fn error(message: impl Into<String>) -> DockerError { DockerError::Ssh(message.into()) }

API shell is flow se mil raha hai:

```text
ExecBuilder::shell()
        ↓
POST /v1.52/containers/{container_id}/exec
        ↓
Docker exec ID return karta hai
        ↓
POST /v1.52/exec/{exec_id}/start
Connection: Upgrade
Upgrade: tcp
        ↓
Duplex reader/writer stream
```

Use:

```rust
let mut shell = docker
    .container("web")
    .exec()
    .interactive()
    .tty(true)
    .api()
    .shell(["/bin/sh"])
    .await?;
```

Internally pehli request roughly ye body bhejti hai:

```json
{
  "AttachStdin": true,
  "AttachStdout": true,
  "AttachStderr": true,
  "Tty": true,
  "Cmd": ["/bin/sh"]
}
```

Docker exec ID deta hai:

```json
{
  "Id": "exec-id"
}
```

Phir second request:

```http
POST /v1.52/exec/{exec-id}/start
Connection: Upgrade
Upgrade: tcp
Content-Type: application/json
```

```json
{
  "Detach": false,
  "Tty": true
}
```

Returned object me:

```rust
pub reader: OwnedReadHalf
pub writer: OwnedWriteHalf
```

Command send:

```rust
shell.writer.write_all(b"ls -la\n").await?;
```

Output read:

```rust
let mut buffer = [0; 4096];
```

## User

remote wale kase work karta

## Assistant

Remote server par flow ye hai:

```text
Application
    ↓ SSH connection
Local temporary Unix socket
    ↓ SSH local forwarding
Remote /var/run/docker.sock
    ↓
Remote Docker Engine API
```

Example:

```rust
let docker = DockerCli::new_remote(
    "192.168.1.20",
    22,
    "root",
    SshAuth::private_key(private_key),
    host_key,
);

let mut shell = docker
    .container("web")
    .exec()
    .interactive()
    .tty(true)
    .api()
    .shell(["/bin/sh"])
    .await?;
```

`api().shell()` call par:

1. OpenOxide SSH connection establish karta hai.
2. Local temporary socket banata hai:

```text
/tmp/openoxide-docker-api-<uuid>.sock
```

3. SSH Unix-socket forwarding starts:

```text
/tmp/openoxide-docker-api-<uuid>.sock
    → remote:/var/run/docker.sock
```

4. Local code temporary socket par Docker request bhejta hai:

```http
POST /v1.52/containers/web/exec
```

5. SSH request ko remote Docker socket tak forward karta hai.
6. Docker exec ID return karta hai.
7. `/exec/{id}/start` connection upgrade hota hai.
8. Returned reader/writer remote container shell ke saath connected rehte hain.

Input:

```rust
shell.writer.write_all(b"pwd\n").await?;
```

Output:

```rust
let count = shell.reader.read(&mut buffer).await?;
```

Shell active rehne tak tunnel lease active rehti hai. Shell drop hone ke baad active users zero hote hain; 3-minute idle timeout ke baad SSH tunnel aur temporary socket close ho jate hain. Nayi API request timeout se pehle aaye to existing tunnel reuse hota hai.

    +/// Returns whether a CLI command has a concrete Engine API v1.52 mapping.
    +///
    +/// This is intentionally kept beside the dispatcher so callers can reject

    +pub fn supports_command(args: &[String]) -> bool {

    +        && args.get(1).map(String::as_str) == Some("build");

    +#[macro_export]

    +                self.args.retry_limit = Some(max_retries);
    +                self
    +            }

    use crate::docker::DockerError;
    use crate::exec::RemoteExecutor;
    use crate::ssh::{RusshSession, connect_russh};
    use std::sync::Arc;
    use std::time::Duration;
    use tokio::io::copy_bidirectional;
    use tokio::net::UnixListener;
    use tokio::sync::Mutex;
    use tokio::task::JoinHandle;
    
    const IDLE_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(180);
    
    #[derive(Debug)]
    struct RunningTunnel {
        socket: String,
        session: RusshSession,
        cancel: tokio_util::sync::CancellationToken,
        task: JoinHandle<()>,
        users: usize,
        generation: u64,
    }
    
    #[derive(Clone, Debug, Default)]
    pub struct RemoteApiTunnel {
        state: Arc<Mutex<Option<RunningTunnel>>>,
    }
    
    pub struct TunnelLease {
        state: Arc<Mutex<Option<RunningTunnel>>>,
        socket: String,
        generation: u64,
    }
    
    impl TunnelLease {
        pub fn socket(&self) -> &str {
            &self.socket
        }
    }
    
    impl Drop for TunnelLease {
        fn drop(&mut self) {
            let state = self.state.clone();
            let generation = self.generation;
            tokio::spawn(async move {
                {
                    let mut guard = state.lock().await;
                    let Some(tunnel) = guard.as_mut() else { return };
                    tunnel.users = tunnel.users.saturating_sub(1);
                    if tunnel.users != 0 || tunnel.generation != generation {
                        return;
                    }
                }
                tokio::time::sleep(IDLE_TIMEOUT).await;
                let mut guard = state.lock().await;
                let should_close = guard
                    .as_ref()
                    .is_some_and(|t| t.users == 0 && t.generation == generation);
                if should_close {
                    if let Some(tunnel) = guard.take() {
                        tunnel.cancel.cancel();
                        tunnel.task.abort();
                        let _ = tokio::fs::remove_file(&tunnel.socket).await;
                    }
                }
            });
        }
    }
    
    impl RemoteApiTunnel {
        pub async fn acquire(&self, remote: &RemoteExecutor) -> Result<TunnelLease, DockerError> {
            let mut guard = self.state.lock().await;
            let needs_start = match guard.as_mut() {
                Some(tunnel) => tunnel.task.is_finished(),
                None => true,
            };
            if needs_start {
                if let Some(old) = guard.take() {
                    old.cancel.cancel();
                    old.task.abort();
                    let _ = tokio::fs::remove_file(&old.socket).await;
                }
                *guard = Some(start_tunnel(remote).await?);
            }
            let tunnel = guard.as_mut().expect("russh Docker API tunnel initialized");
            tunnel.users += 1;
            tunnel.generation = tunnel.generation.wrapping_add(1);
            Ok(TunnelLease {
                state: self.state.clone(),
                socket: tunnel.socket.clone(),
                generation: tunnel.generation,
            })
        }
    }
    
    async fn start_tunnel(remote: &RemoteExecutor) -> Result<RunningTunnel, DockerError> {
        let socket = format!("/tmp/openoxide-docker-api-{}.sock", uuid::Uuid::new_v4());
        let _ = tokio::fs::remove_file(&socket).await;
        let listener = UnixListener::bind(&socket)
            .map_err(|e| DockerError::Ssh(format!("could not bind Docker API socket: {e}")))?;
        let session = connect_russh(
            remote.host(),
            remote.port(),
            remote.username(),
            remote.auth(),
            remote.host_key(),
            remote.connect_timeout(),
        )
        .await
        .map_err(|e| DockerError::Ssh(e.to_string()))?;
        let cancel = tokio_util::sync::CancellationToken::new();
        let task_cancel = cancel.clone();
        let session_for_task = session.clone();
        let task = tokio::spawn(async move {
            loop {
                let accepted = tokio::select! {
                    _ = task_cancel.cancelled() => break,
                    result = listener.accept() => result,
                };
                let Ok((mut local, _)) = accepted else { break };
                let session = session_for_task.clone();
                let cancelled = task_cancel.clone();
                tokio::spawn(async move {
                    let Ok(mut channel) = session.channel_open_session().await else { return };
                    if channel.exec(true, "docker system dial-stdio").await.is_err() {
                        return;
                    }
                    let mut remote_stream = channel.into_stream();
                    tokio::select! {
                        _ = cancelled.cancelled() => {}
                        _ = copy_bidirectional(&mut local, &mut remote_stream) => {}
                    }
                });
            }
        });
        Ok(RunningTunnel {
            socket,
            session,
            cancel,
            task,
            users: 0,
            generation: 0,
        })
    }

## Assistant

Docker terminal ka current logic do paths me split hai.

**Localhost Docker terminal**

1. Frontend `docker:start` event bhejta hai:
   - `container`
   - `shell`
   - `server_id`
   - `cols`, `rows`

2. Backend `server_id` check karta hai:
   - `127.0.0.1`
   - `localhost`
   - `openoxide-monitor`

   In values ko local server maana jata hai.

3. Local path me container name resolve hota hai, phir:

```rust
DockerCli::new_local()
    .containers()
    .exec(container)
    .interactive()
    .tty(true)
    .api()
    .env("TERM", "xterm-256color")
    .env("OPENOXIDE_SOCKET_ID", socket_id)
    .shell([shell])
    .await
```

4. API shell internally:

   - `POST /containers/{id}/exec`
   - `POST /exec/{exec_id}/start`
   - upgraded persistent connection

5. Is connection ka:

   - reader output ko Socket.IO `stdout` event me bhejta hai
   - writer frontend ke `input` events ko container me bhejta hai
   - `exec_id` resize ke liye store hota hai

6. Resize par:

```text
POST /exec/{exec_id}/resize?h=...&w=...
```

7. Stop/disconnect par writer cancel hota hai aur `OPENOXIDE_SOCKET_ID` wale process ko cleanup kiya jata hai.

**Remote Docker terminal**

1. Remote `server_id` local server nahi hota.
2. Backend remote SSH credentials load karta hai.
3. `russh` se SSH session connect hota hai.
4. Remote par command execute hoti hai:

```bash
docker exec -it --env OPENOXIDE_SOCKET_ID=<id> <container> <shell>
```

5. `RusshTerminal` PTY open karta hai:
   - input channel se remote container ko data
   - output channel se frontend ko data
   - resize SSH PTY resize request se

6. Remote terminal `InMemorySsh` session ke roop me store hota hai.

**Important distinction**

- Local Docker terminal: Docker Engine API shell.
- Remote Docker terminal: russh SSH PTY ke through remote `docker exec`.
- Remote Docker API tunnel alag feature hai: russh + `docker system dial-stdio` local Unix socket proxy.
- Har input par naya connection nahi banta. Ek terminal session ke liye ek persistent reader/writer connection reuse hota hai.

Ab terminal start hone ka flow ye hai:

1. Frontend `docker:start` event bhejta hai:
   - `server_id`
   - container name/search text
   - shell
   - terminal size

2. Backend server identify karta hai:
   - Localhost: local `DockerCli`
   - Remote: `DockerCli::from_remote_executor(...)`

3. Container lookup Docker Engine API se hota hai:

```rust
containers().ps().all().api().list()
```

4. Search name se hota hai, lekin actual target canonical container `ID` hota hai. Isliye Compose/Swarm suffix wale names bhi correctly resolve hote hain.

5. Shell start hota hai:

```rust
docker
    .containers()
    .exec(container_id)
    .interactive()
    .tty(true)
    .api()
    .shell([shell])
    .await
```

6. Docker API internally:

```text
POST /containers/{id}/exec
POST /exec/{exec_id}/start
```

ek persistent reader/writer stream return karta hai.

7. Frontend input same writer par jata hai, output same reader se realtime aata hai.

8. Resize:

```text
POST /exec/{exec_id}/resize
```

9. Remote server me API requests reusable `russh` Docker tunnel se jati hain. Har input ya lookup ke liye naya SSH command nahi banta.

10. Terminal close/disconnect par exec session cleanup hota hai, aur unused remote API tunnel 3 minutes idle ke baad close hota hai.

## User

remote samjoo jab api bolte hai to kya hota hai

## Assistant

Remote me jab `.api()` call hota hai, flow ye hota hai:

```text
Backend
  ↓
russh authenticated SSH session
  ↓
Remote: docker system dial-stdio
  ↓
Local Unix socket proxy
  ↓
Docker Engine API request
  ↓
Remote Docker daemon
```

Example:

```rust
DockerCli::from_remote_executor(remote)
    .containers()
    .exec(container_id)
    .interactive()
    .tty(true)
    .api()
    .shell(["/bin/sh"])
```

Isme:

1. `RemoteExecutor` se `russh` connection establish hota hai.
2. Remote machine par `docker system dial-stdio` channel open hota hai.
3. Backend ek temporary local Unix socket banata hai.
4. Docker API request us local socket par jati hai.
5. Russh channel bytes ko remote Docker daemon tak forward karta hai.
6. Remote daemon `/containers/{id}/exec` aur `/exec/{id}/start` execute karta hai.
7. Same persistent exec stream terminal input/output ke liye reuse hota hai.
8. Resize bhi isi API tunnel se `/exec/{id}/resize` par hota hai.

Isliye remote me `.api()` ka matlab remote Docker daemon ko Engine API se control karna hai, remote shell me `docker exec` command chalana nahi. OpenSSH binary ki zaroorat nahi hai.

Tumhara desired architecture conceptually yehi hai:

```text
OpenOxide Backend
      │
      │ russh
      ▼
SSH channel
      │
      │ docker system dial-stdio
      ▼
remote /var/run/docker.sock
      │
      ▼
Docker daemon
```

`docker system dial-stdio` remote side par Docker CLI ka official stdio bridge hai. Ye Docker daemon ke `/var/run/docker.sock` se connect karta hai aur socket bytes SSH channel ke through backend ko deta hai.

Direct Unix socket ko russh se kholna possible nahi hota, kyunki russh TCP-forward channel provide karta hai, Unix-socket path forwarding nahi. Direct socket ke liye remote machine par `socat` jaisa helper chahiye, jo extra dependency hoga.

Isliye current implementation me:

- OpenSSH binary nahi chahiye
- har request par naya SSH connection nahi banta
- russh session reuse hota hai
- remote Docker socket Docker daemon ka actual socket hi hai
- API requests aur terminal exec isi channel se jate hain

Docker API flow:

```text
POST /containers/{id}/exec
POST /exec/{id}/start
POST /exec/{id}/resize
```

Ye remote Docker daemon par execute hote hain.

## Assistant

Root cause mil gaya: `nginx` ke labels सही हैं (`traefik.docker.network=openoxide-network`, port `80`), लेकिन running Traefik अभी `rustploy-network` पर है। इसलिए Traefik router detect कर रहा है पर nginx तक पहुँच नहीं पा रहा, जिससे 504 Gateway Timeout आ रहा है। Runtime में Traefik को `openoxide-network` से जोड़ रहा हूँ और setup code में भी यह reconciliation जोड़ूँगा।

## Assistant

Issue mil gaya tha: nginx ke labels सही थे, लेकिन Traefik सिर्फ `rustploy-network` पर connected था जबकि nginx `openoxide-network` पर था। इसलिए router match हो रहा था, पर backend तक पहुँच नहीं थी और `504 Gateway Timeout` आ रहा था।

मैंने:

- Running Traefik service को `openoxide-network` से connect किया।
- Setup code में existing Traefik container के लिए network reconciliation जोड़ दी, ताकि पुराने गलत network पर होने पर भी अगली setup/restart में ठीक हो जाए।
- `nginx.localhost` को Host header के साथ verify किया।

अब route सही response दे रहा है और nginx welcome page मिल रही है। Build भी सफल है: `cargo check -p openoxide` ✅

## User

okay me abb major changes le raha hu me ssh ke liye agent use karunga agent ko bolunga shell dene woo dedega and remote server se connect hone bolega to me ssh kar dunga jo hai abhi chaiye ki deploy to agent thora heavy hoga na agent khud hi heal ho jaya karega agar agent se connection na ban paye tabhi cronjob checking hoga etc idea kasa hai ye batoo grpc bidrectional hai to ho jayega

## Assistant

Idea सही है और bidirectional gRPC में यह architecture काम करेगा।

Flow ऐसा रखो:

- Agent backend से persistent bidirectional gRPC connection बनाए रखे।
- Agent हर deployment, health event, container state और metrics backend को push करे।
- Backend agent को deploy/restart/repair commands भेजे।
- Agent command execute करके progress और final result उसी stream पर भेजे।
- Agent connection टूटे तो agent खुद reconnect करे और exponential backoff लगाए।
- Agent काफी देर तक unavailable रहे तभी backend cron/periodic checker fallback health check चलाए।
- Agent वापस connect होते ही pending state/events reconcile करे।

SSH shell के लिए भी यही ठीक है: backend agent को shell command भेज सकता है; जिस remote server पर direct SSH जरूरी हो, वहाँ backend SSH connection बनाए। Deploy operations agent से करवाने पर backend lightweight रहेगा, लेकिन agent में timeout, cancellation, command ID, idempotency और bounded concurrency जरूरी हैं।

एक महत्वपूर्ण बात: cron को primary monitoring मत बनाना। gRPC stream primary source रहे, cron सिर्फ disconnected-agent recovery/fallback checker हो। Agent को “self-heal” करने दो, लेकिन infinite restart loop रोकने के लिए retry limit, cooldown और last failure reason maintain करना होगा।

## User

to main docker image ko to itna heavy hone ke jarurat nahi size kyo ki agent hoga na woo tools na ki isme

## Assistant

Haan, agar agent deployment, Docker operations, monitoring, healing, shell aur remote execution sab handle karega, to main OpenOxide image kaafi lightweight ho sakti hai.

Main image mein sirf ye rehna chahiye:

- API/backend
- UI serving
- Database access
- gRPC control plane
- Queue/state management
- Authentication and authorization
- Agent command dispatch
- SSH orchestration where explicitly needed

Agent image mein ye tools rahenge:

- Docker CLI/API client
- Compose/Swarm operations
- Build/pull/push tools
- Container logs, stats, exec
- Health checks and auto-healing
- Local/remote filesystem operations
- Deployment runtime dependencies

Lekin ek distinction important hai: agar local server bhi agent ke through manage karna hai, to local machine par bhi agent running hona chahiye. Backend container ko `/var/run/docker.sock`, Docker CLI, build tools aur operational binaries dene ki जरूरत नहीं रहेगी। इससे image छोटा, startup तेज और security बेहतर होगी।

Backend में केवल emergency fallback रखना चाहिए, जैसे agent unavailable होने पर limited status check या reconnect handling। Primary Docker execution हमेशा agent से हो।

## User

reconcil kar sakta hai lekin utna need nai kyo ki woo api se hi kar lega agent hi main hoga jo task karega ise sabkuch lightweight ho jayega

## Assistant

Bilkul. Agent primary execution layer hoga, aur backend sirf orchestration/control plane रहेगा।

Agent Docker Engine API से:

- deploy, start, stop, restart, rebuild
- container stats/logs/health
- volumes, networks, images
- shell/exec
- reconciliation और auto-healing

सब handle कर सकता है। Backend gRPC पर command भेजेगा और agent उसी bidirectional stream पर progress, result और events वापस भेजेगा।

इससे main OpenOxide image में Docker CLI, Compose, build tools, SSH tooling और heavy runtime dependencies रखने की जरूरत नहीं रहेगी। Backend lightweight रहेगा; heavy काम agent host पर होगा।

बस ये तीन चीजें agent layer में अनिवार्य रखनी होंगी:

- command ID और idempotency, ताकि retry पर duplicate deploy न हो
- timeout/cancellation और bounded concurrency
- reconnect के बाद state reconciliation, ताकि missed events recover हो सकें

Backend का reconcile केवल agent से प्राप्त API/state के आधार पर होना चाहिए, direct Docker access primary path नहीं होना चाहिए।

    use super::proto::{ContainerStatePoint, ContainerStatesResponse};
    use crate::docker::{api::DockerApi, types::ContainerSummary};
    use std::collections::HashMap;
    use tonic::Status;
    
    pub async fn send_snapshot(
        docker: &DockerApi,
        tx: &tokio::sync::mpsc::Sender<Result<ContainerStatesResponse, Status>>,
    ) -> Result<(), ()> {
        let rows = docker
            .get_json::<Vec<ContainerSummary>>("/containers/json?all=true")
            .await
            .map_err(|error| tracing::debug!(%error, "could not read containers after Docker event"))?;
    
        let mut containers: Vec<_> = rows.into_iter().map(container_state).collect();
        containers.sort_by(|a, b| a.container_id.cmp(&b.container_id));
        tx.send(Ok(ContainerStatesResponse { containers }))
            .await
            .map_err(|_| ())
    }
    
    pub fn container_state(row: ContainerSummary) -> ContainerStatePoint {
        ContainerStatePoint {
            container_id: row.id.short().to_string(),
            name: row.display_name().as_str().to_string(),
            state: row.state,
            status: row.status,
            application_id: label_id(&row.labels, "com.openoxide.application-id"),
            compose_id: label_id(&row.labels, "com.openoxide.compose-id"),
            compose_project: row
                .labels
                .get("com.docker.compose.project")
                .cloned()
                .unwrap_or_default(),
            compose_service: row
                .labels
                .get("com.docker.compose.service")
                .cloned()
                .unwrap_or_default(),
        }
    }
    
    fn label_id(labels: &HashMap<String, String>, key: &str) -> i64 {
        labels
            .get(key)
            .and_then(|value| value.parse().ok())
            .unwrap_or(0)
    }

    use super::{proto::LifecycleControl, proto::ContainerStatesResponse, state};
    use crate::docker::api::DockerApi;
    use std::{pin::Pin, time::Duration};
    use tokio_stream::{Stream, StreamExt};
    use tonic::{Response, Status};
    
    pub type LifecycleStream =
        Pin<Box<dyn Stream<Item = Result<ContainerStatesResponse, Status>> + Send + 'static>>;
    
    pub async fn watch(
        docker: DockerApi,
        mut controls: tonic::Streaming<LifecycleControl>,
    ) -> Result<Response<LifecycleStream>, Status> {
        controls
            .message()
            .await?
            .ok_or_else(|| Status::invalid_argument("missing lifecycle subscription"))?;
    
        let (tx, rx) = tokio::sync::mpsc::channel(8);
        tokio::spawn(async move {
            let mut events = match docker.get_stream("/events").await {
                Ok(events) => events,
                Err(error) => {
                    let _ = tx.send(Err(Status::unavailable(error.to_string()))).await;
                    return;
                }
            };
            let mut heartbeat = tokio::time::interval(Duration::from_secs(15));
            heartbeat.set_missed_tick_behavior(tokio::time::MissedTickBehavior::Skip);
            let mut buffer = Vec::new();
    
            if state::send_snapshot(&docker, &tx).await.is_err() {
                return;
            }
    
            loop {
                tokio::select! {
                    control = controls.message() => match control {
                        Ok(Some(_)) => {}
                        _ => break,
                    },
                    _ = heartbeat.tick() => {
                        if state::send_snapshot(&docker, &tx).await.is_err() { break; }
                    }
                    chunk = events.next() => match chunk {
                        Some(Ok(bytes)) => {
                            buffer.extend_from_slice(&bytes);
                            while let Some(position) = buffer.iter().position(|byte| *byte == b'\n') {
                                buffer.drain(..=position);
                                if state::send_snapshot(&docker, &tx).await.is_err() { return; }
                            }
                        }
                        Some(Err(error)) => {
                            let _ = tx.send(Err(Status::unavailable(error.to_string()))).await;
                            break;
                        }
                        None => break,
                    }
                }
            }
        });
    
        Ok(Response::new(Box::pin(
            tokio_stream::wrappers::ReceiverStream::new(rx),
        )))
    }

    use super::proto::{LogChunk, LogStreamRequest};
    use crate::{docker::api::DockerApi, docker::types::ContainerId, logs::tail_container_logs};
    use std::pin::Pin;
    use tokio_stream::Stream;
    use tonic::{Response, Status};
    use tracing::debug;
    
    const DEFAULT_TAIL_LINES: usize = 100;
    
    pub type LogStream = Pin<Box<dyn Stream<Item = Result<LogChunk, Status>> + Send + 'static>>;
    
    pub fn stream(docker: DockerApi, request: LogStreamRequest) -> Response<LogStream> {
        let tail_lines = if request.tail_lines > 0 {
            request.tail_lines as usize
        } else {
            DEFAULT_TAIL_LINES
        };
        debug!(container = %request.container_id, tail_lines, "serving log tail");
    
        let (tx, rx) = tokio::sync::mpsc::channel(100);
        let container_id = request.container_id;
        tokio::spawn(async move {
            let timestamp = chrono::Utc::now().timestamp();
            let typed_id = ContainerId::new(&container_id);
            for line in tail_container_logs(&docker, &typed_id, tail_lines).await {
                let chunk = LogChunk {
                    container_id: container_id.clone(),
                    log_line: line,
                    timestamp,
                    is_stderr: false,
                };
                if tx.send(Ok(chunk)).await.is_err() {
                    break;
                }
            }
        });
        Response::new(Box::pin(tokio_stream::wrappers::ReceiverStream::new(rx)))
    }

    use super::proto::{
        ContainerMetricPoint, ContainerMetricsResponse, GetContainerMetricsRequest, GetMetricsRequest,
        ServerMetricPoint, ServerMetricsResponse,
    };
    use crate::store::Store;
    use tonic::{Response, Status};
    use tracing::debug;
    
    const DEFAULT_LIMIT: i64 = 50;
    const MAX_LIMIT: i64 = 1000;
    
    pub async fn server(
        store: &Store,
        request: GetMetricsRequest,
    ) -> Result<Response<ServerMetricsResponse>, Status> {
        let limit = clamp_limit(request.limit as i64);
        let rows = store
            .get_last_n_server_metrics(limit)
            .await
            .map_err(|error| Status::internal(error.to_string()))?;
        debug!(requested = limit, returned = rows.len(), "serving server metrics gRPC");
    
        let metrics = rows
            .into_iter()
            .map(|row| ServerMetricPoint {
                id: row.id.unwrap_or(0),
                timestamp: row.timestamp,
                cpu: row.cpu,
                cpu_model: row.cpu_model,
                cpu_cores: row.cpu_cores,
                cpu_physical_cores: row.cpu_physical_cores,
                cpu_speed: row.cpu_speed,
                os: row.os,
                distro: row.distro,
                kernel: row.kernel,
                arch: row.arch,
                mem_used: row.mem_used,
                mem_used_gb: row.mem_used_gb,
                mem_total: row.mem_total,
                uptime: row.uptime,
                disk_used: row.disk_used,
                total_disk: row.total_disk,
                network_in: row.network_in,
                network_out: row.network_out,
            })
            .collect();
        Ok(Response::new(ServerMetricsResponse { metrics }))
    }
    
    pub async fn containers(
        store: &Store,
        request: GetContainerMetricsRequest,
    ) -> Result<Response<ContainerMetricsResponse>, Status> {
        let limit = clamp_limit(request.limit as i64);
        let rows = store
            .get_last_n_container_metrics(&request.app_name, limit)
            .await
            .map_err(|error| Status::internal(error.to_string()))?;
        debug!(container = %request.app_name, requested = limit, returned = rows.len(), "serving container metrics gRPC");
    
        let metrics = rows
            .into_iter()
            .map(|row| ContainerMetricPoint {
                id: row.id.unwrap_or(0),
                timestamp: row.timestamp,
                container_id: row.container_id,
                name: row.name,
                cpu_perc: row.cpu_perc,
                mem_perc: row.mem_perc,
                mem_used_mb: row.mem_used_mb,
                mem_total_mb: row.mem_total_mb,
                net_in_mb: row.net_in_mb,
                net_out_mb: row.net_out_mb,
                block_read_mb: row.block_read_mb,
                block_write_mb: row.block_write_mb,
                application_id: row.application_id.unwrap_or(0),
                compose_id: row.compose_id.unwrap_or(0),
            })
            .collect();
        Ok(Response::new(ContainerMetricsResponse { metrics }))
    }
    
    fn clamp_limit(raw: i64) -> i64 {
        if raw <= 0 {
            DEFAULT_LIMIT
        } else {
            raw.min(MAX_LIMIT)
        }
    }
    
    #[cfg(test)]
    mod tests {
        use super::*;
    
        #[test]
        fn limit_defaults_and_is_capped() {
            assert_eq!(clamp_limit(0), DEFAULT_LIMIT);
            assert_eq!(clamp_limit(-5), DEFAULT_LIMIT);
            assert_eq!(clamp_limit(10), 10);
            assert_eq!(clamp_limit(50_000), MAX_LIMIT);
        }
    }

    use super::proto::ShellMessage;
    use crate::docker::api::DockerApi;
    use std::pin::Pin;
    use tokio::io::{AsyncReadExt, AsyncWriteExt};
    use tokio::process::Command;
    use tokio_stream::Stream;
    use tonic::{Response, Status};
    
    pub type ShellStream = Pin<Box<dyn Stream<Item = Result<ShellMessage, Status>> + Send + 'static>>;
    
    pub async fn open(
        server_id: i64,
        mut input: tonic::Streaming<ShellMessage>,
        expected_server_id: i64,
        _docker: DockerApi,
    ) -> Result<Response<ShellStream>, Status> {
        let first = input
            .message()
            .await?
            .ok_or_else(|| Status::invalid_argument("missing shell open message"))?;
        if first.server_id != server_id || server_id != expected_server_id {
            return Err(Status::not_found("shell server_id does not match this agent"));
        }
        if first.action != "open" {
            return Err(Status::invalid_argument("first shell message must be open"));
        }
    
        let shell = if first.shell.is_empty() { "sh" } else { first.shell.as_str() };
        let mut command = if first.container.is_empty() {
            let mut command = Command::new(shell);
            command
        } else {
            let mut command = Command::new("docker");
            command.args(["exec", "-i", &first.container, shell]);
            command
        };
        let mut child = command
            .stdin(std::process::Stdio::piped())
            .stdout(std::process::Stdio::piped())
            .stderr(std::process::Stdio::piped())
            .spawn()
            .map_err(|error| Status::internal(format!("could not start shell: {error}")))?;
        let mut stdin = child.stdin.take().ok_or_else(|| Status::internal("shell stdin unavailable"))?;
        let mut stdout = child.stdout.take().ok_or_else(|| Status::internal("shell stdout unavailable"))?;
        let mut stderr = child.stderr.take().ok_or_else(|| Status::internal("shell stderr unavailable"))?;
        let (tx, rx) = tokio::sync::mpsc::channel(32);
    
        tokio::spawn(async move {
            let mut out = [0u8; 4096];
            let mut err = [0u8; 4096];
            loop {
                tokio::select! {
                    message = input.message() => match message {
                        Ok(Some(message)) if message.action == "input" => {
                            if stdin.write_all(&message.data).await.is_err() { break; }
                            let _ = stdin.flush().await;
                        }
                        Ok(Some(message)) if message.action == "close" => {
                            let _ = stdin.shutdown().await;
                            break;
                        }
                        Ok(Some(_)) => {}
                        _ => break,
                    },
                    result = stdout.read(&mut out) => match result {
                        Ok(0) => {},
                        Ok(size) => { if tx.send(Ok(ShellMessage { action: "stdout".into(), data: out[..size].to_vec(), ..Default::default() })).await.is_err() { break; } },
                        Err(error) => { let _ = tx.send(Ok(ShellMessage { action: "error".into(), error: error.to_string(), ..Default::default() })).await; break; }
                    },
                    result = stderr.read(&mut err) => match result {
                        Ok(0) => {},
                        Ok(size) => { if tx.send(Ok(ShellMessage { action: "stderr".into(), data: err[..size].to_vec(), ..Default::default() })).await.is_err() { break; } },
                        Err(error) => { let _ = tx.send(Ok(ShellMessage { action: "error".into(), error: error.to_string(), ..Default::default() })).await; break; }
                    },
                    status = child.wait() => {
                        let code = status.ok().and_then(|status| status.code()).unwrap_or(-1);
                        let _ = tx.send(Ok(ShellMessage { action: "exit".into(), exit_code: code, ..Default::default() })).await;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            let _ = child.kill().await;
        });
    
        Ok(Response::new(Box::pin(tokio_stream::wrappers::ReceiverStream::new(rx))))
    }

    use std::sync::Arc;
    
    use auto_di::singleton;
    use crate::{docker::api::DockerApi, store::Store};
    
    /// Agent-side service facade. Transport handlers delegate here so Docker,
    /// metrics, lifecycle and shell dependencies stay in one owned service.
    #[derive(Clone)]
    pub struct MonitoringService {
        pub store: Arc<Store>,
        pub docker: DockerApi,
    }
    
    #[singleton]
    impl MonitoringService {
        pub fn new(store: Arc<Store>, docker: DockerApi) -> Self {
            Self { store, docker }
        }
    }

## Assistant

Ab manual dependency wiring hata di hai.

DI chain ab ye hai:

```text
Config
  -> Store
  -> DockerApi
  -> MonitorContext
  -> MonitoringService
  -> MonitoringGrpc
```

`main.rs` me ab direct `Config::from_env()`, `Store::init()`, `DockerApi::new()`, `MonitoringService::new()` nahi ho raha. Sirf:

```rust
let container = Container::new()?;
let config = container.resolve::<Config>().await?;
let context = container.resolve::<MonitorContext>().await?;
```

Use ho raha hai.

`#[singleton]` providers add kiye:

- `Config`
- `Store`
- `DockerApi`
- `MonitorContext`
- `MonitoringService`
- `MonitoringGrpc`

Compile checks successful:

```text
cargo check -p agent -p openoxide --offline
git diff --check
```

    use auto_di::{Container, DiError};
    use futures::future::BoxFuture;
    use tonic::service::RoutesBuilder;
    
    pub type Registrar = for<'a> fn(
        &'a Container,
        &'a mut RoutesBuilder,
    ) -> BoxFuture<'a, Result<(), DiError>>;
    
    pub struct Descriptor {
        pub registrar: Registrar,
    }
    
    inventory::collect!(Descriptor);
    
    pub async fn register(
        container: &Container,
        builder: &mut RoutesBuilder,
    ) -> Result<(), DiError> {
        for descriptor in inventory::iter::<Descriptor> {
            (descriptor.registrar)(container, builder).await?;
        }
        Ok(())
    }

`auto_grpc` add kar diya, `auto_route` ke same registration idea par.

Naya runtime crate:

```text
crates/auto/grpc/
```

Flow:

```text
#[singleton] MonitoringGrpc
        ↓
inventory::submit!(GrpcServerTask registrar)
        ↓
auto_grpc::register(container, routes)
        ↓
DI resolve + tonic route registration
```

Ab runtime task manually `MonitoringGrpc::new(...)` ya direct `.add_service(MonitoringGrpc...)` nahi karta. `auto_grpc` inventory descriptors collect karta hai aur service ko `Container::resolve()` se inject karke `RoutesBuilder` me register karta hai.

Manual service-specific code sirf registrar me hai, jahan interceptor/token binding required hai. Multiple gRPC services add karne par woh bhi same `inventory::submit!` descriptor se auto register honge.

    fn authenticate(
        token: &str,
        request: tonic::Request<()>,
    ) -> Result<tonic::Request<()>, tonic::Status> {
        let supplied = request.metadata().get("x-metrics-token").and_then(|v| v.to_str().ok());

    }
    
    pub struct GrpcServerTask;
    
    inventory::submit! {
        auto_grpc::Descriptor { registrar: GrpcServerTask::register }
    }
    
    impl GrpcServerTask {
        fn register<'a>(
            container: &'a Container,
            builder: &'a mut RoutesBuilder,
        ) -> BoxFuture<'a, Result<(), auto_di::DiError>> {
            Box::pin(async move {
                let service = container.resolve::<MonitoringGrpc>().await?;
                let config = container.resolve::<crate::core::config::Config>().await?;
                let token = config.metrics_token.clone();
                builder.add_service(MonitoringServiceServer::with_interceptor(
                    (*service).clone(),
                    move |request| authenticate(&token, request),
                ));
                Ok(())
            })
        }
    
        pub async fn run(ctx: MonitorContext, shutdown: CancellationToken) {
            let addr: SocketAddr = match format!("0.0.0.0:{}", ctx.config.grpc_port).parse() {
                Ok(addr) => addr,
                Err(error) => {
                    error!(%error, port = ctx.config.grpc_port, "invalid gRPC bind address");
                    return;
                }
            };
            info!(%addr, "gRPC query server listening");
            let container = match Container::new() {
                Ok(container) => container,
                Err(error) => {
                    error!(%error, "could not create dependency container");
                    return;
                }
            };
            let mut routes = RoutesBuilder::default();
            if let Err(error) = auto_grpc::register(&container, &mut routes).await {
                error!(%error, "could not register gRPC services");
                return;
            }
            if let Err(error) = tonic::transport::Server::builder()
                .add_routes(routes.routes())
                .serve_with_shutdown(addr, shutdown.cancelled_owned())
                .await
            {
                error!(%error, "gRPC server stopped unexpectedly");
            }
        }
    }

## Assistant

`GrpcServerTask` agent ka gRPC server start aur register karta hai. Iska kaam business logic ya Docker operation karna nahi hai.

Flow:

1. `run()` gRPC bind address banata hai, jaise `0.0.0.0:50051`.
2. `auto_grpc::register()` ke through registered gRPC services discover karta hai.
3. `MonitoringGrpc` ko `auto_di` se resolve karta hai.
4. `MonitoringMiddleware` ko bhi `auto_di` se resolve karta hai.
5. Monitoring service ko token-auth interceptor ke saath routes me add karta hai.
6. Tonic server start karta hai.
7. `CancellationToken` milne par gracefully shutdown karta hai.

Actual kaam yahan hota hai:

- Metrics, states, logs, shell: `MonitoringGrpc`
- Docker/monitoring business logic: `services/monitoring`
- Authentication: `MonitoringMiddleware`
- Server lifecycle: `GrpcServerTask`

Isliye `GrpcServerTask` ko composition/bootstrap layer samjho, operational logic ka place nahi.

    use std::net::SocketAddr;
    
    use auto_di::Container;
    use futures::future::BoxFuture;
    use tokio_util::sync::CancellationToken;
    use tonic::service::RoutesBuilder;
    use tracing::{error, info};
    
    use crate::api::grpc::{MonitoringGrpc, MonitoringMiddleware, MonitoringServiceServer};
    use crate::context::MonitorContext;
    
    pub struct GrpcServerTask;
    
    inventory::submit! {
        auto_grpc::Descriptor { registrar: GrpcServerTask::register }
    }
    
    impl GrpcServerTask {
        fn register<'a>(
            container: &'a Container,
            builder: &'a mut RoutesBuilder,
        ) -> BoxFuture<'a, Result<(), auto_di::DiError>> {
            Box::pin(async move {
                let service = container.resolve::<MonitoringGrpc>().await?;
                let middleware = container.resolve::<MonitoringMiddleware>().await?;
                builder.add_service(MonitoringServiceServer::with_interceptor(
                    (*service).clone(),
                    move |request| middleware.authenticate(request),
                ));
                Ok(())
            })
        }
    
        pub async fn run(ctx: MonitorContext, shutdown: CancellationToken) {
            let addr: SocketAddr = match format!("0.0.0.0:{}", ctx.config.grpc_port).parse() {
                Ok(addr) => addr,
                Err(error) => {
                    error!(%error, port = ctx.config.grpc_port, "invalid gRPC bind address");
                    return;
                }
            };
            info!(%addr, "gRPC query server listening");
    
            let container = match Container::new() {
                Ok(container) => container,
                Err(error) => {
                    error!(%error, "could not create dependency container");
                    return;
                }
            };
            let mut routes = RoutesBuilder::default();
            if let Err(error) = auto_grpc::register(&container, &mut routes).await {
                error!(%error, "could not register gRPC services");
                return;
            }
            if let Err(error) = tonic::transport::Server::builder()
                .add_routes(routes.routes())
                .serve_with_shutdown(addr, shutdown.cancelled_owned())
                .await
            {
                error!(%error, "gRPC server stopped unexpectedly");
            }
        }
    }

    Add: /run/media/das/SSD/Devloper/rustploy/crates/auto/grpc_macros/src/lib.rs
    use proc_macro::TokenStream;
    use proc_macro2::Span;
    use quote::{format_ident, quote};
    use syn::{parse_macro_input, punctuated::Punctuated, Expr, ExprArray, ItemImpl, Path, Token};
    
    struct Options {
        middleware: Vec<Path>,
        server: Option<Path>,
    }
    
    impl syn::parse::Parse for Options {
        fn parse(input: syn::parse::ParseStream<'_>) -> syn::Result<Self> {
            let mut middleware = Vec::new();
            let mut server = None;
            while !input.is_empty() {
                let key: syn::Ident = input.parse()?;
                input.parse::<Token![=]>()?;
                if key == "middleware" {
                    let array: ExprArray = input.parse()?;
                    for expr in array.elems {
                        match expr {
                            Expr::Path(path) => middleware.push(path.path),
                            other => return Err(syn::Error::new_spanned(other, "middleware entries must be types")),
                        }
                    }
                } else if key == "server" {
                    server = Some(input.parse()?);
                } else {
                    return Err(syn::Error::new_spanned(key, "unknown auto_grpc option"));
                }
                if input.peek(Token![,]) { input.parse::<Token![,]>()?; }
            }
            Ok(Self { middleware, server })
        }
    }
    
    #[proc_macro_attribute]
    pub fn service(attr: TokenStream, item: TokenStream) -> TokenStream {
        let options = parse_macro_input!(attr as Options);
        let item_impl = parse_macro_input!(item as ItemImpl);
        match expand(options, item_impl) {
            Ok(tokens) => tokens.into(),
            Err(error) => error.to_compile_error().into(),
        }
    }
    
    fn expand(options: Options, item: ItemImpl) -> syn::Result<proc_macro2::TokenStream> {
        let trait_path = item.trait_.as_ref().ok_or_else(|| syn::Error::new(Span::call_site(), "#[auto_grpc::service] requires a trait impl"))?.1.clone();
        let trait_ident = trait_path.segments.last().unwrap().ident.clone();
        let service_ident = match &*item.self_ty {
            syn::Type::Path(path) => path.path.segments.last().unwrap().ident.clone(),
            other => return Err(syn::Error::new_spanned(other, "gRPC service must be a named type")),
        };
        let server_path = options.server.unwrap_or_else(|| {
            let ident = format_ident!("{}Server", trait_ident);
            syn::parse_quote!(#ident)
        });
        let registrar = format_ident!("__auto_grpc_register_{}", service_ident);
        let resolves = options.middleware.iter().enumerate().map(|(index, path)| {
            let var = format_ident!("middleware_{index}");
            quote! { let #var = container.resolve::<#path>().await?; }
        });
        let vars: Vec<_> = options.middleware.iter().enumerate().map(|(index, _)| format_ident!("middleware_{index}")).collect();
        let service = quote! { container.resolve::<#service_ident>().await? };
        let registration = if vars.is_empty() {
            quote! { builder.add_service(#server_path::new((*service).clone())); }
        } else {
            let first = &vars[0];
            let chain = vars.iter().skip(1).fold(quote! { #first.authenticate(request) }, |acc, middleware| quote! { #middleware.authenticate(#acc?) });
            quote! {
                builder.add_service(#server_path::with_interceptor((*service).clone(), move |request| {
                    #chain
                }));
            }
        };
        Ok(quote! {
            #item
            fn #registrar<'a>(container: &'a ::auto_grpc::__private::auto_di::Container, builder: &'a mut ::auto_grpc::__private::tonic::service::RoutesBuilder) -> ::auto_grpc::__private::auto_di::BoxFuture<'a, Result<(), ::auto_grpc::__private::auto_di::DiError>> {
                Box::pin(async move {
                    #(#resolves)*
                    let service = #service;
                    #registration
                    Ok(())
                })
            }
            ::auto_grpc::__private::inventory::submit! {
                ::auto_grpc::Descriptor { registrar: #registrar }
            }
        })
    }

    use std::sync::Arc;
    
    use auto_di::singleton;
    use auto_grpc::middleware;
    
    #[derive(Clone)]
    pub struct MonitoringMiddleware {
        token: Arc<str>,
    }
    
    #[singleton]
    impl MonitoringMiddleware {
        pub fn new(config: Arc<crate::core::config::Config>) -> Self {
            Self {
                token: Arc::from(config.metrics_token.clone()),
            }
        }
    
        pub(crate) fn authenticate(
            &self,
            request: tonic::Request<()>,
        ) -> Result<tonic::Request<()>, tonic::Status> {
            let supplied = request
                .metadata()
                .get("x-metrics-token")
                .and_then(|value| value.to_str().ok());
            if supplied == Some(self.token.as_ref()) {
                Ok(request)
            } else {
                Err(tonic::Status::unauthenticated("invalid monitoring token"))
            }
        }
    }

## Assistant

Current shell flow ye hai:

```text
Frontend terminal
      │
      │ gRPC bidirectional stream
      ▼
Openoxide backend
      │
      │ agent gRPC Shell()
      ▼
Remote/local agent
      │
      ├── container empty: local shell (`sh`/`bash`)
      └── container set: `docker exec -i <container> <shell>`
```

Implementation path:

```text
agent/src/api/grpc.rs
  MonitoringGrpc::shell()
        ↓
agent/src/services/monitoring/mod.rs
  MonitoringService::shell()
        ↓
agent/src/services/monitoring/shell.rs
  ShellService::open()
```

Protocol `ShellMessage` ke actions:

- `Open`: session start karta hai. Isme `server_id`, `container`, aur `shell` aata hai.
- `Input`: terminal se typed bytes child process ke stdin me jate hain.
- `Close`: stdin shutdown karke shell close karta hai.
- `Stdout`: process ka stdout frontend ko bhejta hai.
- `Stderr`: process ka stderr frontend ko bhejta hai.
- `Error`: read/spawn error bhejta hai.
- `Exit`: process exit code bhejta hai.

Agent pe process:

```rust
Command::new("sh")
```

ya container ke liye:

```text
docker exec -i <container> <shell>
```

Agent stdin, stdout aur stderr ko pipes me leta hai. Ek Tokio task simultaneously:

- incoming gRPC messages read karta hai
- stdin me input write karta hai
- stdout read karke stream karta hai
- stderr read karke stream karta hai
- process exit detect karta hai

Important: current implementation remote Docker API ya SSH tunnel use nahi karta. Remote server par installed agent khud us machine ke Docker daemon/local shell ko execute karta hai. Backend sirf persistent gRPC stream maintain karta hai.

Backend ke direct SSH/Docker paths ko gradually replace karna hoga:

7. SSH sirf agent bootstrap/recovery ke liye bachega, regular operations ke liye nahi.
8. Localhost bhi isi agent path se chalega, alag code path nahi rahega.

Important distinction:

- `Shell` = persistent interactive stream.
- `ExecTask` = one-shot/non-PTY command with structured result.
- `Compose` operations = backend command builder banayega, execution agent karega.

Abhi `Shell` endpoint ready hai, lekin backend ka WebSocket terminal usse connected nahi hai aur Compose/deploy/etc. direct SSH/Docker executor use kar rahe hain. Full migration ke liye `ExecTask` RPC aur backend agent client layer next required step hain.

## User

what benifits i will get from this and pros and cons batoo mere ko

## Assistant

`ExecTask` endpoint ka main benefit ye hai ki backend khud Docker/SSH command execute nahi karega; agent target server par command run karega.

**Benefits**

- Local aur remote server ke liye same execution path.
- Backend me baar-baar SSH connection banane ki zarurat kam.
- Docker Compose, deploy, backup, database, image, volume, network operations agent execute kar sakta hai.
- Non-PTY task automation ke liye suitable: deploy, pull, restart, backup, cleanup.
- stdout, stderr, exit code aur timeout structured form me milte hain.
- Agent server ke local Docker socket ko directly use karta hai, isliye remote Docker socket expose nahi karna padta.
- Agent offline ho to operation clearly fail hoga; backend false success nahi dikhayega.
- Future me cancellation, retry, task ID, progress aur audit add karna easy hoga.
- Security boundary better hoti hai: agent ko limited task permissions diye ja sakte hain.

**Cons**

- Agent mandatory dependency ban jayega. Agent down hua to deploy/backup/compose operations rukenge.
- Backend ko har operation ke liye gRPC client migration karna padega. Abhi endpoint bana hai, lekin existing backend paths abhi completely migrate nahi hue.
- Generic `command: sh -lc "..."` powerful hai, isliye authorization aur command validation zaroori hai.
- Shell command portability issue rahega: `bash`, `sh`, Docker Compose version, paths alag ho sakte hain.
- Large logs stream karne par memory/backpressure/cancellation carefully handle karna padega.
- Agent aur backend proto version mismatch hua to compatibility problem hogi.
- Timeout ke baad process cleanup reliable hona chahiye, warna orphan processes reh sakte hain.
- Structured Docker operations ke comparison me generic shell commands ka error handling weak hota hai.
- Agent compromise hone par us server par command execution ka risk high hoga.

**Best architecture**

```text
Backend
  - authorization
  - database state
  - task creation
  - retry/status tracking

Agent
  - command execution
  - Docker/Compose execution
  - stdout/stderr streaming
  - timeout/cancellation
  - local Docker socket access
```

`Shell` interactive terminal ke liye hai. `ExecTask` deploy, compose, backup, restart jaise one-shot background tasks ke liye hai.

Abhi actual benefit tab milega jab backend ke `DockerCli`, `remote_executor`, deployment, backup aur scheduler paths ko is gRPC client par migrate karenge. Endpoint ready hai, full backend migration abhi remaining hai.

    Add: /run/media/das/SSD/Devloper/rustploy/crates/os/src/exec/agent.rs
    use super::{ExecError, ExecExitStatus, ExecOutput, ExecResult, ExecStreamEvent};
    use async_trait::async_trait;
    use std::{ffi::OsStr, sync::Arc};
    use tokio::sync::mpsc;
    use tokio_util::sync::CancellationToken;
    
    #[derive(Clone, Debug)]
    pub struct AgentCommandRequest {
        pub program: String,
        pub args: Vec<String>,
        pub stdin: Vec<u8>,
        pub timeout_seconds: u32,
    }
    
    #[derive(Clone, Debug)]
    pub enum AgentCommandOutput {
        Stdout(Vec<u8>),
        Stderr(Vec<u8>),
        Exit(i32),
        Error(String),
    }
    
    #[async_trait]
    pub trait AgentTransport: Send + Sync + std::fmt::Debug {
        async fn execute(&self, request: AgentCommandRequest) -> ExecResult<Vec<AgentCommandOutput>>;
    }
    
    #[derive(Clone)]
    pub struct AgentExecutor {
        transport: Arc<dyn AgentTransport>,
        timeout_seconds: u32,
    }
    
    impl std::fmt::Debug for AgentExecutor {
        fn fmt(&self, formatter: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
            formatter
                .debug_struct("AgentExecutor")
                .field("timeout_seconds", &self.timeout_seconds)
                .finish_non_exhaustive()
        }
    }
    
    impl AgentExecutor {
        pub fn new(transport: Arc<dyn AgentTransport>) -> Self {
            Self {
                transport,
                timeout_seconds: 300,
            }
        }
    
        pub fn with_timeout_seconds(mut self, timeout_seconds: u32) -> Self {
            self.timeout_seconds = timeout_seconds;
            self
        }
    
        pub async fn run<I, S>(&self, program: &str, args: I) -> ExecResult<ExecOutput>
        where
            I: IntoIterator<Item = S>,
            S: AsRef<OsStr>,
        {
            self.execute(program, args, &[], CancellationToken::new(), None)
                .await
        }
    
        pub async fn run_with_stdin<I, S>(
            &self,
            program: &str,
            args: I,
            stdin: impl AsRef<[u8]>,
        ) -> ExecResult<ExecOutput>
        where
            I: IntoIterator<Item = S>,
            S: AsRef<OsStr>,
        {
            self.execute(program, args, stdin.as_ref(), CancellationToken::new(), None)
                .await
        }
    
        pub async fn run_cancelled<I, S>(
            &self,
            program: &str,
            args: I,
            cancel: &CancellationToken,
        ) -> ExecResult<ExecOutput>
        where
            I: IntoIterator<Item = S>,
            S: AsRef<OsStr>,
        {
            self.execute(program, args, &[], cancel.clone(), None).await
        }
    
        pub async fn run_with_stdin_cancelled<I, S>(
            &self,
            program: &str,
            args: I,
            stdin: impl AsRef<[u8]>,
            cancel: &CancellationToken,
        ) -> ExecResult<ExecOutput>
        where
            I: IntoIterator<Item = S>,
            S: AsRef<OsStr>,
        {
            self.execute(program, args, stdin.as_ref(), cancel.clone(), None)
                .await
        }
    
        pub async fn run_stream<I, S>(
            &self,
            program: &str,
            args: I,
            sender: mpsc::Sender<ExecStreamEvent>,
        ) -> ExecResult<ExecExitStatus>
        where
            I: IntoIterator<Item = S>,
            S: AsRef<OsStr>,
        {
            let output = self
                .execute(program, args, &[], CancellationToken::new(), None)
                .await?;
            if !output.stdout.is_empty() {
                let _ = sender.send(ExecStreamEvent::Stdout(output.stdout.into_bytes())).await;
            }
            if !output.stderr.is_empty() {
                let _ = sender.send(ExecStreamEvent::Stderr(output.stderr.into_bytes())).await;
            }
            Ok(output.status)
        }
    
        async fn execute<I, S>(
            &self,
            program: &str,
            args: I,
            stdin: &[u8],
            cancel: CancellationToken,
            _working_directory: Option<&str>,
        ) -> ExecResult<ExecOutput>
        where
            I: IntoIterator<Item = S>,
            S: AsRef<OsStr>,
        {
            let args = args
                .into_iter()
                .map(|value| value.as_ref().to_string_lossy().into_owned())
                .collect();
            let request = AgentCommandRequest {
                program: program.to_owned(),
                args,
                stdin: stdin.to_vec(),
                timeout_seconds: self.timeout_seconds,
            };
            let outputs = tokio::select! {
                _ = cancel.cancelled() => return Err(ExecError::StreamCancelled),
                result = self.transport.execute(request) => result?,
            };
            let mut stdout = Vec::new();
            let mut stderr = Vec::new();
            let mut exit_code = -1;
            for output in outputs {
                match output {
                    AgentCommandOutput::Stdout(data) => stdout.extend(data),
                    AgentCommandOutput::Stderr(data) => stderr.extend(data),
                    AgentCommandOutput::Exit(code) => exit_code = code,
                    AgentCommandOutput::Error(error) => stderr.extend(error.into_bytes()),
                }
            }
            Ok(ExecOutput {
                status: ExecExitStatus::Agent(exit_code),
                stdout: String::from_utf8_lossy(&stdout).into_owned(),
                stderr: String::from_utf8_lossy(&stderr).into_owned(),
            })
        }
    }
