## Reasoning

**Planning conceptual Rust syntax overview**

## Assistant

Haan, syntax ke saath dekho. Exact implementation baad mein existing `sh!` style ke according fit hogi, lekin developer experience roughly aisa ho sakta hai.

### 1. Basic type-safe command

```rust
let output = sh!(docker ps)
    .arg("--all")
    .run()
    .await?;
```

Dynamic value shell string mein interpolate karne ke bajay separate argument:

```rust
let container = ContainerName::new("openoxide-agent")?;

sh!(docker inspect)
    .arg(container)
    .run()
    .await?;
```

Isse escaping automatic hogi aur injection ka risk nahi rahega.

### 2. Typed flags and enums

```rust
sh!(docker run)
    .image(ImageName::new("redis:7")?)
    .restart(RestartPolicy::UnlessStopped)
    .network(NetworkName::new("openoxide-network")?)
    .detach(true)
    .run()
    .await?;
```

Galat value compile hi nahi hogi:

```rust
.restart("sometimes") // compile error
```

### 3. Execution target

Same command ko local ya remote Agent par:

```rust
sh!(docker ps)
    .on(AgentTarget::Local)
    .run()
    .await?;
```

```rust
sh!(docker ps)
    .on(AgentTarget::Server(server_id))
    .run()
    .await?;
```

Backend khud command execute nahi karega; selected Agent karega.

### 4. CLI and API execution

Default CLI:

```rust
sh!(docker container inspect)
    .container(container_id)
    .run()
    .await?;
```

Docker API version:

```rust
sh!(docker container inspect)
    .container(container_id)
    .api()
    .run()
    .await?;
```

Agar operation Docker API support nahi karta:

```rust
sh!(custom_script)
    .api() // method available hi nahi hogi
```

Ideally capability type ke through `.api()` sirf supported builders par dikhe.

### 5. Typed output

Plain output:

```rust
let text: String = sh!(docker version)
    .run()
    .text()
    .await?;
```

JSON deserialize:

```rust
let info: DockerInfo = sh!(docker info)
    .format(OutputFormat::Json)
    .run()
    .json()
    .await?;
```

Lines:

```rust
let containers: Vec<String> = sh!(docker ps)
    .quiet()
    .run()
    .lines()
    .await?;
```

Exit status only:

```rust
let status = sh!(docker inspect)
    .arg(container)
    .run()
    .status()
    .await?;
```

### 6. Streaming logs

```rust
let mut stream = sh!(docker logs)
    .arg(container)
    .follow(true)
    .tail(100)
    .stream()
    .await?;
```

```rust
while let Some(event) = stream.next().await {
    match event? {
        ShellEvent::Stdout(line) => send_stdout(line).await?,
        ShellEvent::Stderr(line) => send_stderr(line).await?,
        ShellEvent::Exited(status) => handle_exit(status),
    }
}
```

Streaming commands par default 300-second timeout nahi lagega.

### 7. Timeout and cancellation

```rust
sh!(docker pull)
    .arg(image)
    .timeout(Duration::from_minutes(10))
    .cancel_with(deployment_token)
    .run()
    .await?;
```

User deployment cancel kare to Agent par actual process aur child process bhi terminate ho.

### 8. Retry policy

```rust
sh!(docker pull)
    .arg(image)
    .retry(
        RetryPolicy::exponential()
            .attempts(3)
            .initial_delay(Duration::from_secs(1))
            .when(RetryCondition::NetworkFailure),
    )
    .run()
    .await?;
```

Command validation error par retry nahi, sirf network/temporary failure par.

### 9. Environment variables

```rust
sh!(docker build)
    .env(EnvName::new("NODE_ENV")?, "production")
    .secret_env(EnvName::new("REGISTRY_TOKEN")?, token)
    .arg(context)
    .run()
    .await?;
```

`secret_env` ki value logs, tracing aur error messages mein:

```text
REGISTRY_TOKEN=[REDACTED]
```

### 10. Typed paths and mounts

```rust
sh!(docker run)
    .image(image)
    .mount(
        Mount::bind(
            HostPath::new("/data/app")?,
            ContainerPath::new("/app/data")?,
        )
        .read_only(),
    )
    .run()
    .await?;
```

Host path aur container path accidentally interchange nahi honge.

### 11. Container shell

```rust
let shell = sh!(docker exec)
    .container(container_id)
    .shell(ShellKind::Sh)
    .interactive()
    .tty(TtySize::new(120, 40))
    .on(AgentTarget::Server(server_id))
    .open()
    .await?;
```

Resize:

```rust
shell.resize(TtySize::new(cols, rows)).await?;
```

Input:

```rust
shell.write(input).await?;
```

Ye Agent ke existing bidirectional gRPC connection se multiplex ho sakta hai.

### 12. Non-interactive container task

```rust
let result = sh!(container exec)
    .container(container_id)
    .command(sh!(php artisan migrate).arg("--force"))
    .on(AgentTarget::Server(server_id))
    .run()
    .await?;
```

Isme terminal/PTY create nahi hoga; normal task execution hoga.

### 13. Safe pipeline

```rust
let result = sh!(docker ps)
    .format("{{.Names}}")
    .pipe(sh!(sort))
    .run()
    .lines()
    .await?;
```

Lekin ideally common filtering native ho:

```rust
let containers = sh!(docker ps)
    .filter(ContainerFilter::Status(ContainerStatus::Running))
    .filter(ContainerFilter::Label(
        Label::new("openoxide.project.id", project_id),
    ))
    .run()
    .json::<Vec<ContainerSummary>>()
    .await?;
```

Native filter API/CLI dono mein map ki ja sakti hai.

### 14. Structured errors

```rust
match sh!(docker pull).arg(image).run().await {
    Err(ShellError::NotFound { resource, .. }) => {}
    Err(ShellError::Authentication { registry, .. }) => {}
    Err(ShellError::Timeout { duration, .. }) => {}
    Err(ShellError::AgentOffline { server_id }) => {}
    Err(ShellError::Exited { code, stderr, .. }) => {}
    result => {}
}
```

String matching jaise `stderr.contains("not found")` ki जरूरत कम होगी.

### 15. Destructive-operation confirmation

```rust
sh!(docker volume rm)
    .volume(volume)
    .destructive(DestructiveAction::DeleteVolume)
    .authorized_by(user_id)
    .run()
    .await?;
```

Authorization na ho to execution Agent tak jaayega hi nahi.

### 16. Dry run and inspection

```rust
let plan = sh!(docker run)
    .image(image)
    .network(network)
    .env("NODE_ENV", "production")
    .dry_run()?;
```

Possible result:

```rust
ExecutionPlan {
    target: AgentTarget::Server(4),
    transport: Transport::DockerApi,
    operation: "container.create",
    secrets_redacted: true,
}
```

### 17. Idempotent deployments

```rust
sh!(docker service update)
    .service(service_name)
    .image(image)
    .idempotency_key(deployment_id)
    .run()
    .await?;
```

User 2–3 baar Deploy click kare, phir bhi same deployment operation duplicate execute na ho.

### Recommended final style

Common operation readable aur short rahe:

```rust
let containers = sh!(docker containers)
    .on(server.agent())
    .filter(ContainerFilter::Project(project_id))
    .status(ContainerStatus::Running)
    .api()
    .run()
    .json::<Vec<ContainerSummary>>()
    .await?;
```

Interactive shell:

```rust
let session = sh!(docker shell)
    .on(server.agent())
    .container(container_id)
    .tty(size)
    .open()
    .await?;
```

Deployment:

```rust
sh!(docker service deploy)
    .on(server.agent())
    .service(service)
    .image(image)
    .network(network)
    .envs(environment)
    .labels(labels)
    .idempotency_key(deployment_id)
    .api()
    .run()
    .await?;
```

Main principle ye hoga: command readable CLI jaisa dikhe, lekin dynamic values, flags, outputs, errors, target aur capabilities sab typed hon. `run()` default CLI execution rahe aur `.api()` sirf un operations par available ho jahan proper API mapping implemented hai.

## Reasoning

**Outlining shell scripting macro syntax overview**

## Assistant

Samajh gaya—tum `sh!` ke andar actual shell scripting syntax ki baat kar rahe ho: multiple commands, pipe, conditions, redirect, variables, loops, grouping, etc. `.json()` builder wali baat nahi.

`sh!` ko in features se upgrade kar sakte hain:

### Multiple commands

Sequential commands:

```rust
sh! {
    mkdir -p $dir;
    cd $dir;
    git init;
}
```

Success hone par next command:

```rust
sh! {
    docker pull $image &&
    docker service update --image $image $service
}
```

Fallback/error handling:

```rust
sh! {
    docker inspect $container ||
    docker create --name $container $image
}
```

### Pipelines

```rust
sh! {
    docker ps --format "{{.Names}}"
        | grep $project
        | sort
}
```

Pipeline ka exit status configurable ho:

```rust
sh! {
    set -o pipefail;
    docker logs $container | grep "ERROR"
}
```

### Redirects

```rust
sh! {
    docker logs $container > $log_file;
    docker inspect $container 2> $error_file;
}
```

Append aur combined output:

```rust
sh! {
    command >> $log_file;
    command &> $combined_file;
}
```

Agent streaming ke saath:

```rust
sh! {
    command 2>&1 | tee $log_file
}
```

### Variables

Typed Rust values safely inject hon:

```rust
sh! {
    image = $image;
    service = $service;

    docker pull "$image";
    docker service update --image "$image" "$service";
}
```

Shell variable aur Rust interpolation clearly separate rakhe ja sakte hain:

```rust
sh! {
    local_name = "container-$resource_id";
    docker inspect "$local_name";
}
```

Rust value `$value`, shell variable `$$value` jaisa distinction rakh sakte hain:

```rust
sh! {
    NAME = $container_name;
    echo "$$NAME";
}
```

### Environment variables

Single command scope:

```rust
sh! {
    NODE_ENV="production" PORT=$port npm start
}
```

Multiple commands ke liye:

```rust
sh! {
    export NODE_ENV="production";
    export PORT=$port;

    npm run build;
    npm start;
}
```

Secrets automatically redact hon:

```rust
sh! {
    secret REGISTRY_TOKEN = $token;
    docker login --password-stdin <<< "$$REGISTRY_TOKEN";
}
```

### Conditions

```rust
sh! {
    if docker inspect $container; then
        docker start $container;
    else
        docker run --name $container $image;
    fi
}
```

File/directory checks typed ho sakte hain:

```rust
sh! {
    if file_exists($config); then
        docker config create $name $config;
    fi
}
```

Command result check:

```rust
sh! {
    if success(docker network inspect $network); then
        echo "network exists";
    else
        docker network create $network;
    fi
}
```

### Loops

Rust collection safely iterate ho:

```rust
sh! {
    for volume in $volumes {
        docker volume inspect "$volume" ||
        docker volume create "$volume";
    }
}
```

Shell output par iteration:

```rust
sh! {
    for container in $(docker ps -q) {
        docker inspect "$container";
    }
}
```

Better safe version:

```rust
sh! {
    docker ps -q
        | each |container| {
            docker inspect $container;
        }
}
```

Isse whitespace splitting wala shell bug avoid hoga.

### Command substitution

```rust
sh! {
    container_id = $(docker ps -q --filter name=$name);
    docker inspect "$container_id";
}
```

Typed capture bhi useful hoga:

```rust
sh! {
    let container_id: ContainerId =
        capture(docker ps -q --filter name=$name);

    docker inspect $container_id;
}
```

### Grouping and subshell

Same shell context:

```rust
sh! {
    {
        prepare;
        build;
        deploy;
    } > $deployment_log;
}
```

Isolated working directory/environment:

```rust
sh! {
    (
        cd $source_dir;
        npm install;
        npm run build;
    );

    deploy $source_dir;
}
```

### Background commands and waiting

```rust
sh! {
    worker_one &
    first_pid = $!;

    worker_two &
    second_pid = $!;

    wait "$first_pid";
    wait "$second_pid";
}
```

Safer structured concurrency:

```rust
sh! {
    parallel {
        docker pull $frontend_image;
        docker pull $backend_image;
        docker pull $database_image;
    }

    docker stack deploy -c $compose_file $stack;
}
```

Ek command fail hote hi remaining background processes cancel kiye ja sakein.

### Retry and timeout inside script

```rust
sh! {
    retry attempts=3 delay=2s {
        docker pull $image;
    }

    timeout 5m {
        docker service update --image $image $service;
    }
}
```

### Error handling / cleanup

Shell ke `trap` ka readable equivalent:

```rust
sh! {
    defer {
        rm -f $temporary_file;
    }

    download $source > $temporary_file;
    deploy $temporary_file;
}
```

Explicit failure handling:

```rust
sh! {
    try {
        docker service update $service;
    } catch error {
        docker service inspect $service;
        fail error;
    }
}
```

### Heredoc and multiline content

```rust
sh! {
    write $compose_file <<COMPOSE
    services:
      app:
        image: ${image}
    COMPOSE

    docker stack deploy -c $compose_file $stack;
}
```

Better safe form interpolation ambiguity hata dega:

```rust
sh! {
    write_file $compose_file {
        "services:\n";
        "  app:\n";
        "    image: " $image "\n";
    }
}
```

### Functions

Reusable script blocks:

```rust
sh! {
    fn service_exists(name) {
        docker service inspect "$name";
    }

    if service_exists($service) {
        docker service update $service;
    } else {
        docker service create --name $service $image;
    }
}
```

### Strict mode

```rust
sh! {
    strict;

    prepare;
    build;
    deploy;
}
```

`strict` internally equivalent ho sakta hai:

```bash
set -euo pipefail
```

Lekin macro structured errors bhi return kare, sirf cryptic shell exit nahi.

### Sabse useful final syntax

```rust
sh! {
    strict;

    defer {
        rm -f $temporary_file;
    }

    retry attempts=3 delay=2s {
        docker pull $image;
    }

    if success(docker service inspect $service) {
        docker service update
            --image $image
            --label $label
            $service;
    } else {
        docker service create
            --name $service
            --label $label
            $image;
    }

    docker service ps $service
        | grep "Running"
        | tee $deployment_log;
}
```

Main upgrades hone chahiye: `&&/||`, pipelines, redirects, safe variables, capture, conditions, loops, `parallel`, `retry`, `timeout`, `defer`, strict mode aur structured error mein exact failed command/line. Ye actual shell scripting ko readable aur type-safe banayenge.

## Reasoning

**Explaining conceptual syntax inline**

## Assistant

Samajh gaya. Tum `sh!` block ke andar command ka output directly Rust variable mein bind karna chahte ho—shell variable nahi.

Syntax conceptually:

- `let output = <command>` → stdout as string.
- `let lines = <command>.lines` → `Vec<String>`.
- `let bytes = <command>.bytes` → raw bytes.
- `let value: Type = <command>.json` → deserialize karke typed Rust value.
- `let result = <command>.output` → stdout, stderr aur exit status ka complete typed result.
- `let status = <command>.status` → sirf exit status.
- `let success = <command>.success` → boolean.
- `let stream = <command>.stream` → live output receiver/stream.

Meaning syntax roughly `let containers = docker ps ... | capture;` jaisa hoga. Macro internally command execute karke generated async Rust scope mein real Rust variable create karega. Us variable ko:

- `sh!` block ke next commands mein argument ki tarah use kar sakte ho.
- Agar macro expression result return kare, block ke bahar bhi receive kar sakte ho.
- Explicit type annotation dekar parsing compile-time clear rakh sakte ho.
- Command fail ho to assignment na ho; normal `Result` propagation ho.
- Optional capture variant mein failure/empty output ko `Option<T>` banaya ja sakta hai.
- Output trimming explicit hona chahiye—default silently trim karna confusing ho sakta hai.

Important distinction clean rakhna:

- `let` = Rust variable/output capture.
- Shell environment variable ke liye existing `env`/export syntax.
- `$rust_value` = Rust value ko command argument banana.
- Shell `$VAR` ko alag syntax se represent karna.

Best design mere hisaab se assignment ke right side par output mode hona chahiye, jaise conceptual form: `let info: DockerInfo = command → json`, na ki baad mein `.json::<...>()` builder chain. Isse poori multi-command script ek hi `sh!` block ke andar readable rahegi.

are dekho hume alag sochna hoga kyo ki ye variable rust ke under bhi honge and sh ke  under sh ke under default variable jase work karenge and bahar ate hi rust and dono ka farak kabhi pata hi nahi chalega kisi ko samaj rahe ho na

## Assistant

Haan, ab samjha. Tum hybrid lexical variable chahte ho—ek hi variable `sh!` ke andar shell variable jaisa aur block ke bahar normal Rust variable jaisa behave kare. User ko `$`, capture, conversion ya shell/Rust boundary manually manage nahi करनी पड़े।

Macro internally:

- Rust value ko command argument banate waqt safely escape karega.
- Command output assignment ko typed Rust value mein store karega.
- Wahi value subsequent shell commands mein directly usable hogi.
- Exported binding `sh!` ke baad normal Rust variable ban jayegi.
- User ko pata bhi nahi चलेगा execution shell context mein hua ya Rust context mein.

Lekin internally distinction macro ko maintain karni होगी:

- Input binding: pehle से मौजूद Rust variable.
- Captured binding: command output से बना variable.
- Local binding: केवल `sh!` scope तक.
- Exported binding: block के बाहर Rust में उपलब्ध.
- Environment binding: child processes ko environment variable ke रूप में मिले.
- Secret binding: usable ho, lekin logs/errors mein redact रहे.

Output ka type context se infer ho sakta hai: string, bytes, lines, JSON struct, exit status etc. Agar explicit type diya hai to macro matching parser generate kare; type nahi diya to default text output रखे।

Sabse important: ye actual shell text generate karke shell variables par dependent na ho. Macro Rust-level scope aur command graph generate करे। Tab quoting, spaces, binary output, ownership, async execution aur type safety reliable रहेंगी।

Basically user ko ek language दिखेगी, lekin compiler ke andar:

`Rust binding ↔ command argument ↔ captured output ↔ Rust binding`

ka automatic bridge होगा। यही tumhare existing `sh!` ko normal CLI builder se genuinely powerful scripting DSL बना देगा।

    use std::{path::Path, sync::Arc};
    
    use auto_di::singleton;
    
    use crate::{
        api::dto::database::UpsertDatabaseMountDto,
        db::models::mounts::Mount,
        repository::MountRepository,
        services::database::{DatabaseKind, DatabaseService},
    };
    
    pub struct DatabaseMountService {
        databases: Arc<DatabaseService>,
        mounts: Arc<MountRepository>,
    }
    
    #[singleton]
    impl DatabaseMountService {
        fn new(databases: Arc<DatabaseService>, mounts: Arc<MountRepository>) -> Self {
            Self { databases, mounts }
        }
    
        async fn ensure_database(&self, kind: DatabaseKind, id: i64) -> sqlx::Result<()> {
            self.databases.get_by_id(kind, id).await.map(|_| ())
        }
    
        pub async fn list(&self, kind: DatabaseKind, id: i64) -> sqlx::Result<Vec<Mount>> {
            self.ensure_database(kind, id).await?;
            self.mounts.fetch_for_database(id).await
        }
    
        pub async fn create(
            &self,
            kind: DatabaseKind,
            id: i64,
            input: UpsertDatabaseMountDto,
        ) -> sqlx::Result<Mount> {
            self.ensure_database(kind, id).await?;
            let input = normalize_mount(input).map_err(sqlx::Error::Protocol)?;
            self.mounts
                .create_for_database(
                    kind,
                    id,
                    input.mount_type.as_str(),
                    input.host_path.as_deref(),
                    input.volume_name.as_deref(),
                    input.file_path.as_deref(),
                    input.content.as_deref(),
                    &input.mount_path,
                )
                .await
        }
    
        pub async fn update(
            &self,
            kind: DatabaseKind,
            database_id: i64,
            id: i64,
            input: UpsertDatabaseMountDto,
        ) -> sqlx::Result<Mount> {
            self.ensure_database(kind, database_id).await?;
            let input = normalize_mount(input).map_err(sqlx::Error::Protocol)?;
            self.mounts
                .update_for_database(
                    kind,
                    database_id,
                    id,
                    input.mount_type.as_str(),
                    input.host_path.as_deref(),
                    input.volume_name.as_deref(),
                    input.file_path.as_deref(),
                    input.content.as_deref(),
                    &input.mount_path,
                )
                .await?
                .ok_or(sqlx::Error::RowNotFound)
        }
    
        pub async fn delete(
            &self,
            kind: DatabaseKind,
            database_id: i64,
            id: i64,
        ) -> sqlx::Result<bool> {
            self.ensure_database(kind, database_id).await?;
            self.mounts
                .delete_for_database(kind, database_id, id)
                .await
        }
    }
    
    fn normalize_mount(mut input: UpsertDatabaseMountDto) -> Result<UpsertDatabaseMountDto, String> {
        input.mount_path = input.mount_path.trim().to_string();
        if !Path::new(&input.mount_path).is_absolute() {
            return Err("mount_path must be an absolute container path".into());
        }
    
        match input.mount_type {
            crate::utils::builder::spec::MountType::Bind => {
                let value = required_trimmed(input.host_path.as_deref(), "host_path")?;
                if !Path::new(&value).is_absolute() {
                    return Err("host_path must be absolute for BIND mounts".into());
                }
                input.host_path = Some(value);
                input.volume_name = None;
                input.file_path = None;
                input.content = None;
            }
            crate::utils::builder::spec::MountType::Volume => {
                input.volume_name = Some(required_trimmed(
                    input.volume_name.as_deref(),
                    "volume_name",
                )?);
                input.host_path = None;
                input.file_path = None;
                input.content = None;
            }
            crate::utils::builder::spec::MountType::File => {
                input.file_path = Some(required_trimmed(input.file_path.as_deref(), "file_path")?);
                if input.content.is_none() {
                    return Err("content is required for FILE mounts".into());
                }
                input.host_path = None;
                input.volume_name = None;
            }
        }
        Ok(input)
    }
    
    fn required_trimmed(value: Option<&str>, field: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
        value
            .map(str::trim)
            .filter(|value| !value.is_empty())
            .map(str::to_string)
            .ok_or_else(|| format!("{field} is required"))
    }

    export type DatabaseEndpoint =
    	| '/postgres/{id}'
    	| '/mysql/{id}'
    	| '/mariadb/{id}'
    	| '/mongo/{id}'
    	| '/redis/{id}'
    	| '/libsql/{id}';
    
    export function databaseKind(database: any): string {
    	return String(database?.kind || database?.database_kind || 'postgres').toLowerCase();
    }
    
    export function databaseEndpoint(database: any): DatabaseEndpoint {
    	const kind = databaseKind(database);
    	if (kind.includes('mariadb')) return '/mariadb/{id}';
    	if (kind.includes('mysql')) return '/mysql/{id}';
    	if (kind.includes('mongo')) return '/mongo/{id}';
    	if (kind.includes('redis')) return '/redis/{id}';
    	if (kind.includes('libsql')) return '/libsql/{id}';
    	return '/postgres/{id}';
    }

    import {useEffect, useMemo, useState} from 'react';
    import {Network, Save} from 'lucide-react';
    import {Button} from '#/components/ui/button';
    import {Switch} from '#/components/ui/switch';
    import {toast} from 'sonner';
    import {$api} from '#/api/query';
    import {formatApiError} from '#/api/utils';
    import {databaseEndpoint} from './database-endpoint';
    
    export function DatabaseAdvancedNetworks({database, onUpdated}: any) {
    	const {data: networks} = $api.useQuery('get', '/database-networks');
    	const patchDatabase = $api.useMutation(
    		'patch',
    		databaseEndpoint(database) as any,
    	);
    	const [selected, setSelected] = useState<string[]>([]);
    	const [detached, setDetached] = useState(false);
    	const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
    
    	useEffect(() => {
    		setSelected((database?.network_ids || []).map(String));
    		setDetached(Number(database?.detach_rustploy_network || 0) !== 0);
    	}, [database]);
    
    	const available = useMemo(
    		() =>
    			((networks as any[]) || []).filter(
    				network =>
    					!database?.server_id ||
    					!network.server_id ||
    					Number(network.server_id) === Number(database.server_id),
    			),
    		[networks, database?.server_id],
    	);
    
    	const toggle = (id: string) =>
    		setSelected(current =>
    			current.includes(id)
    				? current.filter(item => item !== id)
    				: [...current, id],
    		);
    
    	const save = async () => {
    		if (detached && selected.length === 0)
    			return toast.error('Attach at least one network before detaching Openoxide network');
    		setSaving(true);
    		try {
    			await patchDatabase.mutateAsync({
    				params: {path: {id: Number(database.id)}},
    				body: {
    					network_ids: selected,
    					detach_rustploy_network: detached ? 1 : 0,
    				},
    			} as any);
    			toast.success('Database networks updated');
    			onUpdated();
    		} catch (error) {
    			toast.error(formatApiError(error));
    		} finally {
    			setSaving(false);
    		}
    	};
    
    	return (
    		<section className="flex flex-col gap-5 rounded-2xl border border-border/80 bg-card p-6 shadow-sm">
    			<div>
    				<h3 className="flex items-center gap-2 text-base font-bold">
    					<Network className="size-4 text-primary" /> Networks
    				</h3>
    				<p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
    					Attach overlay networks or isolate this database from the shared Openoxide network.
    				</p>
    			</div>
    			<div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 rounded-xl border p-4">
    				<div>
    					<p className="text-xs font-bold">Detach openoxide-network</p>
    					<p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">Only attached networks will be available after redeploy.</p>
    				</div>
    				<Switch checked={detached} onCheckedChange={setDetached} />
    			</div>
    			<div className="flex flex-col gap-2 border-t border-border/40 pt-4">
    				{available.length === 0 ? (
    					<p className="rounded-lg border border-dashed p-4 text-center text-xs text-muted-foreground">No database networks available for this server.</p>
    				) : available.map(network => {
    					const id = String(network.id);
    					return (
    						<label key={id} className="flex cursor-pointer items-center justify-between rounded-lg border p-3 hover:bg-muted/20">
    							<span><span className="block text-xs font-bold">{network.name}</span><span className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{network.docker_network_name}</span></span>
    							<input type="checkbox" checked={selected.includes(id)} onChange={() => toggle(id)} className="size-4 accent-primary" />
    						</label>
    					);
    				})}
    			</div>
    			<div className="flex justify-end border-t border-border/40 pt-4">
    				<Button onClick={save} disabled={saving} className="h-9 gap-1.5 text-xs"><Save className="size-3.5" /> {saving ? 'Saving...' : 'Save Networks'}</Button>
    			</div>
    		</section>
    	);
    }

    type Mount = {id: number; mount_type: string; volume_name?: string | null; host_path?: string | null; file_path?: string | null; content?: string | null; mount_path: string};
    
    export function DatabaseAdvancedVolumes({database, onUpdated}: any) {
    	const kind = databaseKind(database);
    	const base = `/database-management/${kind}/{id}/mounts` as any;
    	const {data: mounts, refetch} = $api.useQuery('get', base, {params: {path: {id: Number(database?.id)}}} as any);
    	const create = $api.useMutation('post', base);
    	const update = $api.useMutation('put', `${base}/{mount_id}` as any);
    	const remove = $api.useMutation('delete', `${base}/{mount_id}` as any);
    	const [editing, setEditing] = useState<Mount | null>(null);
    	const [type, setType] = useState('VOLUME');
    	const [source, setSource] = useState('');
    	const [target, setTarget] = useState('');
    	const [content, setContent] = useState('');
    	const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
    
    	useEffect(() => {
    		if (!editing) {
    			setType('VOLUME'); setSource(''); setTarget(''); setContent(''); return;
    		}
    		setType(editing.mount_type); setSource(editing.volume_name || editing.host_path || editing.file_path || ''); setTarget(editing.mount_path); setContent(editing.content || '');
    	}, [editing]);
    
    	const reset = () => setEditing(null);
    	const save = async () => {
    		if (!target.trim() || !source.trim()) return toast.error('Mount source and target are required');
    		setSaving(true);
    		try {
    			const body: any = {mount_type: type, mount_path: target.trim(), content: type === 'FILE' ? content : undefined};
    			if (type === 'VOLUME') body.volume_name = source.trim();
    			if (type === 'BIND') body.host_path = source.trim();
    			if (type === 'FILE') body.file_path = source.trim();
    			if (editing) await update.mutateAsync({params: {path: {id: Number(database.id), mount_id: editing.id}}, body} as any);
    			else await create.mutateAsync({params: {path: {id: Number(database.id)}}, body} as any);
    			toast.success(editing ? 'Mount updated' : 'Mount added'); await refetch(); onUpdated(); reset();
    		} catch (error) { toast.error(formatApiError(error)); } finally { setSaving(false); }
    	};
    
    	const deleteMount = async (mount: Mount) => {
    		try { await remove.mutateAsync({params: {path: {id: Number(database.id), mount_id: mount.id}}} as any); toast.success('Mount removed'); await refetch(); onUpdated(); } catch (error) { toast.error(formatApiError(error)); }

The default database volume is used.</p> : ((mounts as Mount[]) || []).map(mount => <div key={mount.id} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-lg border p-3"><div className="min-w-0"><p className="text-xs font-bold">{mount.mount_type} · {mount.mount_path}</p><p className="truncate text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{mount.volume_name || mount.host_path || mount.file_path}</p></div><div className="flex gap-1"><Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="size-8" onClick={() => setEditing(mount)}><Pencil className="size-3.5" /></Button><Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="size-8 text-destructive" onClick={() => deleteMount(mount)}><Trash2 className="size-3.5" /></Button></div></div>)}
    		</div>
    		{editing === null ? <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setEditing({id: 0, mount_type: 'VOLUME', mount_path: ''})} className="h-9 w-fit gap-1.5 text-xs"><Plus className="size-3.5" /> Add Mount</Button> : <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 rounded-xl border bg-muted/10 p-4"><div className="flex items-center justify-between"><p className="text-xs font-bold">{editing.id ?     import {useEffect, useState} from 'react';
    import {Save, SlidersHorizontal} from 'lucide-react';
    import {Button} from '#/components/ui/button';
    import {Input} from '#/components/ui/input';
    import {Textarea} from '#/components/ui/textarea';
    import {toast} from 'sonner';
    import {$api} from '#/api/query';
    import {formatApiError} from '#/api/utils';
    
    export function DatabasePostgresConfig({database, onUpdated}: any) {
    	const id = Number(database?.id);
    	const {data, refetch} = $api.useQuery(
    		'get',
    		'/database-management/postgres/{id}/advanced-config',
    		{params: {path: {id}}},
    	);
    	const update = $api.useMutation(
    		'put',
    		'/database-management/postgres/{id}/advanced-config',
    	);
    	const [settings, setSettings] = useState('');
    	const [role, setRole] = useState('STANDALONE');
    	const [host, setHost] = useState('');
    	const [port, setPort] = useState('5432');
    	const [user, setUser] = useState('');
    	const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
    	const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
    
    	useEffect(() => {
    		const config = data as any;
    		setSettings(
    			Object.entries(config?.settings || {})
    				.map(([key, value]) => `${key}=${value}`)
    				.join('\n'),
    		);
    		setRole(config?.replication_role || 'STANDALONE');
    		setHost(config?.primary_host || '');
    		setPort(String(config?.primary_port || 5432));
    		setUser(config?.replication_user || '');
    	}, [data]);
    
    	const save = async () => {
    		const parsed: Record<string, string> = {};
    		for (const raw of settings.split('\n')) {
    			const line = raw.trim();
    			if (!line || line.startsWith('#')) continue;
    			const separator = line.indexOf('=');
    			if (separator < 1) return toast.error(`Invalid PostgreSQL setting: ${line}`);
    			parsed[line.slice(0, separator).trim()] = line.slice(separator + 1).trim();
    		}
    		if (role === 'REPLICA' && (!host.trim() || !user.trim()))
    			return toast.error('Primary host and replication user are required for replicas');
    
    		setSaving(true);
    		try {
    			await update.mutateAsync({
    				params: {path: {id}},
    				body: {
    					settings: parsed,
    					replication_role: role as any,
    					primary_host: role === 'REPLICA' ? host.trim() : undefined,
    					primary_port: role === 'REPLICA' ? Number(port || 5432) : undefined,
    					replication_user: role === 'REPLICA' ? user.trim() : undefined,
    					replication_password: password.trim() || undefined,
    				},
    			});
    			toast.success('PostgreSQL configuration updated');
    			setPassword('');
    			await refetch();
    			onUpdated();
    		} catch (error) {
    			toast.error(formatApiError(error));
    		} finally {
    			setSaving(false);
    		}
    	};
    
    	return <section className="flex flex-col gap-5 rounded-2xl border border-border/80 bg-card p-6 shadow-sm">
    		<div><h3 className="flex items-center gap-2 text-base font-bold"><SlidersHorizontal className="size-4 text-primary" /> PostgreSQL Configuration</h3><p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground">Configure postgresql.conf overrides and primary/replica behavior.</p></div>
    		<div className="grid gap-4 border-t border-border/40 pt-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
    			<label className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase text-muted-foreground">Replication role<select value={role} onChange={event => setRole(event.target.value)} className="h-9 rounded-md border bg-background px-2 text-xs normal-case"><option value="STANDALONE">Standalone</option><option value="PRIMARY">Primary</option><option value="REPLICA">Replica</option></select></label>
    			{role === 'REPLICA' && <><label className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase text-muted-foreground">Primary host<Input value={host} onChange={event => setHost(event.target.value)} className="h-9 text-xs normal-case" /></label><label className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase text-muted-foreground">Primary port<Input type="number" value={port} onChange={event => setPort(event.target.value)} className="h-9 text-xs normal-case" /></label><label className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase text-muted-foreground">Replication user<Input value={user} onChange={event => setUser(event.target.value)} className="h-9 text-xs normal-case" /></label><label className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase text-muted-foreground sm:col-span-2">Replication password<Input type="password" value={password} onChange={event => setPassword(event.target.value)} placeholder={(data as any)?.replication_password_configured ? 'Leave blank to keep current password' : 'Enter replication password'} className="h-9 text-xs normal-case" /></label></>}
    			<label className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase text-muted-foreground sm:col-span-2">Settings (one key=value per line)<Textarea value={settings} onChange={event => setSettings(event.target.value)} placeholder={'max_connections=200\nshared_buffers=256MB'} className="min-h-32 font-mono text-xs normal-case" /></label>
    		</div>
    		<div className="flex justify-end border-t border-border/40 pt-4"><Button onClick={save} disabled={saving} className="h-9 gap-1.5 text-xs"><Save className="size-3.5" /> {saving ? 'Saving...' : 'Save PostgreSQL Config'}</Button></div>
    	</section>;
    }

    use crate::api::dto::database::DatabaseSwarmSettingsDto;
    use crate::services::database::DatabaseKind;
    use sqlx::SqlitePool;
    use std::sync::Arc;
    
    pub struct DatabaseSwarmSettingsService {
        pool: Arc<SqlitePool>,
    }
    
    impl DatabaseSwarmSettingsService {
        pub fn new(pool: Arc<SqlitePool>) -> Self { Self { pool } }
    
        fn table(kind: DatabaseKind) -> &'static str {
            match kind {
                DatabaseKind::Postgres => "postgres_dbs",
                DatabaseKind::Mysql => "mysql_dbs",
                DatabaseKind::Mariadb => "mariadb_dbs",
                DatabaseKind::Mongo => "mongo_dbs",
                DatabaseKind::Redis => "redis_dbs",
                DatabaseKind::Libsql => "libsql_dbs",
            }
        }
    
        pub async fn get(&self, kind: DatabaseKind, id: i64) -> sqlx::Result<DatabaseSwarmSettingsDto> {
            let table = Self::table(kind);
            let sql = sqlx::AssertSqlSafe(format!(
                "SELECT health_check_swarm, restart_policy_swarm, placement_swarm, update_config_swarm, rollback_config_swarm, mode_swarm, labels_swarm, network_swarm, endpoint_spec_swarm, ulimits_swarm, stop_grace_period_swarm FROM {table} WHERE id = ?"
            ));
            sqlx::query_as::<_, DatabaseSwarmSettingsDto>(&sql)
                .bind(id).fetch_one(self.pool.as_ref()).await
        }
    
        pub async fn update(&self, kind: DatabaseKind, id: i64, value: DatabaseSwarmSettingsDto) -> sqlx::Result<()> {
            let table = Self::table(kind);
            let sql = sqlx::AssertSqlSafe(format!(
                "UPDATE {table} SET health_check_swarm = ?, restart_policy_swarm = ?, placement_swarm = ?, update_config_swarm = ?, rollback_config_swarm = ?, mode_swarm = ?, labels_swarm = ?, network_swarm = ?, endpoint_spec_swarm = ?, ulimits_swarm = ?, stop_grace_period_swarm = ? WHERE id = ?"
            ));
            sqlx::query(&sql)
                .bind(value.health_check_swarm).bind(value.restart_policy_swarm)
                .bind(value.placement_swarm).bind(value.update_config_swarm)
                .bind(value.rollback_config_swarm).bind(value.mode_swarm)
                .bind(value.labels_swarm).bind(value.network_swarm)
                .bind(value.endpoint_spec_swarm).bind(value.ulimits_swarm)

    import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
    import { Save, ServerCog } from 'lucide-react';
    import { Button } from '#/components/ui/button';
    import { Input } from '#/components/ui/input';
    import { Textarea } from '#/components/ui/textarea';
    import { toast } from 'sonner';
    import { $api } from '#/api/query';
    import { formatApiError } from '#/api/utils';
    
    type Props = { database: any; onUpdated: () => void };
    const fields = [
      ['health_check_swarm', 'Health Check JSON'],
      ['restart_policy_swarm', 'Restart Policy JSON'],
      ['placement_swarm', 'Placement JSON'],
      ['update_config_swarm', 'Update Config JSON'],
      ['rollback_config_swarm', 'Rollback Config JSON'],
      ['mode_swarm', 'Mode JSON'],
      ['network_swarm', 'Service Networks JSON'],
      ['labels_swarm', 'Service Labels JSON'],
      ['endpoint_spec_swarm', 'Endpoint Spec JSON'],
      ['ulimits_swarm', 'Ulimits JSON'],
    ] as const;
    
    export function DatabaseSwarmSettings({ database, onUpdated }: Props) {
      const kind = String(database?.kind || 'postgres').toLowerCase();
      const endpoint = useMemo(() => `/database-management/${kind}/{id}/swarm-settings`, [kind]);
      const query = $api.useQuery('get', endpoint as any, { params: { path: { id: database?.id } } } as any, { enabled: !!database?.id } as any);
      const save = $api.useMutation('put', endpoint as any);
      const [values, setValues] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
      const [grace, setGrace] = useState('');
    
      useEffect(() => {
        const data: any = query.data || {};
        setValues(Object.fromEntries(fields.map(([key]) => [key, data[key] || ''])));
        setGrace(data.stop_grace_period_swarm == null ? '' : String(data.stop_grace_period_swarm));
      }, [query.data]);
    
      const update = (key: string, value: string) => setValues(current => ({ ...current, [key]: value }));
      const saveSettings = async () => {
        try {
          await save.mutateAsync({
            params: { path: { id: database?.id } },
            body: { ...values, stop_grace_period_swarm: grace.trim() ? Number(grace) : null },
          } as any);
          toast.success('Swarm settings updated');
          onUpdated();
        } catch (error) { toast.error(formatApiError(error)); }
      };
    
      return <section className="flex flex-col gap-5 rounded-2xl border border-border/80 bg-card p-6 shadow-sm">
        <div>
          <h3 className="flex items-center gap-2 text-base font-bold"><ServerCog className="size-4 text-primary" /> Swarm Settings</h3>
          <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">Dokploy-compatible health, restart, rollout, placement, network, label and endpoint controls. Enter valid Docker Engine JSON.</p>
        </div>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 border-t border-border/40 pt-4 md:grid-cols-2">
          {fields.map(([key, label]) => <label key={key} className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">
            {label}<Textarea value={values[key] || ''} onChange={event => update(key, event.target.value)} placeholder="{}" className="min-h-20 font-mono text-xs normal-case tracking-normal" />
          </label>)}
          <label className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">Stop Grace Period (nanoseconds)
            <Input type="number" value={grace} onChange={event => setGrace(event.target.value)} placeholder="30000000000" className="h-9 text-xs" />
          </label>
        </div>
        <div className="flex justify-end border-t border-border/40 pt-4"><Button onClick={saveSettings} disabled={save.isPending} className="h-9 gap-1.5 text-xs"><Save className="size-3.5" />{save.isPending ? 'Saving...' : 'Save Swarm Settings'}</Button></div>
      </section>;
    }

    +pub async fn apply_database_swarm_settings(
    +    kind: DatabaseKind,
    +    id: i64,
    +    service: &mut StackService,
    +) -> ExecResult<()> {
    +    let settings = auto_di::resolve::<crate::services::database::swarm_settings::DatabaseSwarmSettingsService>()
    +        .await.map_err(|error| ExecError::CommandFailed { code: None, stderr: error.to_string() })?
    +        .get(kind, id).await.map_err(|error| ExecError::CommandFailed { code: None, stderr: error.to_string() })?;
    +
    +    if let Some(raw) = settings.health_check_swarm.filter(|v| !v.trim().is_empty()) {
    +        service.healthcheck = Some(parse_setting(&raw, "health check")?);
    +    }
    +    if let Some(raw) = settings.restart_policy_swarm.filter(|v| !v.trim().is_empty()) {
    +        let value: serde_json::Value = parse_setting(&raw, "restart policy")?;
    +        service.deploy.restart_policy = RestartPolicy {
    +            condition: string_field(&value, "Condition", "condition", "on-failure"),
    +            delay: duration_field(&value, "Delay", "delay", "5s"),
    +            max_attempts: number_field(&value, "MaxAttempts", "max_attempts", 3),
    +            window: duration_field(&value, "Window", "window", "120s"),
    +        };
    +    }
    +    if let Some(raw) = settings.placement_swarm.filter(|v| !v.trim().is_empty()) {
    +        let value: serde_json::Value = parse_setting(&raw, "placement")?;
    +        service.deploy.placement.constraints = array_field(&value, "Constraints", "constraints");
    +    }
    +    apply_update_setting(settings.update_config_swarm, &mut service.deploy.update_config, "update config")?;
    +    apply_update_setting(settings.rollback_config_swarm, &mut service.deploy.rollback_config, "rollback config")?;
    +    if let Some(raw) = settings.labels_swarm.filter(|v| !v.trim().is_empty()) {
    +        let value: BTreeMap<String, String> = parse_setting(&raw, "labels")?;
    +        service.deploy.labels = value.into_iter().map(|(key, value)| format!("{key}={value}")).collect();
    +    }
    +    if let Some(raw) = settings.endpoint_spec_swarm.filter(|v| !v.trim().is_empty()) {
    +        let value: serde_json::Value = parse_setting(&raw, "endpoint spec")?;
    +        service.endpoint_mode = Some(string_field(&value, "Mode", "mode", "vip"));
    +    }
    +    service.ulimits = settings.ulimits_swarm.filter(|v| !v.trim().is_empty())
    +        .map(|raw| parse_setting(&raw, "ulimits")).transpose()?;
    +    service.stop_grace_period = settings.stop_grace_period_swarm.map(|value| format!("{value}ns"));
    +    Ok(())
    +}
    +
    +fn parse_setting<T: serde::de::DeserializeOwned>(raw: &str, name: &str) -> ExecResult<T> {
    +    serde_json::from_str(raw).map_err(|error| ExecError::CommandFailed {
    +        code: None, stderr: format!("Invalid database {name} JSON: {error}"),
    +    })
    +}
    +
    +fn field<'a>(value: &'a serde_json::Value, first: &str, second: &str) -> Option<&'a serde_json::Value> {
    +    value.get(first).or_else(|| value.get(second))
    +}
    +fn string_field(value: &serde_json::Value, first: &str, second: &str, default: &str) -> String {
    +    field(value, first, second).and_then(|v| v.as_str()).unwrap_or(default).to_string()
    +}
    +fn number_field(value: &serde_json::Value, first: &str, second: &str, default: u64) -> u64 {
    +    field(value, first, second).and_then(|v| v.as_u64()).unwrap_or(default)
    +}
    +fn duration_field(value: &serde_json::Value, first: &str, second: &str, default: &str) -> String {
    +    field(value, first, second).map(|v| v.as_str().map(str::to_owned).unwrap_or_else(|| format!("{}ns", v.as_u64().unwrap_or_default()))).unwrap_or_else(|| default.to_string())
    +}
    +fn array_field(value: &serde_json::Value, first: &str, second: &str) -> Vec<String> {
    +    field(value, first, second).and_then(|v| serde_json::from_value(v.clone()).ok()).unwrap_or_default()
    +}
    +fn apply_update_setting(raw: Option<String>, target: &mut UpdateConfig, name: &str) -> ExecResult<()> {
    +    let Some(raw) = raw.filter(|v| !v.trim().is_empty()) else { return Ok(()); };
    +    let value: serde_json::Value = parse_setting(&raw, name)?;
    +    target.parallelism = number_field(&value, "Parallelism", "parallelism", target.parallelism);
    +    target.delay = duration_field(&value, "Delay", "delay", &target.delay);
    +    target.order = string_field(&value, "Order", "order", &target.order);
    +    target.failure_action = string_field(&value, "FailureAction", "failure_action", &target.failure_action);
    +    target.monitor = field(&value, "Monitor", "monitor").map(|v| v.as_str().map(str::to_owned).unwrap_or_else(|| format!("{}ns", v.as_u64().unwrap_or_default())));
    +    target.max_failure_ratio = field(&value, "MaxFailureRatio", "max_failure_ratio").and_then(|v| v.as_f64());
    +    Ok(())
    +}
    +
     #[derive(Serialize)]

## Assistant

Database section ko Dokploy ke parity ke kaafi close la diya hai.

Added/updated:

- Metadata: name और description edit
- Custom image, command और args
- PostgreSQL advanced config और replication role
- Replicas, CPU/memory limits
- Volumes/mounts CRUD:
  - Volume
  - Bind mount
  - File mount
- Network assignment और Openoxide network detach
- Dokploy-style Swarm Settings:

  - Restart policy
  - Placement constraints
  - Update config
  - Rollback config
  - Replicated/Global mode
  - Service labels
  - Network settings

    import {useEffect, useState} from 'react';
    import {HardDrive, Pencil, Plus, Save, Trash2, X} from 'lucide-react';
    import {Button} from '#/components/ui/button';
    import {Input} from '#/components/ui/input';
    import {Textarea} from '#/components/ui/textarea';
    import {toast} from 'sonner';
    import {$api} from '#/api/query';
    import {formatApiError} from '#/api/utils';
    import {databaseEndpoint, databaseKind} from './database-endpoint';
    
    type Mount = {id: number; mount_type: string; volume_name?: string | null; host_path?: string | null; file_path?: string | null; content?: string | null; mount_path: string};
    
    export function DatabaseAdvancedVolumes({database, onUpdated}: any) {
    	const kind = databaseKind(database);
    	const base = '/database-management/{kind}/{id}/mounts' as any;
    	const item = '/database-management/{kind}/{database_id}/mounts/{id}' as any;
    	const {data: mounts, refetch} = $api.useQuery('get', base, {params: {path: {kind, id: Number(database?.id)}}} as any);
    	const create = $api.useMutation('post', base);
    	const update = $api.useMutation('put', item);
    	const remove = $api.useMutation('delete', item);
    	const [editing, setEditing] = useState<Mount | null>(null);
    	const [type, setType] = useState('VOLUME');
    	const [source, setSource] = useState('');
    	const [target, setTarget] = useState('');
    	const [content, setContent] = useState('');
    	const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
    
    	useEffect(() => {
    		if (!editing) {
    			setType('VOLUME'); setSource(''); setTarget(''); setContent(''); return;
    		}
    		setType(editing.mount_type); setSource(editing.volume_name || editing.host_path || editing.file_path || ''); setTarget(editing.mount_path); setContent(editing.content || '');
    	}, [editing]);
    
    	const reset = () => setEditing(null);
    	const save = async () => {
    		if (!target.trim() || !source.trim()) return toast.error('Mount source and target are required');
    		setSaving(true);
    		try {
    			const body: any = {mount_type: type, mount_path: target.trim(), content: type === 'FILE' ? content : undefined};
    			if (type === 'VOLUME') body.volume_name = source.trim();
    			if (type === 'BIND') body.host_path = source.trim();
    			if (type === 'FILE') body.file_path = source.trim();
    			if (editing?.id) await update.mutateAsync({params: {path: {kind, database_id: Number(database.id), id: editing.id}}, body} as any);
    			else await create.mutateAsync({params: {path: {kind, id: Number(database.id)}}, body} as any);
    			toast.success(editing ? 'Mount updated' : 'Mount added'); await refetch(); onUpdated(); reset();
    		} catch (error) { toast.error(formatApiError(error)); } finally { setSaving(false); }
    	};
    
    	const deleteMount = async (mount: Mount) => {
    		try { await remove.mutateAsync({params: {path: {kind, database_id: Number(database.id), id: mount.id}}} as any); toast.success('Mount removed'); await refetch(); onUpdated(); } catch (error) { toast.error(formatApiError(error)); }
    	};
    
    	return <section className="flex flex-col gap-5 rounded-2xl border border-border/80 bg-card p-6 shadow-sm">
    		<div><h3 className="flex items-center gap-2 text-base font-bold"><HardDrive className="size-4 text-primary" /> Volumes & Mounts</h3><p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground">Persist database data or mount host files. Redeploy applies changes.</p></div>
    		<div className="flex flex-col gap-2 border-t border-border/40 pt-4">
    			{((mounts as Mount[]) || []).length === 0 ? <p className="rounded-lg border border-dashed p-4 text-center text-xs text-muted-foreground">No custom mounts configured. The default database volume is used.</p> : ((mounts as Mount[]) || []).map(mount => <div key={mount.id} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-lg border p-3"><div className="min-w-0"><p className="text-xs font-bold">{mount.mount_type} · {mount.mount_path}</p><p className="truncate text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{mount.volume_name || mount.host_path || mount.file_path}</p></div><div className="flex gap-1"><Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="size-8" onClick={() => setEditing(mount)}><Pencil className="size-3.5" /></Button><Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="size-8 text-destructive" onClick={() => deleteMount(mount)}><Trash2 className="size-3.5" /></Button></div></div>)}
    		</div>
    		{editing === null ? <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setEditing({id: 0, mount_type: 'VOLUME', mount_path: ''})} className="h-9 w-fit gap-1.5 text-xs"><Plus className="size-3.5" /> Add Mount</Button> : <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 rounded-xl border bg-muted/10 p-4"><div className="flex items-center justify-between"><p className="text-xs font-bold">{editing.id ? 'Edit Mount' : 'Add Mount'}</p><Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="size-7" onClick={reset}><X className="size-3.5" /></Button></div><div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2"><label className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase text-muted-foreground">Type<select value={type} onChange={event => setType(event.target.value)} className="h-9 rounded-md border bg-background px-2 text-xs normal-case"><option value="VOLUME">Named volume</option><option value="BIND">Host bind</option><option value="FILE">File</option></select></label><label className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase text-muted-foreground">Source<Input value={source} onChange={event => setSource(event.target.value)} placeholder={type === 'VOLUME' ? 'database-data' : '/host/path'} className="h-9 text-xs normal-case" /></label><label className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase text-muted-foreground sm:col-span-2">Container path<Input value={target} onChange={event => setTarget(event.target.value)} placeholder="/var/lib/postgresql/data" className="h-9 text-xs normal-case" /></label>{type === 'FILE' && <label className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase text-muted-foreground sm:col-span-2">Content<Textarea value={content} onChange={event => setContent(event.target.value)} className="min-h-20 text-xs normal-case" /></label>}</div><div className="flex justify-end"><Button onClick={save} disabled={saving} className="h-9 gap-1.5 text-xs"><Save className="size-3.5" /> {saving ? 'Saving...' : 'Save Mount'}</Button></div></div>}
    	</section>;
    }

    import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
    import { Save, ServerCog } from 'lucide-react';
    import { Button } from '#/components/ui/button';
    import { Input } from '#/components/ui/input';
    import { Textarea } from '#/components/ui/textarea';
    import { toast } from 'sonner';
    import { $api } from '#/api/query';
    import { formatApiError } from '#/api/utils';
    
    type Props = { database: any; onUpdated: () => void };
    const fields = [
      ['health_check_swarm', 'Health Check JSON'],
      ['restart_policy_swarm', 'Restart Policy JSON'],
      ['placement_swarm', 'Placement JSON'],
      ['update_config_swarm', 'Update Config JSON'],
      ['rollback_config_swarm', 'Rollback Config JSON'],
      ['mode_swarm', 'Mode JSON'],
      ['network_swarm', 'Service Networks JSON'],
      ['labels_swarm', 'Service Labels JSON'],
      ['endpoint_spec_swarm', 'Endpoint Spec JSON'],
      ['ulimits_swarm', 'Ulimits JSON'],
    ] as const;
    
    export function DatabaseSwarmSettings({ database, onUpdated }: Props) {
      const kind = String(database?.kind || 'postgres').toLowerCase();
      const endpoint = useMemo(() => `/database-management/${kind}/{id}/swarm-settings`, [kind]);
      const query = $api.useQuery('get', endpoint as any, { params: { path: { id: database?.id } } } as any, { enabled: !!database?.id } as any);
      const save = $api.useMutation('put', endpoint as any);
      const [values, setValues] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
      const [grace, setGrace] = useState('');
    
      useEffect(() => {
        const data: any = query.data || {};
        setValues(Object.fromEntries(fields.map(([key]) => [key, data[key] || ''])));
        setGrace(data.stop_grace_period_swarm == null ? '' : String(data.stop_grace_period_swarm));
      }, [query.data]);
    
      const update = (key: string, value: string) => setValues(current => ({ ...current, [key]: value }));
      const saveSettings = async () => {
        try {
          await save.mutateAsync({
            params: { path: { id: database?.id } },
            body: { ...values, stop_grace_period_swarm: grace.trim() ? Number(grace) : null },
          } as any);
          toast.success('Swarm settings updated');
          onUpdated();
        } catch (error) { toast.error(formatApiError(error)); }
      };
    
      return <section className="flex flex-col gap-5 rounded-2xl border border-border/80 bg-card p-6 shadow-sm">
        <div>
          <h3 className="flex items-center gap-2 text-base font-bold"><ServerCog className="size-4 text-primary" /> Swarm Settings</h3>
          <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">Dokploy-compatible health, restart, rollout, placement, network, label and endpoint controls. Enter valid Docker Engine JSON.</p>
        </div>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 border-t border-border/40 pt-4 md:grid-cols-2">
          {fields.map(([key, label]) => <label key={key} className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">

    import {Button} from '#/components/ui/button';
    import {Input} from '#/components/ui/input';
    import {Textarea} from '#/components/ui/textarea';
    import {Dialog, DialogContent, DialogDescription, DialogFooter, DialogHeader, DialogTitle} from '#/components/ui/dialog';
    import {toast} from 'sonner';
    import {$api} from '#/api/query';
    import {formatApiError} from '#/api/utils';
    
    type Props = {database: any; onUpdated: () => void};
    const fields = [
    	['health_check_swarm', 'Health Check', 'Configure container health checks.'],
    	['restart_policy_swarm', 'Restart Policy', 'Control restart condition and retry behavior.'],
    	['placement_swarm', 'Placement', 'Configure Swarm node constraints.'],
    	['update_config_swarm', 'Update Config', 'Configure rolling update behavior.'],
    	['rollback_config_swarm', 'Rollback Config', 'Configure automatic rollback behavior.'],
    	['mode_swarm', 'Mode', 'Configure replicated or global mode.'],
    	['network_swarm', 'Network', 'Configure service network attachments.'],
    	['labels_swarm', 'Labels', 'Add service labels as key-value JSON.'],
    	['endpoint_spec_swarm', 'Endpoint Spec', 'Configure VIP or DNS round-robin.'],
    	['ulimits_swarm', 'Ulimits', 'Configure container ulimits.'],
    ] as const;
    
    export function DatabaseSwarmSettings({database, onUpdated}: Props) {
    	const kind = String(database?.kind || 'postgres').toLowerCase();
    	const endpoint = useMemo(() => `/database-management/${kind}/{id}/swarm-settings`, [kind]);
    	const query = $api.useQuery('get', endpoint as any, {params: {path: {id: database?.id}}} as any);
    	const save = $api.useMutation('put', endpoint as any);
    	const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
    	const [active, setActive] = useState<(typeof fields)[number][0]>('health_check_swarm');
    	const [values, setValues] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
    	const [grace, setGrace] = useState('');
    
    	useEffect(() => {
    		const data: any = query.data || {};
    		setValues(Object.fromEntries(fields.map(([key]) => [key, data[key] || ''])));
    		setGrace(data.stop_grace_period_swarm == null ? '' : String(data.stop_grace_period_swarm));
    	}, [query.data]);
    
    	const selected = fields.find(([key]) => key === active)!;
    	const saveSettings = async () => {
    		try {
    			await save.mutateAsync({params: {path: {id: database?.id}}, body: {...values, stop_grace_period_swarm: grace.trim() ? Number(grace) : null}} as any);
    			toast.success('Swarm settings updated'); setOpen(false); onUpdated();
    		} catch (error) {toast.error(formatApiError(error));}
    	};
    
    	return <section className="flex flex-col gap-5 rounded-2xl border border-border/80 bg-card p-6 shadow-sm">
    		<div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-4"><div><h3 className="flex items-center gap-2 text-base font-bold"><ServerCog className="size-4 text-primary" /> Cluster Settings</h3><p className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">Modify Docker Swarm settings for this database service.</p></div><Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => setOpen(true)} className="h-9 gap-1.5 text-xs"><Settings className="size-4" /> Swarm Settings</Button></div>
    		<div className="rounded-lg border border-blue-500/20 bg-blue-500/5 p-3 text-xs text-muted-foreground">Redeploy after changing cluster settings to apply them.</div>
    		<Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}><DialogContent className="flex max-h-[85vh] flex-col sm:max-w-6xl"><DialogHeader><DialogTitle>Swarm Settings</DialogTitle><DialogDescription>Configure advanced Docker Swarm settings for this database.</DialogDescription></DialogHeader><div className="flex min-h-0 flex-1 flex-col gap-4 overflow-hidden py-2 md:flex-row"><nav className="flex shrink-0 gap-1 overflow-x-auto border-b pb-3 md:w-64 md:flex-col md:overflow-y-auto md:border-r md:border-b-0 md:pr-4">{fields.map(([key, label, description]) => <button type="button" key={key} onClick={() => setActive(key)} className={`min-w-40 rounded-md px-3 py-2 text-left text-xs transition-colors md:min-w-0 ${active === key ? 'bg-primary text-primary-foreground' : 'hover:bg-muted'}`}><span className="block font-medium">{label}</span><span className="mt-0.5 block opacity-75">{description}</span></button>)}<button type="button" onClick={() => setActive('stop_grace_period_swarm' as any)} className={`min-w-40 rounded-md px-3 py-2 text-left text-xs md:min-w-0 ${active === ('stop_grace_period_swarm' as any) ? 'bg-primary text-primary-foreground' : 'hover:bg-muted'}`}><span className="block font-medium">Stop Grace Period</span><span className="mt-0.5 block opacity-75">Graceful shutdown timeout.</span></button></nav><div className="min-h-64 flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-1">{active === ('stop_grace_period_swarm' as any) ? <label className="flex max-w-md flex-col gap-2 text-sm font-medium">Stop Grace Period (nanoseconds)<Input type="number" value={grace} onChange={event => setGrace(event.target.value)} placeholder="30000000000" /></label> : <div className="flex flex-col gap-3"><div><h4 className="text-sm font-semibold">{selected[1]}</h4><p className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">{selected[2]} Enter valid Docker Engine JSON.</p></div><Textarea value={values[active] || ''} onChange={event => setValues(current => ({...current, [active]: event.target.value}))} placeholder="{}" className="min-h-72 font-mono text-xs" /></div>}</div></div><DialogFooter><Button onClick={saveSettings} disabled={save.isPending} className="gap-1.5"><Save className="size-4" />{save.isPending ? 'Saving...' : 'Save Swarm Settings'}</Button></DialogFooter></DialogContent></Dialog>

     if(keyName==='update_config_swarm'||keyName==='rollback_config_swarm')return <div className="grid max-w-2xl gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2"><Num label="Parallelism" value={value.Parallelism} set={v=>set('Parallelism',v)}/><Num label="Delay (nanoseconds)" value={value.Delay} set={v=>set('Delay',v)}/><Field label="Failure Action"><select className="h-9 rounded-md border bg-background px-2 text-sm" value={value.FailureAction||'pause'} onChange={e=>set('FailureAction',e.target.value)}><option>pause</option><option>continue</option><option>rollback</option></select></Field><Field label="Order"><select className="h-9 rounded-md border bg-background px-2 text-sm" value={value.Order||'stop-first'} onChange={e=>set('Order',e.target.value)}><option>stop-first</option><option>start-first</option></select></Field><Num label="Monitor (nanoseconds)" value={value.Monitor} set={v=>set('Monitor',v)}/><Num label="Max Failure Ratio" value={value.MaxFailureRatio} set={v=>set('MaxFailureRatio',v)}/></div>;
     if(keyName==='health_check_swarm')return <div className="grid max-w-2xl gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2"><Field label="Test command"><Input value={value.Test||''} onChange={e=>set('Test',e.target.value)} placeholder="CMD-SHELL healthcheck"/></Field><Num label="Interval (nanoseconds)" value={value.Interval} set={v=>set('Interval',v)}/><Num label="Timeout (nanoseconds)" value={value.Timeout} set={v=>set('Timeout',v)}/><Num label="Retries" value={value.Retries} set={v=>set('Retries',v)}/><Num label="Start Period (nanoseconds)" value={value.StartPeriod} set={v=>set('StartPeriod',v)}/></div>;
     if(keyName==='placement_swarm')return <Field label="Constraints (comma separated)"><Input value={value.Constraints||''} onChange={e=>set('Constraints',e.target.value)} placeholder="node.role==manager,node.labels.zone==prod"/></Field>;
     if(keyName==='network_swarm')return <div className="grid max-w-2xl gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2"><Field label="Network target"><Input value={value.Target||''} onChange={e=>set('Target',e.target.value)} placeholder="openoxide-network"/></Field><Field label="Aliases (comma separated)"><Input value={value.Aliases||''} onChange={e=>set('Aliases',e.target.value)}/></Field></div>;
     if(keyName==='labels_swarm')return <div className="grid max-w-2xl gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2"><Field label="Label key"><Input value={value.key||''} onChange={e=>set('key',e.target.value)} placeholder="com.example.role"/></Field><Field label="Label value"><Input value={value.value||''} onChange={e=>set('value',e.target.value)} placeholder="database"/></Field></div>;
     if(keyName==='endpoint_spec_swarm')return <Field label="Endpoint mode"><select className="h-9 max-w-md rounded-md border bg-background px-2 text-sm" value={value.Mode||'vip'} onChange={e=>set('Mode',e.target.value)}><option value="vip">VIP (Virtual IP)</option><option value="dnsrr">DNS Round Robin</option></select></Field>;
     return <div className="grid max-w-2xl gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2"><Num label="nofile soft" value={value.nofile_soft} set={v=>set('nofile_soft',v)}/><Num label="nofile hard" value={value.nofile_hard} set={v=>set('nofile_hard',v)}/></div>;
    }
    function Num({label,value,set}:{label:string;value:any;set:(value:number)=>void}){return <Field label={label}><Input type="number" value={value??''} onChange={e=>set(Number(e.target.value))}/></Field>}
    function Field({label,children}:{label:string;children:React.ReactNode}){return <label className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 text-xs font-medium">{label}{children}</label>}

    type Props = {section: SwarmKey; value: any; set: (key: string, value: any) => void};

     if (section === 'mode_swarm') return <div className="grid max-w-lg gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2"><Field label="Service Mode"><select className="h-9 rounded-md border bg-background px-2 text-sm" value={value.type || 'Replicated'} onChange={e => set('type', e.target.value)}><option>Replicated</option><option>Global</option></select></Field>{value.type !== 'Global' && <NumberField label="Replicas" value={value.Replicas} set={v => set('Replicas', v)} />}</div>;

     if (section === 'update_config_swarm' || section === 'rollback_config_swarm') return <div className="grid max-w-2xl gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2"><NumberField label="Parallelism" value={value.Parallelism} set={v => set('Parallelism', v)} /><NumberField label="Delay (nanoseconds)" value={value.Delay} set={v => set('Delay', v)} /><Field label="Failure Action"><select className="h-9 rounded-md border bg-background px-2 text-sm" value={value.FailureAction || 'pause'} onChange={e => set('FailureAction', e.target.value)}><option>pause</option><option>continue</option><option>rollback</option></select></Field><Field label="Order"><select className="h-9 rounded-md border bg-background px-2 text-sm" value={value.Order || 'stop-first'} onChange={e => set('Order', e.target.value)}><option>stop-first</option><option>start-first</option></select></Field><NumberField label="Monitor (nanoseconds)" value={value.Monitor} set={v => set('Monitor', v)} /><NumberField label="Max Failure Ratio" value={value.MaxFailureRatio} set={v => set('MaxFailureRatio', v)} /></div>;
     if (section === 'health_check_swarm') return <div className="grid max-w-2xl gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2"><Field label="Test command"><Input value={value.Test || ''} onChange={e => set('Test', e.target.value)} placeholder="curl -f http://localhost/health || exit 1" /></Field><NumberField label="Interval (nanoseconds)" value={value.Interval} set={v => set('Interval', v)} /><NumberField label="Timeout (nanoseconds)" value={value.Timeout} set={v => set('Timeout', v)} /><NumberField label="Retries" value={value.Retries} set={v => set('Retries', v)} /><NumberField label="Start Period (nanoseconds)" value={value.StartPeriod} set={v => set('StartPeriod', v)} /></div>;
     if (section === 'placement_swarm') return <div className="flex max-w-2xl flex-col gap-4"><Field label="Constraints (comma separated)"><Input value={value.Constraints || ''} onChange={e => set('Constraints', e.target.value)} placeholder="node.role==manager" /></Field><Field label="Preferences (spread descriptors, comma separated)"><Input value={value.Preferences || ''} onChange={e => set('Preferences', e.target.value)} placeholder="node.labels.zone" /></Field><Field label="Platforms (architecture:os, comma separated)"><Input value={value.Platforms || ''} onChange={e => set('Platforms', e.target.value)} placeholder="amd64:linux,arm64:linux" /></Field><NumberField label="Max Replicas Per Node" value={value.MaxReplicas} set={v => set('MaxReplicas', v)} /></div>;
     if (section === 'network_swarm') return <div className="grid max-w-2xl gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2"><Field label="Network target"><Input value={value.Target || ''} onChange={e => set('Target', e.target.value)} placeholder="openoxide-network" /></Field><Field label="Aliases (comma separated)"><Input value={value.Aliases || ''} onChange={e => set('Aliases', e.target.value)} /></Field><Field label="Driver option key"><Input value={value.DriverOptKey || ''} onChange={e => set('DriverOptKey', e.target.value)} placeholder="com.docker.network.driver.mtu" /></Field><Field label="Driver option value"><Input value={value.DriverOptValue || ''} onChange={e => set('DriverOptValue', e.target.value)} placeholder="1500" /></Field></div>;
     if (section === 'labels_swarm') return <div className="grid max-w-2xl gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2"><Field label="Label key"><Input value={value.key || ''} onChange={e => set('key', e.target.value)} placeholder="com.example.role" /></Field><Field label="Label value"><Input value={value.value || ''} onChange={e => set('value', e.target.value)} placeholder="database" /></Field></div>;
     if (section === 'endpoint_spec_swarm') return <Field label="Endpoint mode"><select className="h-9 max-w-md rounded-md border bg-background px-2 text-sm" value={value.Mode || 'vip'} onChange={e => set('Mode', e.target.value)}><option value="vip">VIP (Virtual IP)</option><option value="dnsrr">DNS Round Robin</option></select></Field>;
     return <div className="grid max-w-2xl gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2"><NumberField label="nofile soft" value={value.nofile_soft} set={v => set('nofile_soft', v)} /><NumberField label="nofile hard" value={value.nofile_hard} set={v => set('nofile_hard', v)} /></div>;
    }

    function Field({label, children}: {label: string; children: React.ReactNode}) {return <label className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 text-xs font-medium">{label}{children}</label>;}
