    import {Input} from '#/components/ui/input';
    
    export type SwarmKey =
    	| 'health_check_swarm'
    	| 'restart_policy_swarm'
    	| 'placement_swarm'
    	| 'update_config_swarm'
    	| 'rollback_config_swarm'
    	| 'mode_swarm'
    	| 'network_swarm'
    	| 'labels_swarm'
    	| 'endpoint_spec_swarm'
    	| 'ulimits_swarm';
    type Props = {
    	section: SwarmKey;
    	value: any;
    	set: (key: string, value: any) => void;
    };
    
    export function SwarmSettingsForm({section, value, set}: Props) {
    	if (section === 'mode_swarm')
    		return (
    			<div className="grid max-w-lg gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
    				<Field label="Service Mode">
    					<select
    						className="h-9 rounded-md border bg-background px-2 text-sm"
    						value={value.type || 'Replicated'}
    						onChange={e => set('type', e.target.value)}>
    						<option>Replicated</option>
    						<option>Global</option>
    					</select>
    				</Field>
    				{value.type !== 'Global' && (
    					<NumberField
    						label="Replicas"
    						value={value.Replicas}
    						set={v => set('Replicas', v)}
    					/>
    				)}
    			</div>
    		);
    	if (section === 'restart_policy_swarm')
    		return (
    			<div className="grid max-w-2xl gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
    				<Field label="Condition">
    					<select
    						className="h-9 rounded-md border bg-background px-2 text-sm"
    						value={value.Condition || 'on-failure'}
    						onChange={e => set('Condition', e.target.value)}>
    						<option value="none">None</option>
    						<option value="on-failure">On Failure</option>
    						<option value="any">Any</option>
    					</select>
    				</Field>
    				<NumberField
    					label="Delay (nanoseconds)"
    					value={value.Delay}
    					set={v => set('Delay', v)}
    				/>
    				<NumberField
    					label="Max Attempts"
    					value={value.MaxAttempts}
    					set={v => set('MaxAttempts', v)}
    				/>
    				<NumberField
    					label="Window (nanoseconds)"
    					value={value.Window}
    					set={v => set('Window', v)}
    				/>
    			</div>
    		);
    	if (
    		section === 'update_config_swarm' ||
    		section === 'rollback_config_swarm'
    	)
    		return (
    			<div className="grid max-w-2xl gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
    				<NumberField
    					label="Parallelism"
    					value={value.Parallelism}
    					set={v => set('Parallelism', v)}
    				/>
    				<NumberField
    					label="Delay (nanoseconds)"
    					value={value.Delay}
    					set={v => set('Delay', v)}
    				/>
    				<Field label="Failure Action">
    					<select
    						className="h-9 rounded-md border bg-background px-2 text-sm"
    						value={value.FailureAction || 'pause'}
    						onChange={e => set('FailureAction', e.target.value)}>
    						<option>pause</option>
    						<option>continue</option>
    						<option>rollback</option>
    					</select>
    				</Field>
    				<Field label="Order">
    					<select
    						className="h-9 rounded-md border bg-background px-2 text-sm"
    						value={value.Order || 'stop-first'}
    						onChange={e => set('Order', e.target.value)}>
    						<option>stop-first</option>
    						<option>start-first</option>
    					</select>
    				</Field>
    				<NumberField
    					label="Monitor (nanoseconds)"
    					value={value.Monitor}
    					set={v => set('Monitor', v)}
    				/>
    				<NumberField
    					label="Max Failure Ratio"
    					value={value.MaxFailureRatio}
    					set={v => set('MaxFailureRatio', v)}
    				/>
    			</div>
    		);
    	if (section === 'health_check_swarm')
    		return (
    			<div className="grid max-w-2xl gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
    				<Field label="Test command">
    					<Input
    						value={value.Test || ''}
    						onChange={e => set('Test', e.target.value)}
    						placeholder="curl -f http://localhost/health || exit 1"
    					/>
    				</Field>
    				<NumberField
    					label="Interval (nanoseconds)"
    					value={value.Interval}
    					set={v => set('Interval', v)}
    				/>
    				<NumberField
    					label="Timeout (nanoseconds)"
    					value={value.Timeout}
    					set={v => set('Timeout', v)}
    				/>
    				<NumberField
    					label="Retries"
    					value={value.Retries}
    					set={v => set('Retries', v)}
    				/>
    				<NumberField
    					label="Start Period (nanoseconds)"
    					value={value.StartPeriod}
    					set={v => set('StartPeriod', v)}
    				/>
    			</div>
    		);
    	if (section === 'placement_swarm')
    		return (
    			<div className="flex max-w-2xl flex-col gap-4">
    				<Field label="Constraints (comma separated)">
    					<Input
    						value={value.Constraints || ''}
    						onChange={e => set('Constraints', e.target.value)}
    						placeholder="node.role==manager"
    					/>
    				</Field>
    				<Field label="Preferences (spread descriptors, comma separated)">
    					<Input
    						value={value.Preferences || ''}
    						onChange={e => set('Preferences', e.target.value)}
    						placeholder="node.labels.zone"
    					/>
    				</Field>
    				<Field label="Platforms (architecture:os, comma separated)">
    					<Input
    						value={value.Platforms || ''}
    						onChange={e => set('Platforms', e.target.value)}
    						placeholder="amd64:linux,arm64:linux"
    					/>
    				</Field>
    				<NumberField
    					label="Max Replicas Per Node"
    					value={value.MaxReplicas}
    					set={v => set('MaxReplicas', v)}
    				/>
    			</div>
    		);
    	if (section === 'network_swarm')
    		return (
    			<div className="grid max-w-2xl gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
    				<Field label="Network target">
    					<Input
    						value={value.Target || ''}
    						onChange={e => set('Target', e.target.value)}
    						placeholder="openoxide-network"
    					/>
    				</Field>
    				<Field label="Aliases (comma separated)">
    					<Input
    						value={value.Aliases || ''}
    						onChange={e => set('Aliases', e.target.value)}
    					/>
    				</Field>
    				<Field label="Driver option key">
    					<Input
    						value={value.DriverOptKey || ''}
    						onChange={e => set('DriverOptKey', e.target.value)}
    						placeholder="com.docker.network.driver.mtu"
    					/>
    				</Field>
    				<Field label="Driver option value">
    					<Input
    						value={value.DriverOptValue || ''}
    						onChange={e => set('DriverOptValue', e.target.value)}
    						placeholder="1500"
    					/>
    				</Field>
    			</div>
    		);
    	if (section === 'labels_swarm')
    		return (
    			<div className="grid max-w-2xl gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
    				<Field label="Label key">
    					<Input
    						value={value.key || ''}
    						onChange={e => set('key', e.target.value)}
    						placeholder="com.example.role"
    					/>
    				</Field>
    				<Field label="Label value">
    					<Input
    						value={value.value || ''}
    						onChange={e => set('value', e.target.value)}
    						placeholder="database"
    					/>
    				</Field>
    			</div>
    		);
    	if (section === 'endpoint_spec_swarm')
    		return (
    			<Field label="Endpoint mode">
    				<select
    					className="h-9 max-w-md rounded-md border bg-background px-2 text-sm"
    					value={value.Mode || 'vip'}
    					onChange={e => set('Mode', e.target.value)}>
    					<option value="vip">VIP (Virtual IP)</option>
    					<option value="dnsrr">DNS Round Robin</option>
    				</select>
    			</Field>
    		);
    	return (
    		<div className="grid max-w-2xl gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
    			<NumberField
    				label="nofile soft"
    				value={value.nofile_soft}
    				set={v => set('nofile_soft', v)}
    			/>
    			<NumberField
    				label="nofile hard"
    				value={value.nofile_hard}
    				set={v => set('nofile_hard', v)}
    			/>
    		</div>
    	);
    }
    function NumberField({
    	label,
    	value,
    	set,
    }: {
    	label: string;
    	value: any;
    	set: (value: number) => void;
    }) {
    	return (
    		<Field label={label}>
    			<Input
    				type="number"
    				value={value ?? ''}
    				onChange={e => set(Number(e.target.value))}
    			/>
    		</Field>
    	);
    }
    function Field({
    	label,
    	children,
    }: {
    	label: string;
    	children: React.ReactNode;
    }) {
    	return (
    		<label className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 text-xs font-medium">
    			{label}
    			{children}
    		</label>
    	);
    }

    import {useEffect, useMemo, useState} from 'react';
    import {toast} from 'sonner';
    import {$api} from '#/api/query';
    import {formatApiError} from '#/api/utils';
    import type {SwarmKey} from './swarm-settings-forms';
    
    export const swarmSections: ReadonlyArray<[SwarmKey, string]> = [['health_check_swarm','Health Check'],['restart_policy_swarm','Restart Policy'],['placement_swarm','Placement'],['update_config_swarm','Update Config'],['rollback_config_swarm','Rollback Config'],['mode_swarm','Mode'],['network_swarm','Network'],['labels_swarm','Labels'],['endpoint_spec_swarm','Endpoint Spec'],['ulimits_swarm','Ulimits']];
    const defaults:any={mode_swarm:{type:'Replicated',Replicas:1},restart_policy_swarm:{Condition:'on-failure'},update_config_swarm:{FailureAction:'rollback',Order:'stop-first'},rollback_config_swarm:{FailureAction:'pause',Order:'stop-first'},endpoint_spec_swarm:{Mode:'vip'}};
    
    export function useDatabaseSwarmSettings(database:any,onUpdated:()=>void){
     const kind=String(database?.kind||'postgres').toLowerCase(); const endpoint=useMemo(()=>`/database-management/${kind}/{id}/swarm-settings`,[kind]); const query=$api.useQuery('get',endpoint as any,{params:{path:{id:database?.id}}} as any); const save=$api.useMutation('put',endpoint as any); const [active,setActive]=useState<SwarmKey>('mode_swarm'); const [values,setValues]=useState<any>({...defaults}); const [grace,setGrace]=useState('');
     useEffect(()=>{const data:any=query.data||{};const next:any={...defaults};swarmSections.forEach(([key])=>{if(data[key])try{next[key]={...next[key],...JSON.parse(data[key])}}catch{}});setValues(next);setGrace(data.stop_grace_period_swarm==null?'':String(data.stop_grace_period_swarm));},[query.data]);
     const set=(key:string,value:any)=>setValues((old:any)=>({...old,[active]:{...old[active],[key]:value}}));
     const saveAll=async()=>{try{const body:any={};swarmSections.forEach(([key])=>serialize(body,key,{...values[key]}));await save.mutateAsync({params:{path:{id:database?.id}},body:{...body,stop_grace_period_swarm:grace?Number(grace):null}} as any);toast.success('Swarm settings updated');onUpdated();return true}catch(error){toast.error(formatApiError(error));return false}};
     return {active,setActive,values,set,grace,setGrace,saveAll,saving:save.isPending};
    }
    
    function serialize(body:any,key:SwarmKey,value:any){
     if(key==='mode_swarm'){body[key]=JSON.stringify(value.type==='Global'?{Global:{}}:{Replicated:{Replicas:Number(value.Replicas||1)}});return}
     if(key==='health_check_swarm'&&value.Test)value.Test=value.Test.startsWith('CMD')?[value.Test]:['CMD-SHELL',value.Test];
     if(key==='placement_swarm'){if(typeof value.Constraints==='string')value.Constraints=csv(value.Constraints);if(typeof value.Preferences==='string')value.Preferences=csv(value.Preferences).map((SpreadDescriptor:string)=>({SpreadDescriptor}));if(typeof value.Platforms==='string')value.Platforms=csv(value.Platforms).map((item:string)=>{const[Architecture,OS]=item.split(':');return{Architecture,OS}})}
     if(key==='network_swarm'){if(typeof value.Aliases==='string')value.Aliases=csv(value.Aliases);if(value.DriverOptKey)value.DriverOpts={[value.DriverOptKey]:value.DriverOptValue||''};delete value.DriverOptKey;delete value.DriverOptValue}

    }

    import {useEffect, useMemo, useState} from 'react';
    import {Save, Settings, ServerCog} from 'lucide-react';
    import {Button} from '#/components/ui/button';
    import {Input} from '#/components/ui/input';
    import {
    	Dialog,
    	DialogContent,
    	DialogDescription,
    	DialogFooter,
    	DialogHeader,
    	DialogTitle,
    } from '#/components/ui/dialog';
    import {toast} from 'sonner';
    import {$api} from '#/api/query';
    import {formatApiError} from '#/api/utils';
    import {SwarmSettingsForm, type SwarmKey} from './swarm-settings-forms';
    
    type Props = {database: any; onUpdated: () => void};
    const sections = [
    	['health_check_swarm', 'Health Check'],
    	['restart_policy_swarm', 'Restart Policy'],
    	['placement_swarm', 'Placement'],
    	['update_config_swarm', 'Update Config'],
    	['rollback_config_swarm', 'Rollback Config'],
    	['mode_swarm', 'Mode'],
    	['network_swarm', 'Network'],
    	['labels_swarm', 'Labels'],
    	['endpoint_spec_swarm', 'Endpoint Spec'],
    	['ulimits_swarm', 'Ulimits'],
    ] as const;
    type Key = SwarmKey;
    const defaults: any = {
    	mode_swarm: {type: 'Replicated', Replicas: 1},
    	restart_policy_swarm: {Condition: 'on-failure'},
    	update_config_swarm: {FailureAction: 'rollback', Order: 'stop-first'},
    	rollback_config_swarm: {FailureAction: 'pause', Order: 'stop-first'},
    	endpoint_spec_swarm: {Mode: 'vip'},
    };
    
    export function DatabaseSwarmSettings({database, onUpdated}: Props) {
    	const kind = String(database?.kind || 'postgres').toLowerCase();
    	const endpoint = useMemo(
    		() => `/database-management/${kind}/{id}/swarm-settings`,
    		[kind],
    	);
    	const query = $api.useQuery(
    		'get',
    		endpoint as any,
    		{params: {path: {id: database?.id}}} as any,
    	);
    	const save = $api.useMutation('put', endpoint as any);
    	const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
    	const [active, setActive] = useState<Key>('mode_swarm');
    	const [values, setValues] = useState<any>({...defaults});
    	const [grace, setGrace] = useState('');
    	useEffect(() => {
    		const data: any = query.data || {};
    		const next: any = {...defaults};
    		sections.forEach(([key]) => {
    			if (data[key])
    				try {
    					next[key] = {...next[key], ...JSON.parse(data[key])};
    				} catch {}
    		});
    		setValues(next);
    		setGrace(
    			data.stop_grace_period_swarm == null
    				? ''
    				: String(data.stop_grace_period_swarm),
    		);
    	}, [query.data]);
    	const set = (key: string, value: any) =>
    		setValues((old: any) => ({
    			...old,
    			[active]: {...old[active], [key]: value},
    		}));
    	const saveAll = async () => {
    		try {
    			const body: any = {};
    			sections.forEach(([key]) => {
    				const value = {...values[key]};
    				if (key === 'mode_swarm') {
    					body[key] = JSON.stringify(
    						value.type === 'Global'
    							? {Global: {}}
    							: {Replicated: {Replicas: Number(value.Replicas || 1)}},
    					);
    					return;
    				}
    				if (key === 'health_check_swarm' && value.Test) {
    					value.Test = value.Test.startsWith('CMD')
    						? [value.Test]
    						: ['CMD-SHELL', value.Test];
    				}
    				if (key === 'placement_swarm') {
    					if (typeof value.Constraints === 'string')
    						value.Constraints = csv(value.Constraints);
    					if (typeof value.Preferences === 'string')
    						value.Preferences = csv(value.Preferences).map(
    							(SpreadDescriptor: string) => ({SpreadDescriptor}),
    						);
    					if (typeof value.Platforms === 'string')
    						value.Platforms = csv(value.Platforms).map((item: string) => {
    							const [Architecture, OS] = item.split(':');
    							return {Architecture, OS};
    						});
    				}
    				if (key === 'network_swarm') {
    					if (typeof value.Aliases === 'string')
    						value.Aliases = csv(value.Aliases);
    					if (value.DriverOptKey)
    						value.DriverOpts = {
    							[value.DriverOptKey]: value.DriverOptValue || '',
    						};
    					delete value.DriverOptKey;
    					delete value.DriverOptValue;
    				}
    				if (key === 'labels_swarm' && value.key) {
    					body[key] = JSON.stringify({[value.key]: value.value || ''});
    				} else {
    					delete value.key;
    					delete value.value;
    					body[key] = Object.keys(value).length
    						? JSON.stringify(value)
    						: null;
    				}
    			});
    			await save.mutateAsync({
    				params: {path: {id: database?.id}},
    				body: {
    					...body,
    					stop_grace_period_swarm: grace ? Number(grace) : null,
    				},
    			} as any);
    			toast.success('Swarm settings updated');
    			setOpen(false);
    			onUpdated();
    		} catch (error) {
    			toast.error(formatApiError(error));
    		}
    	};
    	return (
    		<section className="flex flex-col gap-5 rounded-2xl border border-border/80 bg-card p-6 shadow-sm">
    			<div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-4">
    				<div>
    					<h3 className="flex items-center gap-2 text-base font-bold">
    						<ServerCog className="size-4 text-primary" /> Cluster Settings
    					</h3>
    					<p className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
    						Configure Docker Swarm service behavior.
    					</p>
    				</div>
    				<Button
    					variant="secondary"
    					onClick={() => setOpen(true)}
    					className="h-9 gap-1.5 text-xs">
    					<Settings className="size-4" /> Swarm Settings
    				</Button>
    			</div>
    			<div className="rounded-lg border border-blue-500/20 bg-blue-500/5 p-3 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
    				Redeploy after changing cluster settings to apply them.
    			</div>
    			<Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
    				<DialogContent className="flex max-h-[85vh] flex-col sm:max-w-6xl">
    					<DialogHeader>
    						<DialogTitle>Swarm Settings</DialogTitle>
    						<DialogDescription>
    							Configure advanced options with normal controls.
    						</DialogDescription>
    					</DialogHeader>
    					<div className="flex min-h-0 flex-1 flex-col gap-4 overflow-hidden py-2 md:flex-row">
    						<nav className="flex shrink-0 gap-1 overflow-x-auto border-b pb-3 md:w-56 md:flex-col md:overflow-y-auto md:border-r md:border-b-0 md:pr-4">
    							{sections.map(([key, label]) => (
    								<button
    									type="button"
    									key={key}
    									onClick={() => setActive(key)}
    									className={`rounded-md px-3 py-2 text-left text-xs ${active === key ? 'bg-primary text-primary-foreground' : 'hover:bg-muted'}`}>
    									{label}
    								</button>
    							))}
    							<button
    								type="button"
    								onClick={() => setActive('stop_grace_period_swarm' as Key)}
    								className={`rounded-md px-3 py-2 text-left text-xs ${active === 'stop_grace_period_swarm' ? 'bg-primary text-primary-foreground' : 'hover:bg-muted'}`}>
    								Stop Grace Period
    							</button>
    						</nav>
    						<div className="min-h-64 flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-1">
    							{active === 'stop_grace_period_swarm' ? (
    								<Field label="Stop Grace Period (nanoseconds)">
    									<Input
    										type="number"
    										value={grace}
    										onChange={e => setGrace(e.target.value)}
    										placeholder="30000000000"
    									/>
    								</Field>
    							) : (
    								<SwarmSettingsForm
    									section={active}
    									value={values[active] || {}}
    									set={set}
    								/>
    							)}
    						</div>
    					</div>
    					<DialogFooter>
    						<Button
    							onClick={saveAll}
    							disabled={save.isPending}
    							className="gap-1.5">
    							<Save className="size-4" />
    							{save.isPending ? 'Saving...' : 'Save Swarm Settings'}
    						</Button>
    					</DialogFooter>
    				</DialogContent>
    			</Dialog>
    		</section>
    	);
    }
    function Field({
    	label,
    	children,
    }: {
    	label: string;
    	children: React.ReactNode;
    }) {
    	return (
    		<label className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 text-xs font-medium">
    			{label}
    			{children}
    		</label>
    	);
    }
    function csv(value: string) {
    	return value
    		.split(',')
    		.map(item => item.trim())
    		.filter(Boolean);
    }

    import {Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue} from '#/components/ui/select';
    
    type Option = {value: string; label: string};
    type Props = {label: string; value: string; options: Option[]; onChange: (value: string) => void};
    
    export function SwarmSelectField({label, value, options, onChange}: Props) {
    	return <label className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 text-xs font-medium">{label}<Select value={value} onValueChange={next => next && onChange(next)}><SelectTrigger className="w-full"><SelectValue placeholder={`Select ${label.toLowerCase()}`} /></SelectTrigger><SelectContent>{options.map(option => <SelectItem key={option.value} value={option.value}>{option.label}</SelectItem>)}</SelectContent></Select></label>;
    }

    +fn apply_network_setting(
    +    raw: &str,
    +    service: &mut StackService,
    +    networks: &mut BTreeMap<String, ExternalNetwork>,
    +) -> ExecResult<()> {
    +    let value: serde_json::Value = parse_setting(raw, "network")?;
    +    let attachments = value.as_array().cloned().unwrap_or_else(|| vec![value]);
    +    for attachment in attachments {
    +        let Some(target) = string_field_opt(&attachment, "Target", "target") else {
    +            return Err(ExecError::CommandFailed {
    +                code: None,
    +                stderr: "Database Swarm network target is required".to_string(),
    +            });
    +        };
    +        let aliases = array_field(&attachment, "Aliases", "aliases");
    +        let driver_opts = field(&attachment, "DriverOpts", "driver_opts")
    +            .and_then(|v| serde_json::from_value(v.clone()).ok())
    +            .unwrap_or_default();
    +        service.networks.insert(
    +            target.clone(),
    +            ServiceNetworkAttachment {
    +                aliases,
    +                driver_opts,
    +            },
    +        );
    +        networks.entry(target.clone()).or_insert(ExternalNetwork {
    +            external: true,
    +            name: target,
    +        });
    +    }
    +    Ok(())
    +}

    import { mkdir, readFile, readdir, rm, writeFile } from "node:fs/promises";
    import path from "node:path";
    
    const sourceDir = "src/db/repository";
    const outputDir = "db/queries/repository";
    const maxLines = 180;
    
    const pascal = (value) =>
      value
        .split(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]+/)
        .filter(Boolean)
        .map((part) => part[0].toUpperCase() + part.slice(1))
        .join("");
    
    function readString(source, start) {
      if (source[start] === "r") {
        const match = source.slice(start).match(/^r(#{0,16})"/);
        if (match) {
          const marker = `"${match[1]}`;
          const contentStart = start + match[0].length;
          const end = source.indexOf(marker, contentStart);
          if (end >= 0) return { value: source.slice(contentStart, end), end: end + marker.length };
        }
      }
      if (source[start] !== '"') return null;
      let index = start + 1;
      while (index < source.length) {
        if (source[index] === "\\") index += 2;
        else if (source[index++] === '"') break;
      }
      const literal = source.slice(start, index).replace(/\\\r?\n\s*/g, "");
      try {
        return { value: JSON.parse(literal), end: index };
      } catch {
        return { value: literal.slice(1, -1), end: index };
      }
    }
    
    function matchingBrace(source, opening) {
      let depth = 1;
      for (let index = opening + 1; index < source.length; index += 1) {
        const string = readString(source, index);
        if (string) {
          index = string.end - 1;
          continue;
        }
        if (source.startsWith("//", index)) {
          index = source.indexOf("\n", index);
          if (index < 0) return source.length;
        } else if (source.startsWith("/*", index)) {
          index = source.indexOf("*/", index + 2) + 1;
        } else if (source[index] === "{") depth += 1;
        else if (source[index] === "}" && --depth === 0) return index;
      }
      return source.length;
    }
    
    function methods(source) {
      const found = [];
      const pattern = /(?:pub(?:\([^)]*\))?\s+)?async\s+fn\s+([a-zA-Z0-9_]+)/g;
      for (const match of source.matchAll(pattern)) {
        const opening = source.indexOf("{", match.index + match[0].length);
        const end = matchingBrace(source, opening);
        found.push({ name: match[1], body: source.slice(opening + 1, end) });
        pattern.lastIndex = end + 1;
      }
      return found;
    }
    
    function sqlStrings(body) {
      const values = [];
      for (let index = 0; index < body.length; index += 1) {
        const string = readString(body, index);
        if (!string) continue;
        index = string.end - 1;
        const sql = string.value.trim();
        if (/^(SELECT|WITH|INSERT|UPDATE|DELETE|REPLACE|PRAGMA)\b/i.test(sql)) values.push(sql);
      }
      return [...new Set(values)];
    }
    
    function cleanSql(sql) {
      return sql
        .replace(/\bAS\s+"([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)(?:[!?])?(?::\s*[^"]+)?"/gi, "AS $1")
        .replace(/\s+$/gm, "")
        .trim()
        .replace(/;?$/, ";");
    }
    
    function command(sql, body) {
      if (/\bRETURNING\b/i.test(sql)) return ":one";
      if (/^(INSERT|UPDATE|DELETE|REPLACE)\b/i.test(sql)) return ":exec";
      return /\.fetch_all\s*\(/.test(body) ? ":many" : ":one";
    }
    
    function chunks(entries) {
      const result = [];
      let current = [];
      let lines = 2;
      for (const entry of entries) {
        const size = entry.sql.split("\n").length + 3;
        if (current.length && lines + size > maxLines) {
          result.push(current);
          current = [];
          lines = 2;
        }
        current.push(entry);
        lines += size;
      }
      if (current.length) result.push(current);
      return result;
    }
    
    await rm(outputDir, { recursive: true, force: true });
    await mkdir(outputDir, { recursive: true });
    const dynamic = [];
    let queryCount = 0;
    
    for (const file of (await readdir(sourceDir)).filter((name) => name.endsWith(".rs")).sort()) {
      const source = await readFile(path.join(sourceDir, file), "utf8");
      const repository = file.replace(/\.rs$/, "");
      const entries = [];
      for (const method of methods(source)) {
        const statements = sqlStrings(method.body);
        statements.forEach((statement, index) => {
          if (/\{[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*\}/.test(statement)) {
            dynamic.push(`${repository}::${method.name} (formatted SQL)`);
            return;
          }
          const suffix = statements.length > 1 ? `${index + 1}` : "";
          entries.push({
            name: `${pascal(repository)}${pascal(method.name)}${suffix}`,
            command: command(statement, method.body),
            sql: cleanSql(statement),
          });
        });
        if (/QueryBuilder|AssertSqlSafe|format!\s*\(/.test(method.body) && statements.length === 0) {
          dynamic.push(`${repository}::${method.name} (runtime-built SQL)`);
        }
      }
      const parts = chunks(entries);
      for (const [index, part] of parts.entries()) {
        const suffix = parts.length > 1 ? `_${index + 1}` : "";
        const header = `-- Extracted from src/db/repository/${file}. Do not edit repository SQL directly.\n\n`;
        const body = part.map((entry) => `-- name: ${entry.name} ${entry.command}\n${entry.sql}\n`).join("\n");
        await writeFile(path.join(outputDir, `${repository}${suffix}.sql`), header + body);
        queryCount += part.length;
      }
    }
    
    await writeFile(
      path.join(outputDir, "DYNAMIC_QUERIES.md"),
      `# Dynamic repository queries\n\nThese queries require typed builders or explicit variants.\n\n${dynamic
        .sort()
        .map((item) => `- \`${item}\``)
        .join("\n")}\n`,
    );
    console.log(`Extracted ${queryCount} static queries; ${dynamic.length} dynamic queries require manual variants.`);

    import { execFileSync } from "node:child_process";
    import { mkdir, readdir, rm, writeFile } from "node:fs/promises";
    import path from "node:path";
    
    const database = process.argv[2];
    const output = process.argv[3] ?? "db/schema";
    
    if (!database) {
      throw new Error("usage: node scripts/split-flash-schema.mjs <sqlite-db> [output-dir]");
    }
    
    const sql = (statement) =>
      execFileSync("sqlite3", ["-noheader", "-separator", "\t", database, statement], {
        encoding: "utf8",
      }).trim();
    
    const quote = (value) => `'${value.replaceAll("'", "''")}'`;
    const tables = sql(
      "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%' ORDER BY name",
    )
      .split("\n")
      .filter(Boolean);
    
    const dependencies = new Map(
      tables.map((table) => [
        table,
        new Set(
          sql(`SELECT DISTINCT \"table\" FROM pragma_foreign_key_list(${quote(table)})`)
            .split("\n")
            .filter((dependency) => dependency && dependency !== table && tables.includes(dependency)),
        ),
      ]),
    );
    
    const ordered = [];
    const pending = new Set(tables);
    while (pending.size) {
      const ready = [...pending]
        .filter((table) => [...dependencies.get(table)].every((dependency) => !pending.has(dependency)))
        .sort();
      const selected = ready.length ? ready : [[...pending].sort()[0]];
      for (const table of selected) {
        pending.delete(table);
        ordered.push(table);
      }
    }
    
    await mkdir(output, { recursive: true });
    for (const file of await readdir(output)) {
      if (file.endsWith(".sql")) await rm(path.join(output, file));
    }
    
    for (const [index, table] of ordered.entries()) {
      const schema = sql(
        `SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE tbl_name=${quote(table)} AND sql IS NOT NULL ` +
          "AND type IN ('table','index','trigger') ORDER BY CASE type WHEN 'table' THEN 0 WHEN 'index' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, name",
      );
      const body = schema
        .split("\n")
        .map((statement) => statement.trimEnd().replace(/;?$/, ";"))
        .join("\n\n");
      const number = String(index + 1).padStart(3, "0");
      await writeFile(path.join(output, `${number}_${table}.sql`), `${body}\n`);
    }
    
    const views = sql("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='view' ORDER BY name")
      .split("\n")
      .filter(Boolean);
    for (const [index, view] of views.entries()) {
      const definition = sql(`SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='view' AND name=${quote(view)}`);
      const number = String(ordered.length + index + 1).padStart(3, "0");
      await writeFile(path.join(output, `${number}_${view}_view.sql`), `${definition.replace(/;?$/, ";")}\n`);
    }

    import { execFileSync } from "node:child_process";
    import { mkdir, readdir, rm, writeFile } from "node:fs/promises";
    import path from "node:path";
    
    const database = process.argv[2];
    const output = process.argv[3] ?? "db/schema";
    
    if (!database) {
      throw new Error("usage: node scripts/split-flash-schema.mjs <sqlite-db> [output-dir]");
    }
    
    const sql = (statement) =>
      execFileSync("sqlite3", ["-noheader", "-separator", "\t", database, statement], {
        encoding: "utf8",
      }).trim();
    
    const quote = (value) => `'${value.replaceAll("'", "''")}'`;
    const tables = sql(
      "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%' ORDER BY name",
    )
      .split("\n")
      .filter(Boolean);
    
    const dependencies = new Map(
      tables.map((table) => [
        table,
        new Set(
          sql(`SELECT DISTINCT \"table\" FROM pragma_foreign_key_list(${quote(table)})`)
            .split("\n")
            .filter((dependency) => dependency && dependency !== table && tables.includes(dependency)),
        ),
      ]),
    );
    
    const ordered = [];
    const pending = new Set(tables);
    while (pending.size) {
      const ready = [...pending]
        .filter((table) => [...dependencies.get(table)].every((dependency) => !pending.has(dependency)))
        .sort();
      const selected = ready.length ? ready : [[...pending].sort()[0]];
      for (const table of selected) {
        pending.delete(table);
        ordered.push(table);
      }
    }

    for (const file of await readdir(output)) {
      if (file.endsWith(".sql")) await rm(path.join(output, file));

          "AND type IN ('table','index','trigger') ORDER BY CASE type WHEN 'table' THEN 0 WHEN 'index' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, name",
      );
      const body = schema
        .split("\n")
        .map((statement) => statement.trimEnd().replace(/;?$/, ";"))
        .join("\n\n");
      const number = String(index + 1).padStart(3, "0");
      await writeFile(path.join(output, `${number}_${table}.sql`), `${body}\n`);
    }

      const number = String(ordered.length + index + 1).padStart(3, "0");
      await writeFile(path.join(output, `${number}_${view}_view.sql`), `${definition.replace(/;?$/, ";")}\n`);
    }
    
    console.log(`Split schema into ${ordered.length} table files and ${views.length} view files.`);
    Add: /run/media/das/SSD/Devloper/rustploy/scripts/split-flash-schema.ts
    import { Database } from "bun:sqlite";
    import { mkdir, readdir, rm, writeFile } from "node:fs/promises";
    import path from "node:path";
    
    const databasePath = process.argv[2];
    const output = process.argv[3] ?? "db/schema";
    
    if (!databasePath) {
      throw new Error("usage: bun scripts/split-flash-schema.ts <sqlite-db> [output-dir]");
    }
    
    const database = new Database(databasePath, { readonly: true });
    const tables = database
      .query<{ name: string }, []>(
        "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%' ORDER BY name",
      )
      .all()
      .map(({ name }) => name);
    
    const dependencies = new Map(
      tables.map((table) => [
        table,
        new Set(
          database
            .query<{ table: string }, [string]>(
              'SELECT DISTINCT "table" FROM pragma_foreign_key_list(?)',
            )
            .all(table)
            .map((row) => row.table)
            .filter((dependency) => dependency !== table && tables.includes(dependency)),
        ),
      ]),
    );
    
    const ordered: string[] = [];
    const pending = new Set(tables);
    while (pending.size) {
      const ready = [...pending]
        .filter((table) => [...dependencies.get(table)!].every((dependency) => !pending.has(dependency)))
        .sort();
      const selected = ready.length ? ready : [[...pending].sort()[0]];
      for (const table of selected) {
        pending.delete(table);
        ordered.push(table);
      }
    }
    
    await mkdir(output, { recursive: true });
    for (const file of await readdir(output)) {
      if (file.endsWith(".sql")) await rm(path.join(output, file));
    }
    
    const objects = database.query<{ sql: string }, [string]>(`
      SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master
      WHERE tbl_name = ? AND sql IS NOT NULL AND type IN ('table', 'index', 'trigger')
      ORDER BY CASE type WHEN 'table' THEN 0 WHEN 'index' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, name
    `);
    
    for (const [index, table] of ordered.entries()) {
      const body = objects
        .all(table)
        .map(({ sql }) => `${sql.trim().replace(/;?$/, ";")}\n`)
        .join("\n");
      const number = String(index + 1).padStart(3, "0");
      await writeFile(path.join(output, `${number}_${table}.sql`), body);
    }
    
    const views = database
      .query<{ name: string; sql: string }, []>(
        "SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'view' ORDER BY name",
      )
      .all();
    for (const [index, view] of views.entries()) {
      const number = String(ordered.length + index + 1).padStart(3, "0");
      await writeFile(
        path.join(output, `${number}_${view.name}_view.sql`),
        `${view.sql.trim().replace(/;?$/, ";")}\n`,
      );
    }
    
    database.close();
    console.log(`Split schema into ${ordered.length} table files and ${views.length} view files.`);

## Assistant

“Dedicated codegen” means I separated the code-generation input from migration input.

Current flow:

```text
db/schema + db/queries
        |
        | prepare-flash-codegen-schema.ts
        v
.flash/schema + .flash/queries
        |
        | flash gen
        v
src/flash_gen/
```

Specifically:

- `db/schema` remains the canonical human-readable schema.
- `db/queries` remains the canonical repository SQL.
- `.flash/schema` is a generated temporary copy simplified for FlashORM’s parser.
- `.flash/queries` is a generated codegen-only query copy.
- `src/flash_gen` contains the generated Rust types and query code.
- No migration or database apply runs during this process.

The command is:

```bash
rm -rf .flash
bun scripts/prepare-flash-codegen-schema.ts
flash gen -f
```

I used this because FlashORM currently fails on a few valid project queries, dynamic table names, and SQLite JSON table functions. Those workarounds are applied only inside `.flash`, so the actual application schema and queries are not damaged.

## Assistant

No. Current web terminal does not create a Russh/SSH connection when the user selects “server”.

Current behavior:

```text
WebSocket terminal
        |
        v
MonitoringService
        |
        v
gRPC Agent shell
        |
        v
Remote server/container
```

Both events use the Agent:

- `docker:start` → Agent Docker shell
- `server:start` → Agent server shell

The `server:start` name is misleading. It currently opens a shell through the remote Agent, not through direct Russh.

Russh is still present, but only for things such as:

- server setup/bootstrap
- Agent installation or repair
- explicit SSH execution paths
- connection checks

So when the user says “server par karo”, the current code still routes to:

```text
Agent → gRPC shell
```

It does not route to:

```text
Backend → Russh → SSH channel → remote server shell
```

That is why the terminal displays messages like:

```text
Terminal session started on agent
Target: agent
```

If you want “Server SSH Terminal” to mean a real Russh connection, the `server:start` WebSocket handler must be switched to the Russh terminal implementation. Docker terminal can remain Agent-based separately.

    +func findMatchingParen(sql string, open int) int {
    +	depth := 0
    +	inString := false
    +	for i := open; i < len(sql); i++ {
    +		switch sql[i] {
    +		case '\'':
    +			if inString && i+1 < len(sql) && sql[i+1] == '\'' {
    +				i++
    +				continue
    +			}
    +			inString = !inString
    +		case '(':
    +			if !inString {
    +				depth++
    +			}
    +		case ')':
    +			if !inString {
    +				depth--
    +				if depth == 0 {

    +				}

    +func inferQuestionParamName(sql string, paramIndex int) string {
    +	position := questionParamPosition(sql, paramIndex)
    +	if position < 0 {
    +		return ""
    +	}
    +
    +	// INSERT columns must be mapped to the VALUES expression containing the
    +	// placeholder; literals and function calls may mean column N is not param N.
    +	insertRe := regexp.MustCompile(`(?i)INSERT\s+INTO\s+\S+\s*\(([^)]+)\)\s*VALUES\s*\(`)
    +	if match := insertRe.FindStringSubmatchIndex(sql); len(match) >= 4 {
    +		valuesOpen := match[1] - 1
    +		valuesEnd := findMatchingParen(sql, valuesOpen)
    +		if position > valuesOpen && valuesEnd > position {
    +			columns := utils.SplitColumns(sql[match[2]:match[3]])
    +			values := utils.SplitColumns(sql[valuesOpen+1 : valuesEnd])
    +			offset := valuesOpen + 1
    +			for i, value := range values {
    +				start := strings.Index(sql[offset:valuesEnd], value)
    +				if start < 0 {
    +					continue
    +				}
    +				start += offset
    +				end := start + len(value)
    +				if position >= start && position < end && i < len(columns) {
    +					return strings.Trim(strings.TrimSpace(columns[i]), `"'`)
    +				}
    +				offset = end
    +			}
    +		}
    +	}
    +
    +	// UPDATE assignments can wrap placeholders in COALESCE/functions. Resolve
    +	// the assignment containing this exact placeholder rather than only `col=?`.
    +	setRe := regexp.MustCompile(`(?i)\bSET\b`)
    +	if setLoc := setRe.FindStringIndex(sql); setLoc != nil && position > setLoc[1] {
    +		setEnd := len(sql)
    +		if whereLoc := regexp.MustCompile(`(?i)\bWHERE\b`).FindStringIndex(sql[setLoc[1]:]); whereLoc != nil {
    +			setEnd = setLoc[1] + whereLoc[0]
    +		}
    +		if position < setEnd {
    +			assignments := utils.SplitColumns(sql[setLoc[1]:setEnd])
    +			offset := setLoc[1]
    +			for _, assignment := range assignments {
    +				start := strings.Index(sql[offset:setEnd], assignment)
    +				if start < 0 {
    +					continue
    +				}
    +				start += offset
    +				end := start + len(assignment)
    +				if position >= start && position < end {
    +					if equals := strings.Index(assignment, "="); equals > 0 {
    +						return strings.Trim(strings.TrimSpace(assignment[:equals]), `"'`)
    +					}
    +				}
    +				offset = end
    +			}
    +		}
    +	}
    +
    +	before := sql[:position]
    +	after := sql[position+1:]
    +	leftColumn := regexp.MustCompile(`(?i)(?:\w+\.)?(\w+)\s*(?:=|<>|!=|<=|>=|<|>|I?LIKE|IS)\s*$`)
    +	if match := leftColumn.FindStringSubmatch(before); len(match) > 1 {
    +		return match[1]
    +	}
    +	rightColumn := regexp.MustCompile(`(?i)^\s*(?:=|<>|!=|<=|>=|<|>|I?LIKE|IS)\s*(?:\w+\.)?(\w+)`)
    +	if match := rightColumn.FindStringSubmatch(after); len(match) > 1 {
    +		return match[1]
    +	}
    +	return ""

    +func questionParamPosition(sql string, paramIndex int) int {
    +	index := 0
    +	inString := false
    +	for i := 0; i < len(sql); i++ {
    +		if sql[i] == '\'' {
    +			if inString && i+1 < len(sql) && sql[i+1] == '\'' {
    +				i++
    +				continue
    +			}
    +			inString = !inString
    +			continue
    +		}
    +		if !inString && sql[i] == '?' {
    +			index++
    +			if index == paramIndex {
    +				return i
    +			}
    +		}
    +	}
    +	return -1
    +}

    +// inferQuestionContextName resolves placeholders hidden inside common SQL
    +// wrappers (lower/trim/coalesce) and nullable-id predicates. It is positional
    +// so it remains correct when a query contains multiple wrapped expressions.
    +func inferQuestionContextName(sql string, paramIndex int) string {
    +	patterns := []*regexp.Regexp{
    +		regexp.MustCompile(`(?i)(\w+)\s*=\s*(?:lower|upper|trim|rtrim|ltrim)\s*\(\s*\?`),
    +		regexp.MustCompile(`(?i)(?:lower|upper|trim|rtrim|ltrim)\s*\(\s*(\w+)\s*\)\s*=\s*(?:lower|upper|trim|rtrim|ltrim)\s*\(\s*\?`),
    +		regexp.MustCompile(`(?i)(\w+)\s*(?:!=|<>|>=|<=|>|<)\s*\?`),
    +	}
    +	for _, pattern := range patterns {
    +		for _, match := range pattern.FindAllStringSubmatchIndex(sql, -1) {
    +			question := strings.Index(sql[match[0]:match[1]], "?")
    +			if question < 0 {
    +				continue
    +			}
    +			questionPos := match[0] + question
    +			if questionParamPosition(sql, paramIndex) == questionPos {
    +				return sql[match[2]:match[3]]
    +			}
    +		}
    +	}
    +	// `? IS NULL OR id != ?` is commonly used for optional updates. Both
    +	// placeholders represent the same id column.
    +	optionalID := regexp.MustCompile(`(?i)\?\s+IS\s+NULL\s+OR\s+(?:\w+\.)?(\w+)\s*!=\s*\?`)
    +	for _, match := range optionalID.FindAllStringSubmatchIndex(sql, -1) {
    +		first := strings.Index(sql[match[0]:match[1]], "?")
    +		second := strings.LastIndex(sql[match[0]:match[1]], "?")
    +		pos := questionParamPosition(sql, paramIndex)
    +		if (first >= 0 && pos == match[0]+first) || (second >= 0 && pos == match[0]+second) {
    +			return sql[match[2]:match[3]]
    +		}
    +	}
    +	return ""
    +}

    use crate::db::models::tags::Tag;
    use auto_di::singleton;
    use sqlx::SqlitePool;
    use std::sync::Arc;
    
    pub struct TagRepository {
        pool: Arc<SqlitePool>,
    }
    
    #[singleton]
    impl TagRepository {
        pub fn new(pool: Arc<SqlitePool>) -> Self {
            Self { pool }
        }
    
        pub async fn get_all(&self) -> Result<Vec<Tag>, sqlx::Error> {
            sqlx::query_as!(
                Tag,
                r#"SELECT id AS "id?: i64", name AS "name: String", color AS "color: String", organization_id AS "organization_id: i64", created_at AS "created_at: i64" FROM tags"#
            )
            .fetch_all(self.pool.as_ref())
            .await
        }
    
        pub async fn get_by_id(&self, id: i64) -> Result<Option<Tag>, sqlx::Error> {
            sqlx::query_as!(
                Tag,
                r#"SELECT id AS "id?: i64", name AS "name: String", color AS "color: String", organization_id AS "organization_id: i64", created_at AS "created_at: i64" FROM tags WHERE id = ?"#,
                id
            )
            .fetch_optional(self.pool.as_ref())
            .await
        }
    
        pub async fn create(&self, item: &Tag) -> Result<i64, sqlx::Error> {
            let _res = sqlx::query!(
                r#"INSERT INTO tags (name, color, organization_id, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)"#,
                &item.name,
                &item.color,
                item.organization_id,
                item.created_at
            )
            .execute(self.pool.as_ref())
            .await?;
            Ok(_res.last_insert_rowid())
        }
    
        pub async fn update(&self, id: i64, item: &Tag) -> Result<(), sqlx::Error> {
            sqlx::query!(
                r#"UPDATE tags SET name = ?, color = ?, organization_id = ?, created_at = ? WHERE id = ?"#,
                &item.name,
                &item.color,
                item.organization_id,
                item.created_at,
                id
            )
            .execute(self.pool.as_ref())
            .await?;
            Ok(())
        }
    
        pub async fn delete(&self, id: i64) -> Result<(), sqlx::Error> {
            sqlx::query!(r#"DELETE FROM tags WHERE id = ?"#, id)
                .execute(self.pool.as_ref())
                .await?;
            Ok(())
        }
    }

    use crate::db::models::tags::Tag;
    use crate::flash_gen::{
        db::Queries,
        models::Tags,
        tags::{TagsCreateParams, TagsGetAllRow, TagsUpdateParams},
    };
    use auto_di::singleton;
    use sqlx::SqlitePool;
    use std::sync::Arc;
    
    pub struct TagRepository {
        queries: Queries,
    }
    
    #[singleton]
    impl TagRepository {
        pub fn new(pool: Arc<SqlitePool>) -> Self {
            Self { queries: Queries::new(pool.as_ref().clone()) }
        }
    
        pub async fn get_all(&self) -> Result<Vec<Tag>, sqlx::Error> {
            self.queries.tags_get_all().await.map(|rows| rows.into_iter().map(Into::into).collect())
        }
    
        pub async fn get_by_id(&self, id: i64) -> Result<Option<Tag>, sqlx::Error> {
            match self.queries.tags_get_by_id(id).await {
                Ok(row) => Ok(Some(row.into())),
                Err(sqlx::Error::RowNotFound) => Ok(None),
                Err(error) => Err(error),
            }
        }
    
        pub async fn create(&self, item: &Tag) -> Result<i64, sqlx::Error> {
            self.queries.tags_create(&TagsCreateParams {
                name: item.name.clone(), color: item.color.clone(),
                organization_id: item.organization_id, created_at: item.created_at,
            }).await?;
            self.queries.tags_get_last_insert_rowid().await
        }
    
        pub async fn update(&self, id: i64, item: &Tag) -> Result<(), sqlx::Error> {
            self.queries.tags_update(&TagsUpdateParams {
                name: item.name.clone(), color: item.color.clone(),
                organization_id: item.organization_id, created_at: item.created_at, id,
            }).await
        }
    
        pub async fn delete(&self, id: i64) -> Result<(), sqlx::Error> { self.queries.tags_delete(id).await }
    }
    
    impl From<TagsGetAllRow> for Tag {
        fn from(row: TagsGetAllRow) -> Self { Self { id: Some(row.id), name: row.name, color: row.color, organization_id: row.organization_id, created_at: row.created_at } }
    }
    
    impl From<Tags> for Tag {
        fn from(row: Tags) -> Self { Self { id: Some(row.id), name: row.name, color: row.color, organization_id: row.organization_id, created_at: row.created_at } }
    }

    use crate::flash_gen::db::Queries;
    use auto_di::singleton;
    use sqlx::SqlitePool;
    use std::{ops::Deref, sync::Arc};
    
    /// Application-owned DI wrapper around the generated FlashORM query client.
    pub struct FlashQueries(Queries);
    
    #[singleton]
    impl FlashQueries {
        pub fn new(pool: Arc<SqlitePool>) -> Self {
            Self(Queries::new(pool.as_ref().clone()))
        }
    }
    
    impl Deref for FlashQueries {
        type Target = Queries;
    
        fn deref(&self) -> &Self::Target {
            &self.0
        }
    }

    use auto_di::singleton;
    use std::sync::Arc;
    
    use crate::api::dto::tag::{CreateTagDto, UpdateTagDto};
    use crate::db::models::tags::Tag;
    use crate::db::repository::project_tags::ProjectTagRepository;
    use crate::db::repository::tags::TagRepository;
    
    #[derive(Clone)]
    pub struct TagService {
        repo_tag: Arc<TagRepository>,
        repo_project_tag: Arc<ProjectTagRepository>,
    }
    
    #[singleton]
    impl TagService {
        fn new(repo_tag: Arc<TagRepository>, repo_project_tag: Arc<ProjectTagRepository>) -> Self {
            Self {
                repo_tag,
                repo_project_tag,
            }
        }
    
        pub async fn list_all(&self) -> sqlx::Result<Vec<Tag>> {
            self.repo_tag.get_all().await
        }
    
        pub async fn get_by_id(&self, id: i64) -> sqlx::Result<Option<Tag>> {
            self.repo_tag.get_by_id(id).await
        }
    
        pub async fn create(&self, dto: CreateTagDto) -> sqlx::Result<Tag> {
            let now = chrono::Utc::now().timestamp();
            let tag = Tag {
                id: None,
                name: dto.name,
                color: dto.color,
                organization_id: dto.organization_id.unwrap_or(1),
                created_at: now,
            };
            let id = self.repo_tag.create(&tag).await?;
            let created = self
                .repo_tag
                .get_by_id(id)
                .await?
                .ok_or(sqlx::Error::RowNotFound)?;
            Ok(created)
        }
    
        pub async fn update(&self, id: i64, dto: UpdateTagDto) -> sqlx::Result<Tag> {
            let existing = self
                .repo_tag
                .get_by_id(id)
                .await?
                .ok_or(sqlx::Error::RowNotFound)?;
            let updated = Tag {
                id: Some(id),
                name: dto.name.unwrap_or(existing.name),
                color: dto.color.unwrap_or(existing.color),
                organization_id: existing.organization_id,
                created_at: existing.created_at,
            };
            self.repo_tag.update(id, &updated).await?;
            Ok(updated)
        }
    
        pub async fn delete(&self, id: i64) -> sqlx::Result<()> {
            self.repo_tag.delete(id).await
        }
    
        pub async fn list_project_tags(&self, project_id: i64) -> sqlx::Result<Vec<Tag>> {
            let project_tags = self.repo_project_tag.get_all().await?;
            let matching_tag_ids: Vec<i64> = project_tags
                .into_iter()
                .filter(|pt| pt.project_id == project_id)
                .map(|pt| pt.tag_id)
                .collect();
    
            let all_tags = self.repo_tag.get_all().await?;
            let filtered = all_tags
                .into_iter()
                .filter(|t| t.id.map_or(false, |id| matching_tag_ids.contains(&id)))
                .collect();
            Ok(filtered)
        }
    
        pub async fn attach_project_tag(&self, project_id: i64, tag_id: i64) -> sqlx::Result<()> {
            let pt = crate::db::models::project_tags::ProjectTag {
                id: None,
                project_id,
                tag_id,
            };
            self.repo_project_tag.create(&pt).await?;
            Ok(())
        }
    
        pub async fn detach_project_tag(&self, project_id: i64, tag_id: i64) -> sqlx::Result<()> {
            let all_pt = self.repo_project_tag.get_all().await?;
            if let Some(target) = all_pt
                .into_iter()
                .find(|pt| pt.project_id == project_id && pt.tag_id == tag_id)
            {
                if let Some(id) = target.id {
                    self.repo_project_tag.delete(id).await?;
                }
            }
            Ok(())
        }
    }

    use auto_di::singleton;
    use std::sync::Arc;
    
    use crate::{
        api::dto::tag::{CreateTagDto, UpdateTagDto},
        db::{models::tags::Tag, queries::FlashQueries},
        flash_gen::{
            models::Tags,
            tags::{TagsCreateParams, TagsGetAllRow, TagsUpdateParams},
        },
    };
    
    #[derive(Clone)]
    pub struct TagService {
        queries: Arc<FlashQueries>,
    }
    
    #[singleton]
    impl TagService {
        fn new(queries: Arc<FlashQueries>) -> Self {
            Self { queries }
        }
    
        pub async fn list_all(&self) -> sqlx::Result<Vec<Tag>> {
            self.queries
                .tags_get_all()
                .await
                .map(|rows| rows.into_iter().map(tag_from_row).collect())
        }
    
        pub async fn get_by_id(&self, id: i64) -> sqlx::Result<Option<Tag>> {
            match self.queries.tags_get_by_id(id).await {
                Ok(row) => Ok(Some(tag_from_model(row))),
                Err(sqlx::Error::RowNotFound) => Ok(None),
                Err(error) => Err(error),
            }
        }
    
        pub async fn create(&self, dto: CreateTagDto) -> sqlx::Result<Tag> {
            let params = TagsCreateParams {
                name: dto.name,
                color: dto.color,
                organization_id: dto.organization_id.unwrap_or(1),
                created_at: chrono::Utc::now().timestamp(),
            };
            self.queries.tags_create(&params).await?;
            let id = self.queries.tags_get_last_insert_rowid().await?;
            self.get_by_id(id).await?.ok_or(sqlx::Error::RowNotFound)
        }
    
        pub async fn update(&self, id: i64, dto: UpdateTagDto) -> sqlx::Result<Tag> {
            let existing = self.get_by_id(id).await?.ok_or(sqlx::Error::RowNotFound)?;
            let updated = Tag {
                id: Some(id),
                name: dto.name.unwrap_or(existing.name),
                color: dto.color.unwrap_or(existing.color),
                organization_id: existing.organization_id,
                created_at: existing.created_at,
            };
            self.queries
                .tags_update(&TagsUpdateParams {
                    name: updated.name.clone(),
                    color: updated.color.clone(),
                    organization_id: updated.organization_id,
                    created_at: updated.created_at,
                    id,
                })
                .await?;
            Ok(updated)
        }
    
        pub async fn delete(&self, id: i64) -> sqlx::Result<()> {
            self.queries.tags_delete(id).await
        }
    
        pub async fn list_project_tags(&self, project_id: i64) -> sqlx::Result<Vec<Tag>> {
            self.queries
                .list_tags_by_project(project_id)
                .await
                .map(|rows| rows.into_iter().map(tag_from_model).collect())
        }
    
        pub async fn attach_project_tag(&self, project_id: i64, tag_id: i64) -> sqlx::Result<()> {
            self.queries.add_tag_to_project(project_id, tag_id).await
        }
    
        pub async fn detach_project_tag(&self, project_id: i64, tag_id: i64) -> sqlx::Result<()> {
            self.queries.remove_tag_from_project(project_id, tag_id).await
        }
    }
    
    fn tag_from_row(row: TagsGetAllRow) -> Tag {
        Tag {
            id: Some(row.id),
            name: row.name,
            color: row.color,
            organization_id: row.organization_id,
            created_at: row.created_at,
        }
    }
    
    fn tag_from_model(row: Tags) -> Tag {
        Tag {
            id: Some(row.id),
            name: row.name,
            color: row.color,
            organization_id: row.organization_id,
            created_at: row.created_at,
        }
    }

        }

            }
        }
    
        pub async fn get_all(&self) -> Result<Vec<Tag>, sqlx::Error> {
            self.queries

                .await

        }

            match self.queries.tags_get_by_id(id).await {
                Ok(row) => Ok(Some(row.into())),
                Err(sqlx::Error::RowNotFound) => Ok(None),
                Err(error) => Err(error),
            }
        }
    
        pub async fn create(&self, item: &Tag) -> Result<i64, sqlx::Error> {
            self.queries
                .tags_create(&TagsCreateParams {
                    name: item.name.clone(),
                    color: item.color.clone(),
                    organization_id: item.organization_id,
                    created_at: item.created_at,
                })
                .await?;
            self.queries.tags_get_last_insert_rowid().await
        }

                    name: item.name.clone(),
                    color: item.color.clone(),
                    organization_id: item.organization_id,
                    created_at: item.created_at,
                    id,
                })

        }

        }

Branch created: `feature/connectrpc-http2`.

Plan:

   - Keep [agent.proto](/run/media/das/SSD/Devloper/rustploy/proto/agent.proto) as the single contract.

3. **Create `auto_connect`**

   - Preserve current DI, singleton, middleware ordering, and automatic service discovery.
   - Generated handlers will use `/agent.AgentService/MethodName`.

4. **Agent HTTP/2 server**
   - Replace the Tonic server with a Hyper/Axum-based ConnectRPC HTTP/2 server.
   - TLS with ALPN `h2`.
   - One backend-to-agent HTTP/2 connection will multiplex metrics, lifecycle events, logs, shell, tasks, and uploads.

5. **Authentication middleware**
   - Move agent-token validation into ConnectRPC middleware.
   - Use Connect-compatible error codes and protobuf error responses.
   - Preserve automatic token repair and agent upgrade behavior.

6. **Backend client**
   - Replace `AgentServiceClient<tonic::Channel>` with a pooled ConnectRPC HTTP/2 client.
   - Keep one channel per server in the existing `DashMap`.
   - Add keepalive, connection health checks, reconnect, timeout, and cancellation handling.

7. **Migrate operations**
   - Unary: agent info, metrics, current container states.
   - Server stream: logs and task output.
   - Client stream: file upload.
   - Bidirectional stream: container lifecycle watch and interactive shell, including resize and cancellation.

8. **Realtime reliability**
   - Maintain one long-lived lifecycle stream per agent.
   - Update current DB state immediately from pushed Docker events.
   - Reconnect with bounded backoff and fetch one fresh snapshot after reconnect to prevent stale state.

9. **Remove Tonic transport**
   - Remove `tonic::transport`, generated Tonic clients/servers, and old registration code.
   - Keep `tonic` only temporarily if status/request types remain during migration, then remove it completely.
   - No permanent dual-stack or legacy gRPC server.

10. **Verification**
   - Test unary and every streaming direction.
   - Test multiple simultaneous shells over one HTTP/2 connection.
   - Test agent restart, token rotation, TLS failure, stream cancellation, upload interruption, and lifecycle resync.
   - Build both Openoxide and agent images and verify runtime connectivity.

Main result: protobuf contract remains, but transport becomes ConnectRPC over TLS HTTP/2 with connection multiplexing and no repeated SSH or per-terminal transport connection.

    use std::sync::Arc;
    
    use auto_di::singleton;
    use connectrpc::{ConnectError, ErrorCode, RequestContext, Response, ServiceRequest, ServiceResult};
    use sqlx::SqlitePool;
    
    use super::generated::openoxide::api::v1::{
        GenerateDomainRequest, GenerateDomainResponse, PublicService,
    };
    
    pub struct PublicConnectService {
        db: Arc<SqlitePool>,
    }
    
    #[singleton]
    impl PublicConnectService {
        pub fn new(db: Arc<SqlitePool>) -> Self {
            Self { db }
        }
    }
    
    impl PublicService for PublicConnectService {
        async fn generate_domain<'a>(
            &'a self,
            _ctx: RequestContext,
            request: ServiceRequest<'_, GenerateDomainRequest>,
        ) -> ServiceResult<impl connectrpc::Encodable<GenerateDomainResponse> + Send + use<'a>> {
            let name = slugify(request.name);
            if name.is_empty() {
                return Err(ConnectError::invalid_argument("name cannot be empty"));
            }
    
            let server_ip = sqlx::query_scalar::<_, Option<String>>(
                "SELECT server_ip FROM settings LIMIT 1",
            )
            .fetch_optional(self.db.as_ref())
            .await
            .map_err(|error| {
                tracing::error!(%error, "could not load server IP for generated domain");
                ConnectError::new(ErrorCode::Internal, "could not generate domain")
            })?
            .flatten();
    
            let domain = match server_ip.as_deref() {
                Some(ip) if !ip.is_empty() => format!("{name}.{}.sslip.io", ip.replace('.', "-")),
                _ => format!("{name}.localhost"),
            };
    
            Response::ok(GenerateDomainResponse {
                domain,
                ..Default::default()
            })
        }
    }
    
    fn slugify(value: &str) -> String {
        value
            .trim()
            .to_ascii_lowercase()
            .chars()
            .fold((String::new(), false), |(mut out, separated), ch| {
                if ch.is_ascii_alphanumeric() {
                    out.push(ch);
                    (out, false)
                } else if !out.is_empty() && !separated {
                    out.push('-');
                    (out, true)
                } else {
                    (out, separated)
                }
            })
            .0
            .trim_end_matches('-')
            .to_owned()
    }

    use std::{convert::Infallible, sync::Arc};
    
    use axum::{Router as AxumRouter, body::Body as AxumBody};
    use bytes::Bytes;
    use connectrpc::{ConnectRpcBody, ConnectRpcService};
    use http_body_util::{BodyExt, combinators::UnsyncBoxBody};
    use hyper::{Request, Response, body::Incoming, service::service_fn};
    use hyper_util::{
        rt::{TokioExecutor, TokioIo},
        server::conn::auto::Builder,
    };
    use tokio::net::TcpListener;
    use tower::ServiceExt;
    
    type BoxError = Box<dyn std::error::Error + Send + Sync>;
    type ResponseBody = UnsyncBoxBody<Bytes, BoxError>;
    
    pub async fn serve(
        listener: TcpListener,
        legacy: AxumRouter,
        connect: ConnectRpcService,
    ) -> std::io::Result<()> {
        let legacy = Arc::new(legacy);
        let connect = Arc::new(connect);
    
        loop {
            let (stream, peer) = listener.accept().await?;
            let legacy = Arc::clone(&legacy);
            let connect = Arc::clone(&connect);
    
            tokio::spawn(async move {
                let service = service_fn(move |request| {
                    dispatch(request, Arc::clone(&legacy), Arc::clone(&connect))
                });
                let io = TokioIo::new(stream);
                let builder = Builder::new(TokioExecutor::new());
    
                if let Err(error) = builder.serve_connection_with_upgrades(io, service).await {
                    tracing::debug!(%peer, %error, "HTTP connection closed with an error");
                }
            });
        }
    }
    
    async fn dispatch(
        request: Request<Incoming>,
        legacy: Arc<AxumRouter>,
        connect: Arc<ConnectRpcService>,
    ) -> Result<Response<ResponseBody>, Infallible> {
        if request
            .uri()
            .path()
            .starts_with("/openoxide.api.")
        {
            let response = connect.as_ref().clone().oneshot(request).await?;
            return Ok(response.map(box_connect_body));
        }
    
        let response = legacy.as_ref().clone().oneshot(request).await?;
        Ok(response.map(box_axum_body))
    }
    
    fn box_connect_body(body: ConnectRpcBody) -> ResponseBody {
        body.map_err(|error| match error {}).boxed_unsync()
    }
    
    fn box_axum_body(body: AxumBody) -> ResponseBody {
        body.map_err(|error| -> BoxError { Box::new(error) })
            .boxed_unsync()
    }

    pub type Registrar = for<'a> fn(
        &'a Container,
        Router,
    ) -> BoxFuture<'a, Result<Router, DiError>>;
    
    pub struct Descriptor {
        pub registrar: Registrar,
    }
    
    inventory::collect!(Descriptor);
    
    pub async fn build_routes(container: &Container) -> Result<Router, DiError> {
        let mut router = Router::new();
        for descriptor in inventory::iter::<Descriptor> {
            router = (descriptor.registrar)(container, router).await?;
        }
        Ok(router)
    }
    
    pub async fn routes() -> Result<Router, DiError> {
        build_routes(auto_di::global_container()?).await
    }

    use proc_macro::TokenStream;
    use quote::{format_ident, quote};
    use syn::{ItemImpl, parse_macro_input};
    
    #[proc_macro_attribute]
    pub fn service(_attr: TokenStream, item: TokenStream) -> TokenStream {
        let item_impl = parse_macro_input!(item as ItemImpl);
        expand(item_impl)
            .unwrap_or_else(syn::Error::into_compile_error)
            .into()
    }
    
    fn expand(item_impl: ItemImpl) -> syn::Result<proc_macro2::TokenStream> {
        let trait_path = item_impl
            .trait_
            .as_ref()
            .ok_or_else(|| syn::Error::new_spanned(&item_impl, "Connect service must implement a trait"))?
            .1
            .clone();
        let service_type = item_impl.self_ty.clone();
        let service_name = match service_type.as_ref() {
            syn::Type::Path(path) => path.path.segments.last().unwrap().ident.clone(),
            other => return Err(syn::Error::new_spanned(other, "Connect service must be a named type")),
        };
    
        let mut extension_path = trait_path.clone();
        let trait_name = extension_path.segments.last_mut().unwrap();
        trait_name.ident = format_ident!("{}Ext", trait_name.ident);
        let registrar = format_ident!(
            "__auto_connect_register_{}",
            service_name.to_string().to_lowercase()
        );
    
        Ok(quote! {
            #item_impl
    
            fn #registrar<'a>(
                container: &'a ::auto_connect::__private::auto_di::Container,
                router: ::auto_connect::__private::connectrpc::Router,
            ) -> ::auto_connect::__private::auto_di::BoxFuture<
                'a,
                Result<
                    ::auto_connect::__private::connectrpc::Router,
                    ::auto_connect::__private::auto_di::DiError,
                >,
            > {
                Box::pin(async move {
                    let service = container.resolve::<#service_type>().await?;
                    Ok(<#service_type as #extension_path>::register(service, router))
                })
            }
    
            ::auto_connect::__private::inventory::submit! {
                ::auto_connect::Descriptor { registrar: #registrar }
            }
        })
    }

    Add: /run/media/das/SSD/Devloper/rustploy/scripts/generate-connect-proto.mjs
    import {mkdir, readFile, readdir, rm, writeFile} from 'node:fs/promises';
    import path from 'node:path';
    
    const specPath = process.argv[2] ?? '/tmp/openoxide-openapi.json';
    const outputDir = process.argv[3] ?? 'proto/openoxide/api/v1';
    const spec = JSON.parse(await readFile(specPath, 'utf8'));
    const schemas = spec.components?.schemas ?? {};
    const operations = [];
    
    for (const [route, pathItem] of Object.entries(spec.paths ?? {})) {
      for (const [method, operation] of Object.entries(pathItem)) {
        if (!['get', 'post', 'put', 'patch', 'delete', 'head', 'options'].includes(method)) continue;
        const [controller = 'Api', handler = `${method}_${route}`] = String(operation.operationId ?? '').split('::');
        const domain = snake(controller.replace(/Controller$/, '') || 'api');
        operations.push({route, method, operation, controller, handler, domain});
      }
    }
    
    await mkdir(outputDir, {recursive: true});
    for (const file of await readdir(outputDir)) {
      if (file.endsWith('.proto')) await rm(path.join(outputDir, file));
    }
    
    const grouped = Map.groupBy(operations, operation => operation.domain);
    const manifest = {operations: operations.length, domains: {}};
    
    for (const [domain, domainOperations] of [...grouped].sort(([a], [b]) => a.localeCompare(b))) {
      const referenced = new Set();
      for (const item of domainOperations) collectOperationRefs(item.operation, referenced);
      expandReferences(referenced);
    
      const packageName = `openoxide.api.v1.${domain}`;
      const serviceName = `${pascal(domain)}Service`;
      const imports = new Set();
      const lines = [
        'syntax = "proto3";',
        '',
        `package ${packageName};`,
        '',
      ];
    
      const schemaBlocks = [...referenced]
        .sort()
        .map(name => renderNamedSchema(name, schemas[name], imports))
        .filter(Boolean);
      const rpcBlocks = domainOperations
        .sort((a, b) => a.handler.localeCompare(b.handler))
        .map(item => renderRpc(item, imports));
    
      if (imports.size) {
        for (const imported of [...imports].sort()) lines.push(`import "${imported}";`);
        lines.push('');
      }
    
      lines.push(`service ${serviceName} {`, ...rpcBlocks.map(block => indent(block)), '}', '');
      lines.push(...domainOperations.flatMap(item => renderOperationMessages(item, imports)), ...schemaBlocks);
    
      const filename = `${domain}.proto`;
      await writeFile(path.join(outputDir, filename), `${lines.join('\n').replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n').trim()}\n`);
      manifest.domains[domain] = {
        file: filename,
        service: serviceName,
        operations: domainOperations.length,
        schemas: referenced.size,
      };
    }
    
    await writeFile(
      path.join(outputDir, 'manifest.json'),
      `${JSON.stringify(manifest, null, 2)}\n`,
    );
    console.log(`Generated ${grouped.size} protobuf domains covering ${operations.length} operations.`);
    
    function collectOperationRefs(operation, refs) {
      for (const parameter of operation.parameters ?? []) collectRefs(parameter.schema, refs);
      for (const media of Object.values(operation.requestBody?.content ?? {})) collectRefs(media.schema, refs);
      for (const response of Object.values(operation.responses ?? {})) {
        for (const media of Object.values(response.content ?? {})) collectRefs(media.schema, refs);
      }
    }
    
    function collectRefs(schema, refs) {
      if (!schema || typeof schema !== 'object') return;
      if (schema.$ref) refs.add(refName(schema.$ref));
      for (const value of Object.values(schema)) {
        if (Array.isArray(value)) value.forEach(item => collectRefs(item, refs));
        else if (value && typeof value === 'object') collectRefs(value, refs);
      }
    }
    
    function expandReferences(refs) {
      let previous = -1;
      while (refs.size !== previous) {
        previous = refs.size;
        for (const name of [...refs]) collectRefs(schemas[name], refs);
      }
    }
    
    function renderRpc({route, method, operation, handler}) {
      const rpcName = pascal(handler);
      const requestName = `${rpcName}Request`;
      const responseName = `${rpcName}Response`;
      const requestContent = operation.requestBody?.content ?? {};
      const clientStream = Object.keys(requestContent).some(type => type.includes('multipart/form-data'));
      const responseContent = Object.values(operation.responses ?? {}).flatMap(response => Object.keys(response.content ?? {}));
      const serverStream = responseContent.some(type => type === 'text/event-stream');
      const comment = `// ${method.toUpperCase()} ${route}`;
      return `${comment}\nrpc ${rpcName}(${clientStream ? 'stream ' : ''}${requestName}) returns (${serverStream ? 'stream ' : ''}${responseName});`;
    }
    
    function renderOperationMessages(item, imports) {
      const rpcName = pascal(item.handler);
      const requestFields = [];
      let fieldNumber = 1;
      for (const parameter of item.operation.parameters ?? []) {
        requestFields.push(renderField(snake(parameter.name), parameter.schema, fieldNumber++, imports));
      }
      const requestContent = item.operation.requestBody?.content ?? {};
      const requestSchema = Object.values(requestContent)[0]?.schema;
      if (requestSchema) {
        const isMultipart = Object.keys(requestContent).some(type => type.includes('multipart/form-data'));
        requestFields.push(isMultipart ? `bytes chunk = ${fieldNumber};` : renderField('body', requestSchema, fieldNumber, imports));
      }
    
      const responseContent = Object.values(item.operation.responses ?? {})
        .flatMap(response => Object.values(response.content ?? {}));
      const responseSchema = responseContent[0]?.schema;
      const responseFields = responseSchema
        ? [renderField('value', responseSchema, 1, imports)]
        : [];
    
      return [
        renderMessage(`${rpcName}Request`, requestFields),
        renderMessage(`${rpcName}Response`, responseFields),
      ];
    }
    
    function renderNamedSchema(name, schema, imports) {
      if (!schema) return '';
      const typeName = protoName(name);
      const enumValues = schema.enum;
      if (Array.isArray(enumValues)) return renderEnum(typeName, enumValues);
    
      const actual = nonNullVariant(schema);
      if (actual?.type !== 'object' && !actual?.properties && !actual?.additionalProperties) {
        return renderMessage(typeName, [renderField('value', actual, 1, imports)]);
      }
    
      const required = new Set(actual.required ?? []);
      const fields = [];
      let number = 1;
      for (const [field, fieldSchema] of Object.entries(actual.properties ?? {})) {
        fields.push(renderField(snake(field), fieldSchema, number++, imports, !required.has(field)));
      }
      if (actual.additionalProperties && fields.length === 0) {
        fields.push(renderMapField('values', actual.additionalProperties, number, imports));
      }
      return renderMessage(typeName, fields);
    }
    
    function renderField(name, rawSchema, number, imports, optional = false) {
      const schema = nonNullVariant(rawSchema) ?? {};
      if (schema.type === 'array') {
        return `repeated ${protoType(schema.items, imports)} ${safeField(name)} = ${number};`;
      }
      if (schema.type === 'object' && schema.additionalProperties) {
        return renderMapField(name, schema.additionalProperties, number, imports);
      }
      const type = protoType(schema, imports);
      const prefix = optional && scalarType(type) ? 'optional ' : '';
      return `${prefix}${type} ${safeField(name)} = ${number};`;
    }
    
    function renderMapField(name, valueSchema, number, imports) {
      const valueType = protoType(valueSchema === true ? {} : valueSchema, imports);
      return `map<string, ${mapValueType(valueType)}> ${safeField(name)} = ${number};`;
    }
    
    function protoType(rawSchema, imports) {
      const schema = nonNullVariant(rawSchema) ?? {};
      if (schema.$ref) return protoName(refName(schema.$ref));
      if (schema.enum) return 'string';
      if (schema.type === 'array') return protoType(schema.items, imports);
      switch (schema.type) {
        case 'boolean': return 'bool';
        case 'integer': return schema.format === 'int32' ? 'int32' : 'int64';
        case 'number': return schema.format === 'float' ? 'float' : 'double';
        case 'string': return schema.format === 'binary' || schema.format === 'byte' ? 'bytes' : 'string';
        case 'object':
        default:
          imports.add('google/protobuf/struct.proto');
          return 'google.protobuf.Value';
      }
    }
    
    function nonNullVariant(schema) {
      if (!schema || typeof schema !== 'object') return schema;
      const variants = schema.oneOf ?? schema.anyOf;
      if (!variants) return schema;
      return variants.find(item => item?.type !== 'null') ?? {};
    }
    
    function renderMessage(name, fields) {
      return `message ${name} {\n${fields.length ? fields.map(field => `  ${field}`).join('\n') : ''}\n}\n`;
    }
    
    function renderEnum(name, values) {
      const prefix = snake(name).toUpperCase();
      const lines = [`${prefix}_UNSPECIFIED = 0;`];
      values.forEach((value, index) => lines.push(`${prefix}_${snake(String(value)).toUpperCase()} = ${index + 1};`));
      return `enum ${name} {\n${lines.map(line => `  ${line}`).join('\n')}\n}\n`;
    }
    
    function refName(ref) {
      return decodeURIComponent(ref.split('/').at(-1));
    }
    
    function protoName(value) {
      const result = pascal(String(value).replace(/[<>\[\],:&' ]+/g, '_'));
      return /^\d/.test(result) ? `Type${result}` : result || 'Value';
    }
    
    function pascal(value) {
      return String(value)
        .split(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]+/)
        .filter(Boolean)
        .map(part => part[0].toUpperCase() + part.slice(1))
        .join('');
    }
    
    function snake(value) {
      return String(value)
        .replace(/([a-z0-9])([A-Z])/g, '$1_$2')
        .replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]+/g, '_')
        .replace(/^_+|_+$/g, '')
        .toLowerCase() || 'value';
    }
    
    function safeField(value) {
      const field = snake(value);
      return ['package', 'service', 'rpc', 'message', 'enum', 'repeated', 'optional', 'returns', 'stream', 'reserved'].includes(field)
        ? `${field}_value`
        : field;
    }
    
    function scalarType(type) {
      return ['double', 'float', 'int32', 'int64', 'uint32', 'uint64', 'sint32', 'sint64', 'fixed32', 'fixed64', 'sfixed32', 'sfixed64', 'bool', 'string', 'bytes'].includes(type);
    }
    
    function mapValueType(type) {
      return type === 'google.protobuf.Value' ? type : type;
    }
    
    function indent(value) {
      return value.split('\n').map(line => `  ${line}`).join('\n');
    }
